অধ্যক্ষ মোহাম্মদ জহিরুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জ:
Principal Mohammad Zahirul Islam is the member of parliament for Chattogram-16 (Banshkhali) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, and took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.

Zahirul Islam was born on 12 March 1976 in Shekherkhil union, Banshkhali upazila, Chattogram district. He is the son of Maulana Md. Ishaq and Mosammat Johora Begum.

He obtained a bachelor's (honours) degree in law. He began his career in 1998 as a lecturer at Hamedia Rahima Fazil Madrasa in Banshkhali. In 2001 he was appointed principal of the same madrasa.

At the age of only 24 he was elected chairman of the Shekherkhil union parishad, and he held the post for two terms. In the upazila parishad election held on 23 March 2014 he was elected chairman of the Banshkhali upazila parishad. In 2018 he gave up the post of upazila chairman to take part in the parliamentary election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-16 as the Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 93,167 votes.
অধ্যাপক নজরুল ইসলাম, যিনি নজরুল ইসলাম মণ:
Prof. Nazrul Islam, also known as Nazrul Islam Mondal, is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Rajshahi-5, a seat made up of Durgapur and Puthia upazilas. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 15 February 1953 in Puthia upazila of Rajshahi district. His father's name is Moyez Uddin Mondal and his mother's name is Fatema Begum. In his working life he was engaged in teaching and business.

Known in local media as a veteran politician, Nazrul Islam was elected by a wide margin in the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026, winning 153,425 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Maulana Manjur Rahman, received 73,445 votes. After the election the Jamaat candidate and local leaders attended an event and greeted and congratulated him with flowers.
অধ্যাপক মোঃ মুজিবুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Professor Md. Mujibur Rahman is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Rajshahi-1, a seat made up of Godagari and Tanore upazilas. A senior nayeb-e-amir (deputy amir) of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, he is representing this seat in Parliament for the second time. In the current Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

He was born on 1 January 1955 in Rajshahi district. His father's name is Serajul Islam and his mother's name is Hamida Khatun.

He obtained honours and MA degrees in English literature from the University of Rajshahi, and a diploma in Arabic and Persian from the same university. Although he passed the BCS education cadre examination, he did not join government service, so as to devote himself fully to Islamic social and political work. He later spent a long career as a professor in the English department of a private college. He is the author of more than 40 books and has visited more than 15 countries around the world to present the ideals of Islam.

He joined Jamaat-e-Islami in 1979 and went on to hold various leadership posts in the party. He was president of the Bangladesh Sramik Kalyan Federation. As the party's nayeb-e-amir, he also served as acting amir in 2017 and 2022. He was first elected MP from Rajshahi-1 in the 3rd parliamentary election in 1986 and served until March 1988.

Almost four decades later, in the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026, he was elected again from the same seat with 171,786 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Sharif Uddin, received 169,902 votes.
অনিন্দ্য ইসলাম অমিত বিদ্যুৎ, জ্বালানি ও:
Aninda Islam Amit is the State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources and the member of parliament (MP) for Jashore-3. He took office on 17 February 2026. A biochemist and businessman, Amit was elected to Parliament for the first time in the 13th Parliament.

He was born in Jashore on 24 August 1975. His father, Tarikul Islam, was a member of the BNP's standing committee and a former Minister of Information; his mother is Professor Nargis Islam. He passed the SSC in 1991 and the HSC in 1993 from Jhenaidah Cadet College, and then obtained a BSc (Honours) in 1996 and an MSc in 1997 in biochemistry and molecular biology from the University of Dhaka. He took an MBA from North South University in 2002. While at university he was team leader for Fazlul Huq Hall in a televised debating competition.

He is managing director of Labscan Medical Services Limited and Lokshamaj Limited. He is a life member of many organisations, including the Jashore Red Crescent Society, Jashore Institute, Bangla Academy, Jashore Chamber of Commerce and the Bangladesh Biochemical Society.

He was involved in student politics at the University of Dhaka, and since 1996 he has played a role in all of the party's national and local elections. He has served as the BNP's central assistant organising secretary (Khulna division). His wife is Sohana Parvin; they have two sons.
অ্যাডভোকেট আবুল কালাম নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৫ (সদর:
Advocate Abul Kalam is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-5 (Sadar and Bandar). This veteran BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the fourth time.

He was born on 11 March 1951 in Narayanganj District. His father, Haji Jalal Uddin Ahmed, was a founding member of the BNP and a member of parliament. His mother is Rahemunnesa Begum. He is a lawyer by profession and was enrolled as a lawyer in 1987.

Abul Kalam has served as president of the Narayanganj Metropolitan BNP and as a member of the BNP's central executive committee. He was elected MP from Narayanganj-5 in the parliamentary elections of 1991, February 1996 and 2001.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was again elected MP for Narayanganj-5 with 114,799 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
অ্যাডভোকেট এম, রুহুল কুদ্দুস তালুকদার দু:
Advocate M. Ruhul Quddus Talukder Dulu is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Natore-2, a seat made up of Natore Sadar and Naldanga upazilas. This BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the fourth time. Since 12 September 2026 he has served as a whip in Parliament. He is a former deputy minister.

He was born on 7 September 1962 in Natore Sadar upazila. His father is Dr Nasir Uddin Talukder and his mother Rafia Nasir. His permanent address is at Alaipur in Natore Sadar.

He is a lawyer by profession, and alongside his legal practice he has long been active in politics. In 1977 he joined the BNP's student organisation, Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, and held various posts in Chhatra Dal. He later also led the Natore district BNP, and has served as the party's central organising secretary.

He was the MP for Natore-2 from 1996 to 2006. He was elected in the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 with 109,196 votes, and during the term of the 8th Parliament served as Deputy Minister of Land. Earlier, as an MP, he was a member of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Communications.

In the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026 he was elected again, with 162,841 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Md. Yunus Ali, received 130,066 votes. In his election pledges he spoke of building Natore into a peaceful, developed and discrimination-free district.
অ্যাডভোকেট নূরুল ইসলাম সুনামগঞ্জ-৪ (সুনা:
Advocate Nurul Islam is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-4 (Sunamganj Sadar and Bishwamvarpur). Known as Nurul Islam Nurul, this lawyer and politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

Nurul Islam was born on 9 October 1976 in Sunamganj Sadar Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Mahtab Ali and his mother Nurjahan Begum. He is a lawyer by profession.

In the 2026 election, as the candidate of the BNP and its alliance, he announced an 11-point election manifesto. It contained pledges on social security, protection of the haors, agriculture, employment, education, healthcare and women's empowerment. He said he wanted to be an MP of the people, not of power.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 98,092 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
অ্যাডভোকেট মোঃ শফিকুল হক মিলন ত্রয়োদশ জ:
Advocate Mohammad Shofiqul Haque Milon is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Rajshahi-3, a seat made up of Paba and Mohanpur upazilas. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In the current Parliament he is chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

He was born on 27 September 1968. His father's name is Md. Hisum Uddin and his mother's name is Mabia Khatun.

Shofiqul Haque Milon is a lawyer by profession. Practising law in Rajshahi for many years, he has provided legal assistance to political activists, human rights activists and ordinary people.

In party politics he is assistant relief and rehabilitation secretary of the BNP's national executive committee. In this role he is involved in the party's relief, rehabilitation and post-disaster assistance activities. He previously served as general secretary of the Rajshahi metropolitan BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 176,318 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Professor Md. Abul Kalam Azad, received 137,927 votes. After the result was announced, the exchange of greetings between the two candidates was talked about locally as an example of goodwill. At the time Milon said that the election was a festival of democracy, and that he wanted to work for the development of the Rajshahi-3 seat with everyone's views and cooperation.
আখতার হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে রংপুর-:
Akhter Hossen is the member of parliament for Rangpur-4 (Pirgacha and Kaunia) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP), and serves as the party's member secretary. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions, and the Library Committee.

Akhter Hossen was born in Sarda Taluk in Kaunia upazila, Rangpur district. His father is Abdus Salam and his mother Rokeya Begum. He completed his secondary education at Bhayarhat Piaria Fazil Madrasa and his Alim at Dhap Satgara Baitul Mukarram Model Kamil Madrasa. He later studied law at the University of Dhaka.

He gained national prominence while still a student. In 2018 he staged a solo hunger strike in protest at the leaking of question papers for the university admission test, and in the same year he played an important role in the quota reform movement. In 2019 he was elected social welfare secretary of the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU). He also served as president and as general secretary of the University of Dhaka unit, and as a vice-president of the central committee, of the Bangladesh General Students' Rights Protection Council. He is the founder of Gonotantrik Chhatra Shakti.

In 2024 he was one of the coordinators of the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement, and he later served as member secretary of the Jatiya Nagorik Committee. When the National Citizen Party was launched on 28 February 2025, he was appointed its member secretary. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-4, winning 149,966 votes with the water lily symbol.
আজহারুল ইসলাম মান্নান নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৩ (সোন:
Azharul Islam Mannan is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-3 (Sonargaon and Siddhirganj). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

He was born on 25 December 1965 in Sonargaon Upazila, Narayanganj District. His father is Lal Mia Bepari and his mother Ayesha Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-3 with 155,400 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he said he dedicated it to the welfare of the people.
আতিকুর রহমান মোজাহিদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Atiqur Rahman Mujahid is the member of parliament for Kurigram-2 (Kurigram Sadar, Rajarhat and Fulbari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is a joint convener of the NCP and joined the party's political council in April 2026. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Atiqur Rahman Mujahid was born on 20 December 1992 in Pathan Para in the Tograihat area of Rajarhat upazila, Kurigram district. His father is Amjad Hossain and his mother Arjuna Begum.

He completed his bachelor's degree at the University of Dhaka. He then went on an international scholarship to the International Islamic University Malaysia, where he obtained a master's degree and a PhD. Professionally he is engaged in business and teaching.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kurigram-2 as the NCP candidate, winning 178,869 votes.
আতিকুল আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুমিল্ল:
Atikul Alam is the independent member of parliament for Cumilla-7 (Chandina upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time. Locally he is known as Atikul Alam Shawon.

Atikul Alam was born in Chandina, Cumilla. He is the son of Md. Khorshed Alam and Jebun Nahar. After completing his primary education at Chandina Adarsha Government Primary School, he passed the SSC in 2006 from Chandina Government Model Pilot School and the HSC from Coda College in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. He later completed an LLB (Honours) at Bhuiyan Academy.

In politics he has served as president of Chandina upazila BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Cumilla-7 as an independent candidate, winning 91,690 votes with the pitcher symbol. He is the father of a son and a daughter.
আনিছুর রহমান মাদারীপুর-৩ আসন থেকে নির্বা:
Anisur Rahaman is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Madaripur-3. Known as Anisur Rahman Talukder Khokon, this politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

He was born on 6 May 1976. His father is Haji Esahak Uddin Talukder and his mother Golbahar Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he holds the post responsible for mass education affairs in the central BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 96,188 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আন্না মিন্‌জ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Anna Minj is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-19 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Anna Minj was born on 31 October 1961. She is the daughter of the late Paulus Minj and the late Serafina Kujur. She lives in Jonail village, Baraigram upazila, Natore district.

A leader of the Oraon community, she has been working for the development of Christians and people of small ethnic groups. Anna Minj is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-19 through the votes of the members of parliament. She is the country's first member of parliament from the Oraon community.

Her husband, Advocate John Gomes, is a lawyer by profession and assistant religious affairs secretary of the BNP central committee.
আফরোজা খানম রিতা খাদ্যমন্ত্রী এবং মানিকগ:
Afroza Khanam Rita is the Minister for Food and the member of parliament for Manikganj-3. She took charge of the Ministry of Food on 21 August 2026; before that she was Minister for Civil Aviation and Tourism in the same cabinet. An industrial entrepreneur, Rita is chairman of the Munnu Group of Industries.

She was born on 4 April 1962 in Manikganj. Her father, Harunar Rashid Khan Munnu, was an industrialist, a minister and a four-time member of parliament for the Manikganj-2 and Manikganj-3 seats; her mother is Huron Nahar Rashid. She placed eighth in the national merit list in the higher secondary examination and obtained a BCom (Honours) in accounting from the University of Dhaka.

A member of the BNP Chairperson's advisory council, Rita was long part of the leadership of Manikganj District BNP. In 2008 she was the party's candidate for Manikganj-2. In 2010 she became a member of the BNP National Executive Committee and in 2013 president of the district BNP; she later became convener of the district BNP.

In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament she was elected member of parliament for the first time, from Manikganj-3. She is married to Moinul Islam.
আবদুল আউয়াল মিন্টু পরিবেশ, বন ও জলবায়ু:
Abdul Awal Mintoo is the Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change and the member of parliament for Feni-3. He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A former president of the FBCCI, the country's apex business organisation, this industrial entrepreneur is a senior BNP leader; he has also served as the party's vice-chairman.

He was born on 22 February 1949 in Aliarpur village, Feni; his father is Alhaj Shafiullah. He passed the SSC from Feni Government Pilot High School in 1964 and the HSC from Cumilla Victoria College in 1966. After a diploma in nautical science in 1968 from what was then the Pakistan Marine Academy (now the Mercantile Marine Academy), he obtained a bachelor's degree in marine transportation and a master's degree in transportation management from the State University of New York Maritime College in the United States.

In 2003 he was elected president of the Federation of Bangladesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FBCCI). He was a director of National Bank and of a large private insurance company, and he is involved in shipping, textiles, cement and agro-based industries, particularly vegetable seed production and research. He was president of the Bangladesh Employers' Federation (1997–99), chairman of the Bangladesh Ocean Going Ship Owners' Association (1988–2000) and chairman of the Bangladesh-India Chamber of Commerce. He has also served on the governing boards of the Dhaka Stock Exchange, Bangladesh Open University and the Bangladesh Institute of Management. He has founded several educational institutions in his home area.

In the election of 12 February 2026 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 157,425 votes in Feni-3. His wife, Nasreen Fatema Awal, is the founding president of the Women Entrepreneurs Association of Bangladesh; they have three sons, Tabith, Tafsir and Tajwar Awal.
আবদুল ওয়াদুদ ভূঁঞা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Abdul Wadud Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for the hill district seat of Khagrachhari in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament from this seat for the third time. He is assistant employment affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee and president of the Khagrachhari district BNP.

Wadud Bhuiyan was born on 5 January 1965 in Ramgarh, Khagrachhari. His father, Alhaj Saleh Ahammad Bhuiyan, was a businessman and social worker; his mother is Bia Saleh. He received his first lessons from his mother; he also became proficient in the local Chakma language. After studying at Ramgarh Government Primary School, he obtained a master's degree (MSS) in sociology from the University of Chittagong in 1986. He is a politician and businessman by profession.

As a student he was convener of the University of Chittagong unit of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal from 1987 to 1989 and president of the Ramgarh unit of the Chhatra Dal from 1980 to 1990. In 1989 he was elected a member of the Khagrachhari Hill District Council. In February 1996 and in 2001 he was elected member of parliament for the Khagrachhari seat as the BNP candidate. In 2001 he became a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs, and from 2002 to 2006 he served as chairman of the Chittagong Hill Tracts Development Board.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for the Khagrachhari seat as the BNP candidate, winning 148,212 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আবদুল হান্নান মাসউদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Abdul Hannan Masud is the member of parliament for Noakhali-6 (Hatiya) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is a senior joint chief coordinator of the NCP and the youngest male member of Parliament.

Masud was born on 1 January 2000 in Burirchar union, Hatiya upazila, Noakhali district. His father, Amirul Islam Mohammad Abdul Malek, is a retired madrasa teacher, and his mother is Ayesha Khatun Bilkis. He is studying for an undergraduate (honours) degree at the University of Dhaka.

He first gained national prominence during the 2024 quota reform movement. He was one of the coordinators of Students Against Discrimination, which led the movement, and later joined the leadership of the National Citizen Party.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, contesting Noakhali-6 on the National Citizen Party's nomination as the candidate of the 11-party electoral alliance, he was elected a member of parliament with 91,899 votes. In 2025 he married Shamoli Sultana Jedni, a former leader of Jatiya Chhatra Shakti.
আবুল কাওছার মোহাম্মদ নজরুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদ:
Abul Kausar Muhammad Nazrul Islam is the member of parliament for Gaibandha-3, which consists of Sadullapur and Palashbari upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He is serving in Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. Locally he is also known as Nazrul Islam Lebu.

He was born on 1 March 1961 in Palashbari upazila, Gaibandha district. His father's name is Amir Uddin Sarkar and his mother's Abeda Begum.

In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026, Nazrul Islam was elected with 162,457 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Professor Dr Syed Moinul Hasan Sadik, received 139,864 votes. He took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.
আবুল কালাম আজাদ সিদ্দিকী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Abul Kalam Azad Siddique is the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-7 (Mirzapur) in the 13th Parliament. This is his third term, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he serves as chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Azad Siddique was born on 31 October 1964. He is the son of Azgar Ali Siddique and Jamela Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

As a student he was involved in Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics. He later served as children's affairs secretary of the BNP's central executive committee and as president of Mirzapur upazila BNP. He was elected MP for Tangail-7 on the sheaf of paddy symbol in the election to the 6th Parliament on 15 February 1996 and in the election to the 7th Parliament on 12 June of the same year.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Tangail-7 for the third time with 141,253 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আবুল হোসেন খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে বরি:
Abul Hossain Khan is the member of parliament (MP) for Barishal-6 (Bakerganj) in the 13th Parliament. This is his second term, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce. He was born on 10 April 1953. He is the son of Asmat Ali Khan and Nurun Nahar.

Abul Hossain Khan was a student at the University of Dhaka, where his political life began as a student leader. He has served as a member of the BNP's national executive committee and as convener of Barishal district BNP. In 2018 he was president of Bakerganj upazila BNP. In the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001 he was first elected MP for Barishal-6 as the BNP candidate. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the second time, for the same seat, with 82,217 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আব্দুল মুনতাকিম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে নী:
Abdul Muntakim is the member of parliament for Nilphamari-4 (Saidpur and Kishoreganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Commerce. Within the party he is ameer of the Saidpur upazila Jamaat-e-Islami.

Muntakim was born on 10 January 1981 in the Rail Bazar area of Saidpur town, Nilphamari district. His father is Md. Abdul Kader Syedi and his mother Mst. Moslema Begum. As a child he memorised the Holy Quran (hifz), and he later obtained a higher degree in general education. Locally he is known as Hafez Abdul Muntakim. Before becoming active in politics he taught at Al Faruk Academy in Saidpur.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Nilphamari-4 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 126,222 votes.
আব্দুল্লাহ আল আমিন নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৪ আসন থেক:
Abdullah Al Amin is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-4. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is head of the NCP's discipline department.

He was born on 4 September 1995 in Narayanganj and grew up there. His father is Md. Zakir Hossain and his mother Ayesha Khatun. After completing his studies at local schools and colleges, he obtained LLB (Hons) and LLM degrees from the Department of Law at the University of Dhaka. By profession he is a High Court lawyer.

As a student he was active in the quota reform movement and the road safety movement, and he was out on the streets in the July 2024 mass uprising. He later joined the National Citizen Party and was given the post of chief coordinator of the NCP's Narayanganj District unit.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-4 with 106,171 votes as the candidate of an 11-party electoral alliance. He is a member of the Narayanganj District Law and Order Committee and of the Red Crescent Society.
আব্দুস সালাম আজাদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Abdus Salam Azad is the member of parliament for Munshiganj-2 (Louhajang and Tongibari Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In the party he serves as a central joint secretary general. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

Salam Azad was born on 3 January 1961. He is the son of Joynal Abedin and Jahanara Begum.

He served as senior vice-president of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, the BNP's youth organisation. In May 2015 he became an assistant organising secretary of the BNP, and in May 2022 he was appointed the party's organising secretary for Dhaka Division. In October 2025 he was made a joint secretary general of the BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 121,154 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী অর্থ ও পরিকল্পনা:
Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury is the Minister of Finance and Planning and the member of parliament for Chattogram-11. He took charge of the two ministries on 17 February 2026. He came into politics with long experience as a businessman and an organiser of the capital market; he is a member of the standing committee, the BNP's highest policymaking forum.

He was born in North Kattali, Pahartali, Chattogram. His father, Mahmudunnabi Chowdhury, was elected a member of the East Pakistan Legislative Assembly for the United Front in 1954 and was minister of mass communication, and later of relief and rehabilitation, in the provincial government; his mother is Meherunnesa Begum Chowdhury. After obtaining a bachelor's degree from Chittagong College in 1969, he went on to higher studies in accounting in London.

After completing his studies he joined the family business. He was the founder and chairman of the Chittagong Stock Exchange, president of the Chittagong Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the first president of the South Asian Federation of Exchanges. He has also served as honorary consul of South Korea in Chattogram, acting chairman of Sonali Bank and a member of the advisory committee of the National Board of Revenue.

He first entered Parliament in 1991 by winning the by-election held after Khaleda Zia gave up the Chattogram-8 seat; he won the same seat in both elections of 1996 and again in 2001. He was Minister of Commerce from 10 October 2001 to 25 March 2004. He has also served as president of the Chattogram metropolitan BNP. Elected from Chattogram-11 in the election to the 13th Parliament, he joined Tarique Rahman's cabinet. He is married to Tahera Alam; they have one son and one daughter.
আমীর এজাজ খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে খুলন:
Amir Azez Khan is the member of parliament (MP) for Khulna-1 (Dacope and Batiaghata) in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time and serves as a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

He was born on 31 December 1970 in Khulna district. He is the son of Md. Arif Ali Khan and Fatema Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Amir Azez Khan is a senior BNP leader and a former convener of Khulna district BNP. In his own words, he has stood by the people of the area for more than three decades. He was also the party's candidate for Khulna-1 in the national elections of 2001, 2008 and 2018.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Khulna-1 with 121,352 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol. According to a report in Prothom Alo, this was the first time since independence that a BNP candidate had won Khulna-1.
আরিফা সুলতানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Arifa Sultana is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-30 in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), she is a member of the party's Dhaka Metropolitan South unit.

Known as Advocate Arifa Sultana Ruma, she was born on 21 April 1979. Her father is Md. Akkas Ali and her mother is Mst. Halima Begum. She is a lawyer at the Dhaka Bar by profession.

She has been active in politics since her student days. She was an assistant general secretary of the central committee of the Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. Alongside her legal practice she is also involved in social work, and she has served as president of the ad hoc committee of Chatmohar Pilot Girls' High School.

Arifa Sultana was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. According to a report in The Daily Star, the party has given her organisational responsibility for the Pabna-1, Pabna-3 and Pabna-4 constituencies.
আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী শ্রম ও কর্মসংস্থান এবং:
Ariful Haque Choudhury is the Minister for Labour and Employment and for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment, and the member of parliament for Sylhet-4. He took charge of the two ministries on 17 February 2026. He was mayor of Sylhet City Corporation for two terms and is a member of the BNP chairperson's advisory council.

He was born on 23 November 1959 at Kumarpara in Sylhet; he is the son of Md. Shafiqul Haque Choudhury and Amina Khatun.

His political career began as a member of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He was president of Sylhet Metropolitan BNP and general secretary of the district BNP, and has also served as a member of the party's central committee. In 2003 he was elected a councillor of Sylhet City Corporation and became chairman of its urban development and planning committee; he was later mayor of the city for two terms.

Elected a member of parliament for the first time from Sylhet-4 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he was given charge of the two ministries for expatriates working abroad and for the country's workers.
আলতাফ হোসেন চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Altaf Hossain Choudhury is the member of parliament (MP) for Patuakhali-1 in the 13th Parliament. A former Chief of Air Staff and former minister, this veteran leader is a vice-chairman of the national executive committee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

He was born on 13 June 1943. He is the son of Abdul Aziz Choudhury and Momena Khatun Choudhury.

He began his career as a fighter pilot in the Pakistan Air Force and qualified as a lead pilot on the Mirage III fighter. He joined the Bangladesh Air Force as a squadron leader in 1972. From 1974 to 1977 he was an instructor at the pilot training school. From 1991 to 1995 he served as Chief of Air Staff of the Bangladesh Air Force.

After retiring, Altaf Hossain Choudhury joined the BNP. Elected MP for Patuakhali-1 in the 2001 election, he served as Home Minister from 2001 to 2004 and as Commerce Minister from 2004 to 2006. In 2008 he was president of Patuakhali district BNP, and he later became a vice-chairman of the party.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was again elected MP for Patuakhali-1 with 152,087 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আলফারুক আব্দুল লতীফ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Al Faruq Abdul Latif is the member of parliament for Nilphamari-2 (Nilphamari Sadar) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Al Faruq was born on 1 September 1970 in Nilphamari. His father is Muhammad Abdul Latif and his mother Hasna Banu. He is a lawyer by profession and is known as Advocate Al Faruq Abdul Latif. Within the party he serves as assistant secretary of the Nilphamari district Jamaat-e-Islami.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Nilphamari-2, winning 146,430 votes with the scales symbol.
আলমগীর মুহাম্মদ মাহফুজ উল্লাহ ফরিদ ত্রয়:
Alamgir Mohammed Mahfuz Ullah Farid is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 (Kutubdia and Moheshkhali upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament from this seat for the third time. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

Mahfuz Ullah Farid was born on 1 October 1957 in Moheshkhali upazila, Cox's Bazar district. He is the son of Aktar Kamal and Surat Jamal Begum. In a family of eight brothers and sisters, he is the third of the brothers. His elder brother, the late Sirajul Haque, was a union parishad chairman, and his younger brother, Mohammad Shahidullah, was chairman of the Bara Moheshkhali union parishad.

He is a lawyer by profession and a member of the Cox's Bazar Bar Association. In 1996 he was first elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 as the BNP candidate, and in 2001 he was re-elected from the same seat. In Parliament he served on the Committee on Public Undertakings. He is a member of the BNP national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 as the BNP candidate, winning 125,543 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আলহাজ্ব জসীম উদ্দীন আহমেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Alhajj Jashim Uddin Ahammed is the member of parliament for Chattogram-14 (Chandanaish upazila and six unions of Satkania upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Jashim Uddin Ahammed was born on 10 June 1977 in Chandanaish. He is the son of Alhaj Mofzal Ahmad and Haji Nur Begum. He is a businessman by profession. Before becoming a member of parliament he served as chairman of the Chandanaish upazila parishad.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-14 as the BNP's nominated candidate, winning 76,493 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আলহাজ্ব মোঃ জি কে গউছ হবিগঞ্জ-৩ আসন থেকে:
Alhaj Md. G.K. Gouse is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Habiganj-3 and a Whip in the 13th Parliament. This is his first term in Parliament. He is also chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

G.K. Gouse was born on 20 April 1968 in Shayestanagar village, Habiganj Sadar upazila. His father was the late Alhaj Golam Murtuza and his mother the late Alhaj Monjila Begum. By profession he is a businessman.

In local government he has served as mayor of Habiganj municipality. In party politics he is BNP's central organising secretary (Sylhet division). In August 2025 he was elected unopposed as president of Habiganj district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 142,348 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He was later made a Whip of Parliament. He is married to Farhana Gouse Happy and is the father of two sons.
আলী আজম মোঃ আবু বকর ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Ali Azam Md. Abu Bakr is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jhenaidah-2 (most of Jhenaidah Sadar upazila, and Horinakundu upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is amir of the Jhenaidah district Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 27 October 1969 in Jhenaidah Sadar. His father is Sheikh Md. Esem Ali and his mother Jamila Khatun.

He is a teacher by profession and is known as Professor Ali Azam Md. Abu Bakr. Jamaat-e-Islami announced him, as its Jhenaidah district amir, as the party's candidate for Jhenaidah-2.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jhenaidah-2 with 195,702 votes under the scales symbol.
আলী নেওয়াজ মাহমুদ খৈয়ম সংস্কৃতি বিষয়ক:
Ali Newaz Mahmood Khyom is State Minister for Cultural Affairs and MP for Rajbari-1 (Sadar-Goalanda). He took office on 17 February 2026. A member of the BNP's central executive committee, Khyom is president of the Rajbari District BNP.

He was born on 25 May 1957; his father is Dr. A. K. M. A. Wahid.

He was first elected MP from Rajbari-1 as the BNP candidate in the 2001 parliamentary election. He was defeated in the same seat in the 2008 and 2018 elections. Winning again in the 13th parliamentary election of 2026, he entered Parliament for the second time and became State Minister for Cultural Affairs.
আসাদুল হাবিব দুলু দুর্যোগ ব্যবস্থাপনা ও:
Asadul Habib Dulu is the Minister for Disaster Management and Relief and the member of parliament for Lalmonirhat-3. He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. Dulu, the BNP's organising secretary for Rangpur division, was previously a Deputy Minister in the government of 2001–2006; he has been elected MP from Lalmonirhat three times.

He was born on 5 August 1960 in Lalmonirhat; his father is Abul Kashem Mia. He obtained a master's degree in economics from the University of Rajshahi. He was engaged in teaching and in business, and is the founding principal of Shahid Abul Kashem College in Lalmonirhat. He is also known as Engineer Dulu.

During the BNP government he was Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Food and Disaster Management. He has now returned to that ministry as a full Minister. His wife is Laila Habib; they have two sons, Ahnaf Habib and Ahmik Habib.
আহমেদ আযম খান মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রী:
Ahmed Aazam Khan is the Minister of Liberation War Affairs and the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-8. He took office as minister on 12 March 2026. A lawyer by profession, he is a vice-chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

He was born in Basail, Tangail; his father is Habibur Rahman Khan. Alongside his legal practice, he has long been active in the BNP's central politics.

He was the party's candidate for Tangail-8 in the 2008 and 2018 elections, and was defeated both times. Elected MP for the first time, from the same seat, in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he joined Tarique Rahman's Cabinet.
আহম্মদ সোহেল মনজুর সুমন গৃহায়ন ও গণপূর্:
Ahammad Sohel Monzoor Sumon is the State Minister for Housing and Public Works and the member of parliament (MP) for Pirojpur-2 (Kawkhali, Bhandaria and Nesarabad). He was sworn in on 17 February 2026 and formally took charge the following day. He is an industrialist by profession.

He was born in Pirojpur; his father is Md. Nurul Islam Monzoor.

Involved in Bangladesh Nationalist Party politics, Sumon was elected MP for Pirojpur-2 for the first time in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
ইকবাল হাসান মাহ্‌মুদ টুকু বিদ্যুৎ, জ্বাল:
Iqbal Hassan Mahmood Tuku is the Minister of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources and the member of parliament (MP) for Sirajganj-2. He was sworn in as minister on 17 February 2026. A freedom fighter of 1971, an industrialist and a four-time MP, he is a member of the BNP's national standing committee.

He was born on 10 May 1950 in Koyelgati village of Shialkol union in Sirajganj. His father, Abdullah Al Mahmud, was Minister of Industries and Natural Resources in the government of Pakistan; his mother's name is Abeda Khatun. After primary and secondary education in Sirajganj, he obtained a master's degree from the University of Dhaka in 1975. As a student he was involved with the East Pakistan Students' Union, took part in the Eleven-Point movement of 1969, and joined the Liberation War in 1971.

He has had a long involvement in industry and trade, particularly in the export-oriented textile and home textile industries. He was managing director of Apex Weaving and Finishing Mills and was associated with several companies of the Apex Group. He has also served as a director of the Bangladesh Shilpa Rin Sangstha (Bangladesh Industrial Loan Agency) and as president of the Dhaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

He became MP for Sirajganj-2 for the Jatiya Party in 1986 and 1988, and joined the BNP in 1990. He won the same seat again in 2001, and in Khaleda Zia's government he was State Minister for Power from October 2001 to May 2006, and later State Minister for Agriculture. He became a member of the BNP's national standing committee on 19 June 2019. In 2007 he was convicted in a case brought by the Anti-Corruption Commission; after a long legal process and exile in London he returned home in October 2024, and in September 2025 the Appellate Division acquitted him of all charges.

His wife, Rumana Mahmood, is a former MP; they have one son and one daughter. Former Deputy Prime Minister M. A. Matin is his brother-in-law (his sister's husband); Matin's son, M. A. Muhit, is also a member of the current Cabinet.
ইঞ্জিনিয়ার ইশরাক হোসেন মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয:
Engineer Ishraque Hossain is the State Minister for Liberation War Affairs and the member of parliament for Dhaka-6. He took office on 17 February 2026 and is the youngest member of the cabinet. An engineer, Ishraque is one of the BNP's young leaders.

He was born on 5 April 1987 in Dhaka. His father, Sadeque Hossain Khoka, was a freedom fighter, a former minister and the last mayor of the undivided Dhaka City Corporation. After studying at Scholastica in Dhaka, he obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from the University of Hertfordshire in the United Kingdom.

He was the BNP candidate in the Dhaka South City Corporation mayoral election of 1 February 2020. When the Awami League candidate, Sheikh Fazle Noor Taposh, was declared the winner in the preliminary results, the BNP rejected the result, alleging rigging; on 3 March 2020 Ishraque filed a case in court seeking the annulment of the result and a declaration that he was the lawful winner.

Elected member of parliament for the first time, from Dhaka-6 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he became State Minister for Liberation War Affairs, the war in which his father had himself taken part.
ইয়াসের খান চৌধুরী তথ্য ও সম্প্রচার প্রত:
Yasser Khan Choudhury is the State Minister for Information and Broadcasting and the member of parliament for Mymensingh-9 (Nandail). He took office on 17 February 2026 and was nominated chairman of the Journalists' Welfare Trust. An information technology specialist, Yasser worked for a long time in the information technology department of the BBC television network in London.

He was born on 18 February 1982 in Moazzempur village, Nandail Upazila, Mymensingh. His father, Anwarul Hossain Khan Chowdhury, was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-9 in 1991; his mother is Rahat Khan Chowdhury.

In BNP politics he was convener of Nandail Upazila BNP. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was elected member of parliament for the first time, from his father's seat, Mymensingh-9, with 85,761 votes.
ইসরাত সুলতানা ইলেন ভূট্টো ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Esrat Sultana Elen Bhutto is the member of parliament (MP) for Jhalokathi-2 (Jhalokathi Sadar and Nalchity) in the 13th Parliament. She has represented this seat before, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is the only woman candidate to win in the Barishal region in the 13th parliamentary election. She was born on 12 October 1966. She is the daughter of Golam Rahman Chowdhury and Mst. Rizia Chowdhury.

Her late husband, Zulfikar Ali Bhutto, was twice elected MP for Jhalokathi-2. After her husband's death, Elen Bhutto became active in BNP politics, and in the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001 she was elected MP for Jhalokathi-2 as the BNP candidate.

Having received the party's nomination for the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, she was again elected MP for Jhalokathi-2 with 113,419 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এ এম মাহবুব উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
A M Mahbub Uddin Khokon is the member of parliament for Noakhali-1 (Chatkhil upazila and part of Sonaimuri upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the second time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is a well-known lawyer, known as Mahbub Uddin Khokon. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, the standing committee on public accounts and the committee on private members' bills and resolutions.

Mahbub Uddin Khokon was born on 12 January 1956 at Sonapur, Sonaimuri upazila, Noakhali district. He is the son of Momtaz Uddin Ahmed and Rowshan Ara Begum. He is the eldest of nine siblings. After passing the SSC from Gopalpur High School, Noakhali, and the HSC from Dhaka Government College, he obtained an LLB degree from the University of Dhaka. In 1992 he completed an LLB (Honours) in Wales, United Kingdom, and in 1993 he was called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn.

He has practised law since 1994. He is the founder and head of the Dhaka-based law firm Mahbub & Company. He has also served as a lawyer for BNP chairperson Khaleda Zia. In March 2024 he was elected president of the Bangladesh Supreme Court Bar Association.

In the 9th parliamentary election in 2008 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from Noakhali-1 as the BNP candidate. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, from the same seat, winning 126,833 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is the father of a daughter and a son; his son is also a barrister.
এ টি এম আজহারুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
A T M Azharul Islam is the member of parliament for Rangpur-2 (Taraganj and Badarganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a nayeb-e-ameer (deputy ameer) of Jamaat-e-Islami and a member of the party's central executive council. In Parliament he is a member of the Business Advisory Committee.

Azharul Islam was born on 28 February 1952 in Rangpur district. His father is Nazir Hossain Ahmad and his mother Romisa Begum. He studied at the University of Dhaka.

He has been involved with the organisation since his student days. After Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir was founded, he became the first president of its University of Dhaka unit. He later served as assistant secretary general and as acting secretary general of Jamaat-e-Islami. He was a candidate for Rangpur-2 in the parliamentary elections of 1996, 2001 and 2008.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-2 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 89,456 votes. At a meeting to exchange views after the election, he pledged to work sincerely to meet the people's expectations and to serve everyone regardless of party or opinion.
এ বি এম মোশাররফ হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
A B M Mosharrof Hossain is the member of parliament (MP) for Patuakhali-4 (Kalapara and Rangabali) in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time. He is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and of the Library Committee, and chair of Sub-committee No. 2 of the Library Committee.

He was born on 25 May 1967 in Patuakhali district. He is the son of Md. Nurul Haque and Saleha Begum. He was a student of Kabi Jasimuddin Hall at the University of Dhaka. Alongside politics, he is engaged in business.

As a student, Mosharrof Hossain was president of the University of Dhaka unit of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He later served as central organising secretary and as first joint convener of Chhatra Dal. He is president of Kalapara upazila BNP. He was also the BNP candidate for this seat in the 2008 and 2018 elections.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Patuakhali-4 with 124,013 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol, and took the oath on 17 February.
এ, ই, সুলতান মাহমুদ বাবু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
A. E. Sultan Mahmud Babu is the member of parliament for Jamalpur-2 (Islampur) in the 13th Parliament. This is his third term for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

Sultan Mahmud Babu was born on 31 March 1955 at Sarkarpara in Gaibandha Union, Islampur Upazila, Jamalpur District. He is the son of Alhaj Shamsuddin Ahmed and Alhaj Nasimunnesa. He passed the SSC from Mohammadpur Government High School and the HSC from Suhrawardy College, and then obtained a BSc in chemistry from the University of Dhaka. After a long break he returned to his studies, completing a BA (Honours) in English literature in 2012 and an MA in 2013 at Darul Ihsan University, and an MBA at American Bangladesh University in 2015. He is a businessman by profession.

Active in BNP politics for several decades, Babu began his political career in the 1980s by building up the party organisation in the Islampur and Sindurmari areas. He has served as president of Islampur Upazila BNP, vice-president of Jamalpur District BNP and a member of the BNP National Executive Committee. He was elected member of parliament for Jamalpur-2 in the February 1996 and 2001 parliamentary elections. In the 8th Parliament he served as chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Housing and Public Works.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for the third time, winning Jamalpur-2 with 95,860 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এ, কে, এম, ফজলুল হক মিলন গাজীপুর-৫ (কালী:
A. K. M. Fazlul Haque Milan is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-5 (Kaliganj). This BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the third time. In September 2026 he was nominated chair of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment. He is also a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Water Resources and the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

He was born in 1963. His father is Ekamuddin and his mother Sahida Khatun.

Rising through student politics, Fazlul Haque Milan served as central publicity secretary and later central president of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He was an active organiser in the anti-autocracy movement of 1990. He later served as central general secretary of the Swechchhasebak Dal, general secretary and president of the Gazipur District BNP, a member of the BNP's National Executive Committee and central organising secretary (Dhaka Division).

He had previously been elected MP twice from what was then Gazipur-3 (now Gazipur-5, Kaliganj), one of these being the 2001 parliamentary election.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-5 with 133,869 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এ, কে, এম, সেলিম রেজা হাবিব ত্রয়োদশ জাত:
A. K. M. Selim Reza Habib is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Pabna-2 (Sujanagar upazila and part of Bera upazila). Elected as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he is serving his third term as an MP.

He was born on 15 March 1957 in Malifa village of Sujanagar upazila, Pabna district. His father is A. K. M. Habibar Rahman and his mother Mst. Zakia Habib. He is a politician by profession.

Selim Reza Habib was first elected MP for Pabna-2 in the 6th parliamentary election of February 1996. In the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 he was given the responsibility of representing the seat for the second time.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for the third time, with 215,406 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.

To spread education in the area he founded Selim Reza Habib Degree College, Zakia Habib Agricultural College and Kashinathpur Women's College.
এ, জেড, এম, রেজওয়ানুল হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
A Z M Rezwanul Haque is the member of parliament for Dinajpur-5 (Parbatipur and Fulbari) in the 13th Parliament. Elected as an independent candidate, he has entered Parliament for the second time. He was previously elected MP from the same seat as the candidate of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) in the election to the 6th Parliament held on 15 February 1996.

Rezwanul Haque was born on 5 January 1956 in Parbatipur, Dinajpur district. His father is Abdul Jabbar and his mother Hamida Khanam. He is a businessman by profession. He joined the BNP in 1995 and for a long time contested elections as the party's candidate for Dinajpur-5. He has also served as president of the Parbatipur upazila BNP and as convener of the Dinajpur district BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP as an independent candidate, winning 114,484 votes with the lock symbol.
এ. বি. এম আশরাফ উদ্দিন (নিজান) ত্রয়োদশ:
A.B.M. Ashraf Uddin (Nizan) is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-4 (Ramgati and Kamalnagar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He represents this seat for the third time for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Since 12 September 2026 he has served as a Whip in Parliament. He is also a member of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts, the Library Committee and the Special Committee.

Freedom fighter Ashraf Uddin Nizan is a native of Ramgati in Lakshmipur. He is the son of Abdul Hadi Mia and Mosammat Zakia Khatun. He obtained a master's degree from the University of Chittagong. He is a businessman by profession.

He was elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-4 as the BNP candidate in the elections to the 8th and 9th Parliaments in 2001 and 2008. In Parliament he served as chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock. Within the party he is industry and commerce affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-4, winning 115,199 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এডভোকেট মোঃ জালাল উদ্দীন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Advocate Md. Jalal Uddin is the member of parliament for Kishoreganj-2 (Katiadi and Pakundia Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In the party he serves as convener of Pakundia Upazila BNP.

Jalal Uddin was born on 1 February 1962. His home is in Syedgaon Purbapara, Pakundia Upazila, Kishoreganj District. He is the son of Shams Uddin and Anowara Begum. He is a lawyer by profession.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 143,669 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory the seat returned to the BNP after a long 25 years. He assumed office as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.

He is married to Syeda Begum China and is the father of two daughters.
এম ইকবাল হোসেইন দুর্যোগ ব্যবস্থাপনা ও ত্:
M. Iqbal Hossain is the State Minister for Disaster Management and Relief and the member of parliament for Mymensingh-3 (Gouripur). He took office on 17 February 2026.

His home is in Tatrakanda village, Sidhla Union, Gouripur Upazila, Mymensingh. His father, Ismail Hossain Talukder, was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-2 (Phulpur-Tarakanda) in the 1979 election to the 2nd Parliament; his mother is Syeda Fatema Khatun. He studied at the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET).

Elected member of parliament for the first time, for Mymensingh-3 as the candidate of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he joined the government.
এম মঞ্জুরুল করিম রনি গাজীপুর-২ (গাজীপুর:
M Manjurul Karim Roni is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-2 (Gazipur Sadar and Tongi). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is general secretary of the Gazipur Metropolitan BNP.

Manjurul Karim was born on 12 February 1984 into a political family in Gazipur. His late father, Professor M. A. Mannan, was the first elected mayor of Gazipur City Corporation and a former State Minister for Religious Affairs and for Science and Technology. His mother is Sajeda Mannan. He entered politics carrying on his father's political legacy and ideal of public service.

The 13th parliamentary election, held on 12 February 2026, was his first parliamentary election. In it he was elected MP for Gazipur-2 with 188,606 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এম রশিদুজ্জামান মিল্লাত বেসামরিক বিমান প:
M. Rashiduzzaman Millat is the Minister of Civil Aviation and Tourism and the member of parliament (MP) for Jamalpur-1 (Dewanganj-Baksiganj). In February 2026 he took charge as State Minister of the same ministry, and six months later, on 21 August, he became a full minister. A businessman, Millat is the central treasurer of the BNP.

He was born on 14 January 1961 in the village of Kalikapur in Dewanganj municipal town, Jamalpur; his father is Nawab Ali Prodhan and his mother Rokeya Begum. He is his parents' only child. After completing his secondary education at Dewanganj Government High School, he obtained a bachelor's degree in business administration and, in 2014, a master's degree in Islamic studies from Uttara University. He has received training from the National Democratic Institute (NDI) and the Centre for Governance Studies.

He became active in politics in 1986 under the guidance of Abdus Salam Talukder. He was on the central committee of JASAS, the BNP's cultural organisation, and joined the main party in 1991. He has served as president of Dewanganj upazila BNP and as president of Jamalpur district BNP.

He was elected MP in the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001, the first time he stood. In the 2026 election he won Jamalpur-1 for the second time, with 173,656 votes.
এম, এ, মুহিত ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সিরাজ:
M. A. Muhit is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Sirajganj-6, and State Minister for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's Cabinet. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). His full name is Mohammad Abdul Muhit.

He was born in Dhaka on 5 October 1969. His father, M. A. Matin, was an ophthalmologist and politician who served as Deputy Prime Minister of Bangladesh and held several ministries, including health and home affairs. His mother, Tasmina Matin, was an obstetrician and gynaecologist and the founding principal of North Bengal Medical College in Sirajganj. His maternal grandfather, Abdullah Al Mahmud, was Pakistan's Minister of Industries and Natural Resources.

Muhit completed his MBBS at Dhaka Medical College and pursued higher studies in the United Kingdom. He obtained MSc degrees in clinical ophthalmology from the University of Bristol and in community ophthalmology from University College London. He earned a PhD in public health ophthalmology from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.

He is an ophthalmologist and public health specialist by profession. His research on eye disease and blindness in children, barriers to accessing eye care, and childhood disability and rehabilitation has been published. He is chairman and former pro-vice-chancellor of the University of South Asia, vice-chairman of North Bengal Medical College, and president of BNSB Eye Hospital in Sirajganj. He founded CSF Global (formerly the Child Sight Foundation) with the aim of connecting children with disabilities to treatment and eye care, and serves as its president.

Involved in BNP politics in Shahjadpur upazila, Muhit first became the party's candidate for Sirajganj-6 in the 2018 election. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP with 171,508 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol, and was later given the post of State Minister for Health and Family Welfare. His maternal uncle, Iqbal Hassan Mahmood, is a member of the BNP's national standing committee and Minister of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources.
এম, এ, হান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্র:
M. A. Hannan is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-1 (Nasirnagar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), and is BNP's first member of parliament from this seat. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock. He is also president of Nasirnagar upazila BNP.

Hannan was born on 1 January 1973 in Nasirnagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Md. Abdul Hekim and Sulema Khatun. He comes from a family of martyrs. His brother Abdul Kadir is a freedom fighter and the commander of the Nasirnagar upazila Muktijoddha Sangsad (freedom fighters' council). By profession he is a businessman.

A politician who rose from the grassroots, he has served as chairman of a union parishad. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 68,092 votes in Brahmanbaria-1 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এমরান আহমদ চৌধুরী সিলেট-৬ আসন থেকে নির্ব:
Emran Ahmed Chowdhury is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-6. A lawyer and politician, he is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs.

He was born on 1 November 1967 in Kotoyalpur village, Hetimganj, Lakshmipasha union, Golapganj upazila, Sylhet district. He is the son of Ziaur Rahman Chowdhury and Afia Khatun Chowdhury.

After passing the SSC from Atharia High School and the HSC from Murari Chand College, Sylhet, he obtained BSc and MSc degrees from the Department of Physics at the University of Chittagong. He later obtained an MA from the Department of Bangla at the University of Dhaka and an LLM from Sylhet International University. He completed a diploma in leadership, management, politics and international risk at the University of South Wales in the United Kingdom, and the Graduate Diploma in Law course at Nottingham Trent University.

On 10 January 2019 he joined the Sylhet District Bar Association as a lawyer. He is the editor and publisher of the Sylhet-based daily Sachitra Sylhet.

As a student he was general secretary of Sylhet district Chhatra Dal. He is currently general secretary of Sylhet district BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 108,612 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Syeda Nurunnahar and is the father of two daughters.
এরশাদ উল্লাহ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট্টগ:
Ershad Ullah is the member of parliament for Chattogram-8 (part of Boalkhali upazila and wards 3 to 7 of Chattogram City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is convener of the Chattogram metropolitan BNP. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Land.

Ershad Ullah was born in Chattogram on 21 March 1954. He is the son of Sharafat Ullah and Anwara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in BNP politics in Chattogram. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament as the BNP's nominated candidate for Chattogram-8, winning 152,969 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এস এ জিন্নাহ কবীর ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
S A Jinnah Kabir is the member of parliament for Manikganj-1 (Daulatpur, Gior and Shibaloy Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Jinnah Kabir was born in 1960 in Maniknagar village, Shibaloy Upazila, Manikganj District. He is the son of Abu Md. Momtaz Uddin and Anowara Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in the organisational work of Manikganj District BNP. He served as member secretary of the district BNP convening committee, and in March 2021 he was elected general secretary at the district BNP conference.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 137,773 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এস কে আজিজুল বারী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
SK Azizul Baree is the member of parliament (MP) for Khulna-4 in the 13th Parliament. Known in politics as Azizul Baree Helal, he has entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts. In the party he serves as information affairs secretary of the national executive committee.

He was born on 2 September 1967. He is the son of Sheikh Mokam Baree and Sahara Khatun. In 1985 he was admitted to the University of Dhaka, from which he obtained a BSc (Honours) in soil science. He also completed a professional master's in Japanese Studies at the University of Dhaka.

Helal's political career began in Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, the BNP's student organisation. In January 2003 he became central general secretary of Chhatra Dal, and in January 2005 its central president. He served as president until July 2009. He was later given the post of information affairs secretary in the BNP's central committee. He was the BNP candidate for Dhaka-18 in the 2008 election and for Khulna-4 in the 2018 election.

In the 2026 election he campaigned on a 74-point electoral pledge. It included promises to build a second bridge over the Bhairab river to make communication with Khulna, the district headquarters, easier, to complete work on the Nagarghat and Railgate bridges quickly, and to build embankments to prevent river erosion. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Khulna-4 with 123,162 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এস, এম, জাহাঙ্গীর হোসেন ঢাকা-১৮ আসন থেকে:
S. M. Jahangir Hossain is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-18. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a joint convener of the convening committee of the BNP's Dhaka Metropolitan North unit and, in Parliament, a member of the House Committee.

Jahangir Hossain was born in Dhaka on 1 January 1973. His father is A. K. M. Nuruzzaman and his mother Khairun Nesa. After his higher secondary education he enrolled at Tejgaon College.

His political career began in 1988 as a member of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He took part in the anti-autocracy movement of 1990 and that year was general secretary of the Chhatra Dal's college unit. The following year he was elected vice-president of the Tejgaon College students' union. In 1994 he became social welfare secretary of the Chhatra Dal, and in 2001 president of the Chhatra Dal's Dhaka Metropolitan North unit. He later joined the Jubo Dal and served as general secretary of the Dhaka Metropolitan North Jubo Dal in 2010, and as the Jubo Dal's central publicity secretary and central vice-president.

He was the BNP candidate for Dhaka-18 in the 2018 parliamentary election and in the 2020 by-election. During the 2024 quota reform movement he stood by the students and was involved in the movement in the Uttara area.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-18 with 144,715 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Razia Sultana; the couple have two daughters.
এস, এম, জিলানী গোপালগঞ্জ-৩ (টুঙ্গিপাড়া:
S. M. Zilany is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Gopalganj-3 (Tungipara and Kotalipara). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament.

S. M. Zilany was born on 2 June 1969 in Tungipara Upazila, Gopalganj District. His father is Sheikh Abdur Rashid and his mother Mst. Nurun Nahar.

In party politics he is president of Jatiyatabadi Swechchhasebak Dal, an associate organisation of the BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 60,991 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In this election the sheaf of paddy candidates won all three seats in Gopalganj District.
এস, এম, ফয়সল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে হবিগ:
S.M. Faisal is the member of parliament for Habiganj-4 (Chunarughat and Madhabpur upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), the politician has come to Parliament for the second time. His full name is Syed Mohammad Faisal, but he is better known as S.M. Faisal.

Faisal was born on 1 January 1942 in Madhabpur upazila, Habiganj district. His father, Syed Sayeed Uddin Ahmad, was a member of the provincial assembly (MPA), and his mother is Begum Hamida Banu. He obtained MA and LLB degrees from the University of Dhaka. By profession he is an industrialist. He serves as chairman of Saiham Cotton Mills Limited and managing director of Saiham Textile Mills Limited, both of the Saiham Group.

In politics, Faisal has long been involved with BNP in Habiganj. He has served as president of Habiganj district BNP. In the 6th parliamentary election held on 15 February 1996, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Habiganj-4 seat. In the 2018 election, on a party decision, he gave up the seat to an alliance partner's candidate.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, winning 188,072 votes in Habiganj-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
ওবায়দুল্লাহ সালাফী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Obaidullah Salafi is the member of parliament for Nilphamari-3 (Jaldhaka) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology. Within the party he is a member of the working council of the Nilphamari district Jamaat-e-Islami, and he is known as Maulana Obaidullah Salafi.

Salafi was born on 1 April 1972. His father is Riaz Uddin and his mother Maleka Begum. He is a businessman by profession. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Nilphamari-3 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 109,686 votes.
কলিম উদ্দিন আহমেদ সুনামগঞ্জ-৫ আসন থেকে ন:
Kalim Uddin Ahmed is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-5. Known as Kalim Uddin Ahmed Milon, this experienced politician is representing his seat in Parliament for the fourth time. In the 13th Parliament he serves as chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Kalim Uddin Ahmed was born in 1958 in Bagbari, Chhatak Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Habib Ulla and his mother Hasna Begum.

He has been active in politics since his student days. He was initially involved in the politics of the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal (JSD). He was first elected MP from Sunamganj-5 as the JSD candidate in the election to the 4th Parliament in 1988. He was elected for the second time, as an independent candidate, in the election to the 6th Parliament on 15 February 1996.

In 1996 he joined the BNP and served as organising secretary, general secretary and convener of the Sunamganj District BNP. He was elected MP for the third time, on the BNP's nomination, in the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001. In 2017 he was elected president of the Sunamganj District BNP. He has also served as an assistant organising secretary of the central BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the fourth time, with 151,915 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
কাজী রফিকুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Kazi Rafiqul Islam is the member of parliament for Bogura-1, which consists of Sariakandi and Sonatala upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he is representing this seat in Parliament for the second time. In the current Parliament he is a member of the standing committees on the Ministry of Industries and the Ministry of Planning.

He was born on 12 January 1956 in Sariakandi upazila, Bogura district. His father's name is Kazi Efaz Uddin and his mother's Mst. Rahima Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

Kazi Rafiqul Islam is a member of the BNP's national executive committee. He was first elected MP from Bogura-1 on a BNP nomination in the 2001 election to the 8th Parliament. He was also the party's candidate for the same seat in the 2018 election.

The BNP declared him its candidate for Bogura-1 well before the election to the 13th Parliament. After his nomination he campaigned in the area through public outreach, meetings and rallies, and courtyard meetings. In the election of 12 February 2026 he was elected by a wide margin with 171,440 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Md. Shahabuddin, received 57,959 votes.
কাজী শাহ মোফাজ্জাল হোসাইন কায়কোবাদ ধর্ম:
Kazi Shah Mofazzal Houssain Kaikobad is the Minister for Religious Affairs and the member of parliament for Cumilla-3 (Muradnagar). He was appointed Minister for Religious Affairs on 17 February 2026. He has been elected a member of parliament from this seat six times, and has previously served twice as State Minister for Religious Affairs.

He was born on 20 February 1956 in Muradnagar, Cumilla; his father is Kazi Noman Ahmed.

He first became a member of parliament in the 3rd parliamentary election in 1986, on a Jatiya Party nomination, and for the second time in 1988. He was State Minister for Religious Affairs from 2 May to 6 December 1990. He won again for the Jatiya Party in the June 1996 election. He later joined BNP, became a member of parliament on the party's nomination in 2001, and again served as State Minister for Religious Affairs from 3 August 2002 to 1 July 2003. He was elected in 2008 as well. In 2016 he became a vice-chairman of BNP.

In 2018 he was sentenced to life imprisonment in the case over the grenade attack of 21 August 2004; he had been abroad since 2014. On 1 December 2024 the High Court acquitted him and all the other accused in the case. Having returned home after the July mass uprising, he won the Cumilla-3 seat for the sixth time in the 2026 election.
কামরুজ্জামান কামরুল সুনামগঞ্জ-১ (তাহিরপু:
Kamruzzaman Kamrul is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-1 (Tahirpur, Jamalganj, Madhyanagar and Dharmapasha). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament.

Kamruzzaman Kamrul was born on 7 January 1978 in Tahirpur Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Niam Uddin and his mother Jahanara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

He has experience in local politics and as an elected representative. He is a former chairman of the Tahirpur Upazila Parishad and a former organising secretary of the Sunamganj District BNP. On the instructions of the party's central leadership he became the BNP candidate for Sunamganj-1.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 161,774 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
খন্দকার আবদুল মুক্তাদীর শিল্প, বাণিজ্য এ:
Khandakar Abdul Muktadir is Minister for Industries, for Commerce and for Textiles and Jute, and MP for Sylhet-1. He took charge of these three ministries on 17 February 2026. An industrialist and former president of the Sylhet Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Muktadir has been an adviser to the BNP chairperson since 2016.

He was born on 25 September 1969 in Ahmadpur village, Tetli Union, Dakshin Surma Upazila, Sylhet. His father, Khandakar Abdul Malik, was a BNP politician and MP for what were then the Sylhet-8 and Sylhet-1 seats. He passed his SSC from Sylhet Cadet College and his HSC from Dhaka City College, then obtained an MSS in political science from the National University and an MBA in business administration from North South University.

He entered active politics by joining the BNP in 2011. He was the party's candidate for Sylhet-1 in the 2018 election. Elected MP for the first time from the same seat in the 13th parliamentary election of 2026, he was given charge of the country's industry and commerce sectors in the cabinet.

His wife is Zakia Yasmin; they have a son and a daughter.
খায়রুল কবির খোকন নরসিংদী-১ আসন থেকে নির:
