She is also secretary of the Bangladesh National Women Lawyers' Association, vice-president of the Bangladesh Law Association and a life member of the Dhaka University Alumni Association.

Fahima Nasrin was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. According to a report in The Daily Star, although her political area is Munshiganj-3, the party has given her organisational responsibility for the Jhenaidah-3 and Jhenaidah-4 constituencies.
ফেরদৌসী আহমেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Ferdousy Ahmed is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-23 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a joint convener of the Dhaka Metropolitan North BNP.

Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti was born on 15 January 1974. She is the daughter of Haji Md. Nizamuddin Ahmed and Haji Mst. Hosne Ara Ahmed. She obtained a bachelor's degree from Begum Badrunnesa Government Women's College. She is a businesswoman by profession.

During her college years she was an active worker of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal and was elected AGS (assistant general secretary) of the college students' union. Her brother, the late Nasir Uddin Ahmed Pintu, was a BNP leader. Her husband, Saidur Rahman Newton, was the councillor for ward 8 of Dhaka North City Corporation. After her husband's death Ferdousy Ahmed was herself elected councillor and carried out development work in the area. She is active in politics in the Mirpur area.

Ferdousy Ahmed is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-23 through the votes of the members of parliament.
ববি হাজ্জাজ প্রাথমিক ও গণশিক্ষা প্রতিমন্:
Bobby Hajjaj is State Minister for Primary and Mass Education and MP for Dhaka-13. He has held this post since 4 March 2026. An Oxford-educated researcher and columnist, he is the founding chairman of the Nationalist Democratic Movement (NDM); in the 2026 election he won as a BNP candidate.

He was born and raised in Dhaka. His father is the businessman Musa Bin Shamsher and his mother Kaniz Fatema Chowdhury. After his schooling at Maple Leaf International School, he took a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Texas at Austin in the United States. He later completed an MBA at the University of Oxford in 2006 and carried out postgraduate research in strategy there.

After graduating, he worked for a year in the financial sector in the United States before returning home. From 2003 he worked for several years as a business development and strategy consultant in America, Europe and the Middle East. From late 2009, based in Bangladesh, he was a lecturer and researcher in business strategy at North South University, and wrote regularly for The Daily Star, The Daily Independent and the Dhaka Tribune. In 2015 he launched ‘Swapner Desh’, a civic empowerment initiative involving young people.

In 2012 he became special adviser to former President H. M. Ershad. He came to public attention for his criticism of the 2014 election; in late 2013 RAB detained him for 20 hours. In April 2017 he formed the NDM party. In the 13th parliamentary election of 2026 he was elected MP for the first time, from Dhaka-13 under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Barrister Rashna Imam; they have two daughters.
বিলকিস ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Bilkis Islam is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-7 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a member of the BNP executive committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Bilkis Islam was born on 1 January 1956 in Panialpukur village, Kishoreganj upazila, Nilphamari district. She is the daughter of Khayer Uddin Ahmed and Khayetunnesa.

In the 8th Parliament she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 15. She became the member of parliament for this seat in 2005. Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-7 through the votes of the members of parliament.
বিশ্বাস জাহাঙ্গীর আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Biswas Jahangir Alam is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Narail-1. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time and is a member of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries. He is also serving as president of the Narail district BNP.

He was born on 7 April 1955 in Khasial (South) village of Pahardanga union, Naragati thana, Narail district. His mother is Nur Jahan Begum.

Alongside politics, he is an entrepreneur in the healthcare and manpower export sectors. He is the proprietor of Al-Riyadh Medical Check-up, a GCC-approved medical centre in Banani, Dhaka. He has also long run a manpower export business through Saracen Corporation, a government-licensed recruiting agency and member of BAIRA (Bangladesh Association of International Recruiting Agencies).

He has been involved in politics since his student days and is a senior BNP leader. In February 2025, at the party's biennial conference, he was elected president of the Narail district BNP by the votes of the district's councillors. As district president he is responsible for overseeing the party's grassroots activities and coordinating with the central leadership.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Narail-1 with 99,975 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
বীথিকা বিনতে হোসাইন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Bithika Benta Hossain is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-24 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament for the first time as a nominee of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Bithika Benta Hossain was born on 1 September 1980. Her father is A.K.M. Mofazzal Hossain and her mother is Ayesha Mofaz. She is a businesswoman by profession.

Her husband, Shafiul Bari Babu, was president of the Jatiyatabadi Swechchhasebak Dal. Shafiul Bari died on 28 July 2020. After her husband's death, Bithika Benta Hossain became active in politics. She was one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved seats for women in the 13th Parliament. She became the MP for reserved Women's Seat-24 through a vote of members of parliament.
বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোঃ আব্দুল ওয়ারেছ ত্রয:
Freedom fighter Md Abdul Wares is the member of parliament for Gaibandha-5, which consists of Fulchhari and Saghata upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

He was born on 31 July 1952 in the village of Mechhat in Jumarbari union of Saghata upazila, Gaibandha district. His father's name is Kazem Uddin and his mother's Rahima Begum. He is a freedom fighter on the government's official list. He is a homeopathic physician by profession.

Abdul Wares has long been involved in the politics of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. Having received the party's nomination for the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026, he was elected with 89,274 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Faruk Alam Sarkar, received 73,483 votes. After his win he described it as a victory for the ordinary people of Saghata and Fulchhari upazilas.

Taking part in the debate in Parliament on the motion of thanks on the President's address, he raised the state of healthcare in his constituency. He called for vacant posts at the Saghata and Fulchhari upazila health complexes to be filled quickly, and demanded that an agricultural university and a medical college be established in Gaibandha.
বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোঃ নাছির চৌধুরী সুনামগ:
Freedom fighter Md Nasir Chowdhury is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-2 (Derai and Sulla). The 13th Parliament is his second term.

Nasir Chowdhury was born on 2 June 1950. His father is Md. Gias Uddin Chowdhury and his mother Aftarun Nesa Khanam. Politics is his profession.

This veteran politician is a member of the BNP's central executive committee. In local government he was twice elected chairman of the upazila parishad. He was first elected MP in the election to the 7th Parliament held in June 1996. In all he has contested five parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the second time, with 99,522 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the result was announced, his nearest rival, the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Mohammad Shishir Manir, congratulated him.
বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোহাম্মদ আব্দুল মালিক স:
Freedom fighter Mohammed Abdul Malique is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-3 (Dakshin Surma, Balaganj and Fenchuganj). Known as M. A. Malik, the politician is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

Abdul Malique was born on 12 November 1957 at Tilabari in Tetli, Dakshin Surma upazila, Sylhet district. He is the son of Mohammed Konu Mia and Ariza Begum.

A long-time resident of the United Kingdom, this expatriate politician has served as general secretary and as president of UK BNP. He has also served as an adviser to the BNP chairperson and as chief adviser to the Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Byabsayi Dal (Bangladesh Nationalist Business Party).

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 114,255 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is one of three expatriate leaders who won on BNP nominations in Sylhet division.
ব্যারিষ্টার কায়সার কামাল একজন বিশিষ্ট ব: Barrister Kayser Kamal is a prominent Bangladeshi politician and a senior advocate of the Supreme Court, currently serving as Deputy Speaker of the 13th Parliament of Bangladesh. Representing Netrokona-1, he brings his extensive legal and government experience to his leadership; he previously served as State Minister for Land. He was born in 1972 in Netrokona. After obtaining bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of Dhaka, he completed his legal education in the United Kingdom, where he obtained an LLB (Honours), and in 2005 he was called to the Bar by the Honourable Society of Lincoln's Inn. Elected Deputy Speaker unanimously in March 2026, Barrister Kamal is committed to increasing inclusive participation, ensuring transparent governance and maintaining impartial leadership in the country's central democratic institution.
ব্যারিস্টার আন্দালিভ রহমান পার্থ তথ্য ও:
Barrister Andaleeve Rahman Partho is the Minister of Information and Broadcasting and the member of parliament (MP) for Bhola-1. He has been in charge of the ministry since August 2026. He has been chairman of Bangladesh Jatiya Party (BJP) since 2008, and sits in the Cabinet as an alliance partner of the BNP.

He was born on 20 April 1974 in Dhaka. His father, Naziur Rahman Manzur, was the founding chairman of Bangladesh Jatiya Party, a former minister and a former mayor of Dhaka; the family's roots lie in the zamindar family of Balia in Bhola. His mother is Sheikh Reba. After completing his schooling at St Joseph Higher Secondary School in Dhaka, he obtained a law degree (LLB) in London and completed the Bar-at-Law at Lincoln's Inn.

After returning home he worked for five years as a pupil in the legal profession under the supervision of Barrister Rafique-ul Huq. Alongside working as a lawyer in Dhaka, he is principal of the British School of Law.

He was involved in politics alongside his father for more than twenty-five years; after his father's death in April 2008 he was elected chairman of the party. In the election to the 9th Parliament that year he won Bhola-1 as the candidate of the four-party alliance, and served as chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs. Elected an MP for the second time in the 2026 election, he joined Tarique Rahman's Cabinet.
ব্যারিস্টার জহরত আদিব চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জা:
Barrister Jahrat Adib Chowdhury is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-27 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament for the first time as a nominee of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). On 13 July 2026 she was elected chair of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Jahrat Adib Chowdhury was born on 26 March 1983 in Gangkul village, Barlekha upazila, Moulvibazar district. Her father, Advocate Ebadur Rahman Chowdhury, is a four-time member of parliament, a former MP for Moulvibazar-1 and a former State Minister for Food and Disaster Management. Her mother is Sawda Ebad Chowdhury. One of four sisters, Jahrat grew up in Moulvibazar itself.

She became a Barrister-at-Law at Lincoln's Inn in the United Kingdom and obtained an LLM in commercial law from the University of Derby. She also completed a Senior Executive Leadership course at Harvard Business School and an Advanced Certificate in Business Administration at the Institute of Business Administration (IBA), University of Dhaka.

She began her career in the corporate sector. She worked in various important positions at the pharmaceutical company Novartis Bangladesh and at Grameenphone. In 2014 she joined Banglalink as Chief Legal Officer and Company Secretary, and in April 2025 she became the company's deputy chief executive officer. She is the first woman deputy CEO in the country's telecommunications sector. She is a lawyer of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and a member of the Supreme Court Bar Association and the Moulvibazar District Bar Association. She has visited more than 30 countries for her work and is associated with various social, educational and public welfare trusts.

For the reserved seats for women in the 13th Parliament, the BNP nominated her from the Moulvibazar and Habiganj area. She became the MP for reserved Women's Seat-27 through a vote of members of parliament. Her husband, Barrister Muhammad Zisan Haider, is a deputy attorney general at the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. The couple have one son.
ব্যারিস্টার মীর মোহাম্মদ হেলাল উদ্দীন (ম:
Barrister Mir Mohammed Helal Uddin (Mir Helal) is the State Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs and for Land, and the member of parliament for Chattogram-5. He became State Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs on 17 February 2026 and on 12 March was also given charge of the Ministry of Land. A Supreme Court lawyer and UK-trained barrister, he is assistant organising secretary (Chattogram division) of the BNP national executive committee.

He was born on 12 August 1982 and comes from the Mir Bari of Mirer Khil in Hathazari, Chattogram. His father, Mir Mohammed Nasir Uddin, is a former State Minister for Civil Aviation and Tourism and a former mayor of Chattogram City Corporation; his mother is Dalia Naznin Nasir. He is his parents' only son. He completed the Bar-at-Law as a member of Lincoln's Inn in the United Kingdom.

Within the party he is special assistant to the chairperson's foreign affairs advisory committee and a member of the BNP media cell. He is a director of the Ziaur Rahman Foundation and convener of the Legal Research Cell founded by Tarique Rahman.

In 2007 he was convicted, together with his father, in an Anti-Corruption Commission assets case; after a long legal process, the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court acquitted both father and son in September 2025. In the 2026 election he was elected member of parliament for the first time, winning 147,054 votes in Chattogram-5.
ব্যারিস্টার মুহাম্মদ নওশাদ জমির ত্রয়োদশ:
Barrister Muhammad Nawshad Zamir is the member of parliament for Panchagarh-1 (Panchagarh Sadar, Tentulia and Atwari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he serves as chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs. He is also a member of the Business Advisory Committee and the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions.

Nawshad Zamir was born on 3 February 1970 in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. His father, Muhammad Jamiruddin Sircar, served as Speaker of the Parliament of Bangladesh, as a minister and as President. His mother is Begum Nur Akhtar Sircar. He passed his SSC from Dhanmondi Government Boys' High School and his HSC from Dhaka College. After obtaining bachelor's and master's degrees in law from the University of Dhaka, he earned an LLM from Harvard University and a master's degree in taxation from the University of Oxford. He later completed the Bar-at-Law at Lincoln's Inn.

A lawyer by profession, Nawshad Zamir is a senior advocate of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and head of Jurists Chambers in Dhaka. His practice centres on corporate law, Islamic finance and constitutional writs. He gives legal advice to banking, insurance, telecom, IT and shipping companies. As a consultant to the Infrastructure Investment Facilitation Company (IIFC), he helped prepare the concession agreement for the New Mooring Container Terminal at Chattogram Port and the guidelines for the BTRC's cellular licence auction. His writing on international law and human rights has been published in journals and newspapers in Bangladesh and abroad.

In politics, Nawshad Zamir is the BNP's international affairs secretary and a member of the BNP Chairperson's Foreign Affairs Advisory Committee. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Panchagarh-1, winning 176,169 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
ব্যারিস্টার সাকিলা ফারজানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতী:
Barrister Shakila Farzana is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-8 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the special committee on amending the Constitution and of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs.

Her father, Syed Wahidul Alam, was the member of parliament for Chattogram-5 from 1991 to 2006 and served as a BNP Whip from 2001 to 2006. Her mother is Farida Wahid. Shakila Farzana passed the SSC from Bangladesh Mohila Samity Girls' High School in Chattogram and the HSC from Chittagong College. After obtaining LLB and LLM degrees from the University of Chittagong, she obtained a second LLB degree from the University of London and completed the Bar Vocational Course at City University, London.

A lawyer by profession, Shakila Farzana practises in the High Court Division of the Supreme Court. Early in her career she worked for two years with Barrister Rafique-ul Huq and for more than four years with Barrister Rokanuddin Mahmud. In 2008 she set up her own law firm, Law Cornerstone. She is a member of the Dhaka District Bar Association and the Supreme Court Bar Association.

In politics she has served as joint general secretary of the Supreme Court unit of the Jatiyatabadi Ainjibi Forum, the organisation of pro-BNP lawyers. In April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-8 through the votes of the members of parliament. Her husband, Md. Bahauddin, is a Chattogram-based businessman. The couple have two children.
ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল (অব.) ড. এ কে এম শা:
Brigadier General (retd) Dr. A K M Shamsul Islam is Defence Adviser to the Prime Minister, with the rank of a State Minister, in charge of the Ministry of Defence and, since 6 June 2026, of the Armed Forces Division. A retired army officer and security analyst, Shamsul Islam holds a PhD on the country's nuclear security. He is not a member of parliament.

He was born in Nandail upazila, Mymensingh. At school he came first in the district in class eight and received a talent-pool scholarship. After being placed on the board merit lists in the SSC and HSC from Cumilla Cadet College, he obtained a BSc from the University of Chittagong, coming first in the first class. He obtained master's degrees in defence studies from the Defence Services Command and Staff College, in management from Philippine Christian University (with a gold medal), in military technology from Bangladesh University of Professionals and in defence studies from Bangladesh Open University. He later received a PhD on the nuclear security of Bangladesh from Jahangirnagar University. He has received advanced military and strategic training in Bangladesh, Pakistan, the United Kingdom, China, the Philippines, Russia and the United States.

In 1989, after completing the 21st Long Course at the Bangladesh Military Academy, he was commissioned into the army, and he received the Osmani Gold Medal for academic excellence. On United Nations peacekeeping missions he served in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as staff officer to the Force Commander and as deputy contingent commander, and in Iraq as a training expert and adviser. The Awami League government of the time sent him into compulsory retirement from the rank of brigadier general.

After retirement he joined the BNP and taught as an adjunct professor at Independent University, Bangladesh. In 2025 he sought the party's nomination for the Mymensingh-9 (Nandail) seat. On 17 December 2025 he was appointed chief security officer responsible for the security of Khaleda Zia and Tarique Rahman; when Tarique Rahman became Prime Minister, he became his Defence Adviser.
মঈনুল ইসলাম খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে মা:
Moinul Islam Khan is the member of parliament for Manikganj-2 (Singair, Harirampur, and the Hatipara, Bhararia and Putail unions of Manikganj Sadar Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the second time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Engineer Moinul Islam Khan Shanto. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Finance, the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Planning and the Special Committee.

Moinul Islam Khan was born on 6 February 1954 in Manikganj District. His father, the late Shamsul Islam Khan (Naya Mia), was an industrialist and BNP politician; he was elected member of parliament for Manikganj-4 four times and served as Minister of Industries in Khaleda Zia's first cabinet. His mother is Begum Rahima Islam. Moinul Islam Khan's younger brother, Hafizul Islam Uttu, lost his life when a boat capsized while he was distributing relief in Singair Upazila during the 1988 floods.

He is an engineer and businessman by profession. In the by-election held in January 2006 following his father's death, he was elected member of parliament for Manikganj-4 as the BNP candidate and represented the seat in the 8th Parliament. In the party he has served as general secretary of Manikganj District BNP, and on 7 August 2016 he was nominated a member of the advisory council of the BNP Chairperson, Khaleda Zia.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected for Manikganj-2 as the BNP's nominated candidate with 175,776 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মনজুর এলাহী নরসিংদী-৩ (শিবপুর) আসন থেকে:
Monjur Elahi is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narsingdi-3 (Shibpur). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is general secretary of the Narsingdi District BNP and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

He was born on 1 June 1972 in Narsingdi Sadar Upazila, Narsingdi District. His father is Abed Ali Mia and his mother Momeza Begum. In December 2025 the BNP gave him its final nomination for Narsingdi-3.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narsingdi-3 with 82,061 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মমতাজ আলো ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্ষিত:
Momtaj Alo Ahmed is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-28 in the 13th Parliament. The BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) nominated her for this seat. She serves as international affairs secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Mohila Dal and as president of the Mohila Dal in France.

Momtaj Alo was born on 6 June 1974. She is the daughter of A. Gani Bepari of Purba Rakhi village, Shilai union, Munshiganj Sadar upazila. Her mother's name is Halima Khatun. According to reports citing party sources, she was nominated for the reserved seat in recognition of her long and active role in party activities abroad and at home.

Momtaj Alo was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As each of these seats, which are filled by a vote of members of parliament, had a single candidate, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মাছুম মোস্তফা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে নেত্:
Masum Mustafa is the member of parliament for Netrokona-5 (Purbadhala Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism. In the party he serves as assistant secretary of Netrokona District Jamaat.

Masum Mustafa was born on 1 January 1980 in Purbadhala Upazila, Netrokona District. He is the son of Md. Abdul Aziz and Rabia Akter. He is a teacher by profession, an assistant professor of Islamic studies at Hafez Ziaur Rahman Degree College in Purbadhala.

He entered politics through Islami Chhatra Shibir in 1994 and joined Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami in 2003. He has held posts at various levels of the party's labour organisation, the Bangladesh Sramik Federation. In 2014 he was elected vice-chairman of Purbadhala Upazila Parishad.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the eleven-party alliance candidate with 82,177 votes under the scales symbol. Speaking about his political beliefs to Prothom Alo, he said he has always believed in non-violent and non-communal politics.
মাধবী মার্মা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Madhabi Marma is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-34 in the 13th Parliament. The BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) nominated her for a reserved seat for women from the three hill districts of Bandarban, Khagrachhari and Rangamati. In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Madhabi Marma was born on 2 March 1977. Her father is Lapai Marma and her mother is Roma Marma. She is a resident of Bandarban and a lawyer by profession. She is a member of the Bandarban District Bar Association and vice-president of the Bandarban unit of the Corruption Prevention Committee. She is also serving as a member of the Bandarban Hill District Council formed in November 2024.

In BNP politics she has served as general secretary of the Bandarban district Mohila Dal. A Bangla Tribune report described her as a representative of the small ethnic communities on the BNP's list.

Madhabi Marma was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মানসুরা আক্তার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংর:
Mansura Akter is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-26 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament for the first time as a nominee of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is the youngest of the BNP's nominees for the reserved seats for women. She is a joint general secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Mansura Akter was born on 21 September 1994 in Purbadhala upazila of Netrokona district. She is also known as Mansura Alam. She was admitted to the Department of Law of the University of Dhaka in the 2012-13 academic session and completed her bachelor's degree there. While a student, she worked as the university correspondent of the daily Jaijaidin.

Chhatra Dal leader Mansura Akter was one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved seats for women in the 13th Parliament. She became the MP for reserved Women's Seat-26 through a vote of members of parliament.
মারজিয়া বেগম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Marzia Begum is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-38 in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, she is assistant secretary of the party's central women's wing and a member of its central executive council.

Also known as Marzia Foyez, she was born on 10 November 1957 in Nakla upazila of Sherpur district. Her father is Nurur Rahman and her mother is Tahamina Begum. In 1980 she married the physician Dr. Foyez Ahmed, who was naib-e-amir (deputy chief) of the Lakshmipur district Jamaat. Her husband's home is in Bancharampur, Lakshmipur Sadar upazila.

After passing her HSC, she completed a bachelor's degree in psychology at Eden Mohila College and later enrolled for a master's degree.

She has long been active in the politics of Islamic organisations. After serving as central organising and publicity secretary of Bangladesh Islami Chhatri Sangstha, she took on the post of central assistant secretary in Jamaat's women's wing.

Marzia Begum was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মারদিয়া মমতাজ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংর:
Mardia Mumtaz is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-44 in the 13th Parliament. Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami nominated her for this seat. She is known as an engineer, teacher and translator.

Engineer Mardia Mumtaz was born on 15 March 1985. Her father is the engineer B. Z. M. Momtazul Karim and her mother is Saleha Momtaz. Her ancestral home is in Brahmanbaria district.

She studied at Ideal School and College and at Viqarunnisa Noon School and College in Dhaka. She then obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in civil engineering from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). Since August 2017 she has been working as a lecturer in the Department of Civil Engineering at Daffodil International University. Before that she worked at Megacity Builders as a structural design consultant and as a structural and seismic fitness auditor. As a translator, she has translated two books, 'Al Muhaddithat' and 'Revive Your Heart', into Bangla.

From an early age she was involved with Islami Chhatri Sangstha, and until 2012 she served as president of the organisation's BUET unit. After completing her studies in 2013 she joined Jamaat-e-Islami, and in 2017 she became a rukon (full member). She has held various responsibilities in the IT and engineering department of the party's Dhaka Metropolitan unit. She is a member of Jamaat's women's wing and a central member of Nari Odhikar Andolon (Women's Rights Movement).

Mardia Mumtaz was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মাসুদ সাঈদী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে পিরোজপ:
Masood Sayedee is the member of parliament (MP) for Pirojpur-1 (Pirojpur Sadar, Nazirpur and Indurkani) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Industries. He is a businessman by profession.

Masood Sayedee was born in the village of Saidkhali in Zianagar, Pirojpur. He is the son of the Islamic preacher and politician Allama Delwar Hossain Sayeedi and Begum Saleha Sayeedi.

He has experience in local government. In the 2014 upazila parishad elections he was elected chairman of Zianagar Upazila Parishad, and held the post from 23 April 2014 to 30 April 2019. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Pirojpur-1 with 132,659 votes on the scales symbol.
মাহদী আমিন প্রতিমন্ত্রীর পদমর্যাদায় প্র:
Mahdi Amin is Adviser to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, with the rank of a State Minister, and spokesperson of the Prime Minister's Office. Since 24 February 2026 he has been responsible for the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education, the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment and the Ministry of Labour and Employment. This Cambridge-educated policy researcher is not a member of parliament.

After completing his secondary education at Dhanmondi Government Boys' High School and his higher secondary education at Dhaka College, he obtained a bachelor's degree in business administration from Middlesex University in the United Kingdom, coming first in his class. He obtained a certificate in the political economy of public policy from the London School of Economics and took part in an exchange programme at Baruch College, City University of New York. In 2010 he obtained an MPhil in modern South Asian studies from the University of Cambridge; his research, supervised by Sir Christopher Bayly, was on the integration of technology in government policymaking in South Asia. At Cambridge he has done doctoral research on the electric vehicle industry and green technology.

He is the founder and president of the think tank 'Bangladesh Policy Forum Cambridge'; the forum has affiliated chapters in the United States, Canada, Australia, Germany, Finland and Bangladesh.

He was education and research adviser to Tarique Rahman, then acting chairman of the BNP, and in 2024 he became a member of the party's foreign affairs advisory committee. As spokesperson of the BNP's central election management committee, formed ahead of the 2026 election and referendum, he gave regular press briefings from the party's election office in Gulshan.
মাহফুজা হান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সং:
Mahfuza Hannan is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-41 in the 13th Parliament. Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami nominated her for this seat. She has served as secretary of the Sylhet Metropolitan women's Jamaat.

Known as Professor Mahfuza Hannan, the educationist was born on 20 March 1959. Her father is Shah Tajammul Ali Siddiqui and her mother is Mariamunnesa Chowdhury. According to a Dinajpur TV report, after a long 31 years of teaching she is now engaged in organisational work.

Mahfuza Hannan was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. When she returned to Sylhet after taking the oath, leaders of the women's Jamaat gave her a reception at Osmani Airport. On that occasion she pledged to work to establish women's rightful rights and for the advancement of women.
মাহবুবা হাকিম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Mahabuba Hakim is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-48 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament from Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis, as a nominee of the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami. She is a member of the party's Nari Majlis (women's wing).

Engineer Mahabuba Hakim was born on 15 November 1984 in Savar, Dhaka. Her father is Abdul Hakim and her mother is Mahmuda Sultana.

She passed the SSC examination in 1999 and the HSC examination in 2001 with star marks from Savar Cantonment Public School and College. She received a government scholarship in class eight. She later completed a bachelor's degree in textile engineering at Bangladesh University of Textiles (BUTEX). As a student she earned a reputation in recitation, debating and public speaking.

In her professional career she worked at Textile Birds Group, Anlima Textile Limited and Far East Knitting and Dyeing Industries Limited. She has experience in laboratory management and quality control.

Mahabuba Hakim was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.

She is currently involved in religious education through running a hifzkhana (Quran memorisation school) and a maktab, and is active in children's education and social development work in the Paltan area of the capital. Her husband, Dr. Awlad Hossain, is a specialist in medicine and gastro-liver diseases and an assistant professor. She is the mother of two children.
মাহমুদা আলম মিতু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Mahmuda Alam Mitu is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-46 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament from the National Citizen Party (NCP), as a nominee of the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami. She is a central joint member secretary of the NCP and member secretary of Jatiya Nari Shakti, the party's women's organisation.

Dr. Mahmuda Alam Mitu was born on 10 February 1989 in Betagi, Barguna district. Her father is Mahbub Alam and her mother is Yasmin Alam. She is the elder of two siblings.

She passed her SSC from Betagi Girls' High School and her HSC from Betagi Government Degree College. She then obtained an MBBS degree from Shahabuddin Medical College in Gulshan, Dhaka. She is a physician by profession.

During the July mass uprising she helped the protesters by giving medical advice and first aid through social media and a network of doctors. For this role she received the 'July Kanya' (Daughter of July) honour. Alongside her medical profession she is active in politics and also serves as the NCP's joint chief organiser (southern region).

Mahmuda Alam Mitu was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মাহ্‌মুদা হাবীবা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Mahmuda Habiba is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-13 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is joint general secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal and a member of the BNP media cell.

Mahmuda Habiba was born on 18 March 1973. Her father, Muhammad Ayen Ud-Din, was the member of parliament for Rajshahi-4 from 1986 to 1988. Her mother is Nurmahal Khatun. She is a businesswoman by profession.

She is a member of the convening committee of the Rajshahi district BNP. Mahmuda Habiba is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-13 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মিয়া নুরুদ্দিন আহাম্মেদ অপু শরীয়তপুর-৩:
Miah Nuruddin Ahmad Apu is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Shariatpur-3 and a Whip in the 13th Parliament. This is his first term in Parliament. He also serves as a member of the House Committee, the Special Committee and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Nuruddin Apu was born on 1 October 1974 in Kodalpur Union, Gosairhat Upazila, Shariatpur District. His father is Mia Chan Mridha and his mother Amena Begum.

He has long been involved in politics. He has served as private secretary to BNP chairman Tarique Rahman. He was the BNP candidate for Shariatpur-3 in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 107,516 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The President later appointed him a Whip of Parliament.
মির্জা আব্বাস (আব্বাস উদ্দিন আহমেদ) মন্ত:
Mirza Abbas (Abbas Uddin Ahmed) is Political Adviser to the Prime Minister, with the rank of a minister, and the member of parliament for Dhaka-8. He was given this post on 24 February 2026. A former mayor of the undivided Dhaka City Corporation who served for five years as Minister of Housing and Public Works, this veteran leader is a member of the BNP National Standing Committee; he has been in the BNP since the party's founding.

He was born on 7 February 1951, the son of Abdur Razzak and Komola Khatun. He enrolled at Nazimuddin Bhuiyan Degree College in 1966 and obtained a bachelor's degree in commerce in 1971. He began his career in the family firm, Mirza Enterprise; he is a founder of Dhaka Bank and has been one of its directors since 1995. In 1980 he founded Mirza Abbas Mohila College in Shahjahanpur, Dhaka, for the education of women.

He joined the BNP when Ziaur Rahman formed the party. He was a front-line organiser in the anti-Ershad movement of the 1980s and in the mass movement of 1990. Elected member of parliament for Dhaka-6 in 1991, he was for a time State Minister for Youth and Sports; from 19 May 1991 to 28 December 1993 he was mayor of the undivided Dhaka City Corporation. After winning the February 1996 election he briefly became Minister of Land and of Housing and Public Works.

Elected again from Dhaka-6 in 2001, he was Minister of Housing and Public Works from 11 October 2001 to 27 October 2006; during his tenure, in 2006, an amendment to the Building Construction Rules was passed. He was unable to take part in the 2008 and 2014 elections, and he was defeated in Dhaka-8 in 2018. In 2026 he was elected member of parliament for the fourth time, from Dhaka-8. In 1983 he married Afroza Abbas, who is central president of Jatiyatabadi Mohila Dal; they have two sons and a daughter.
মিসেস সাজেদা সামাদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Mst. Sajeda Samad is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-42 in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, she is director of the party's women's wing for the Bogura region.

Sajeda Samad was born on 18 January 1964. Her father is S. M. Abdus Sattar and her mother is Mst. Jibon Nesa.

This Bogura leader has also held office in local government. She was woman vice-chairman of the Bogura Sadar Upazila Parishad.

Sajeda Samad was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. After she was elected an MP, a reception and a women's rally were organised for her in Bogura.
মীর আহমাদ বিনকাসেম, যিনি ব্যারিস্টার আরম:
Mir Ahmad Binquasem, also known as Barrister Arman, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-14. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Library Committee and Sub-committee No. 1 of the Library Committee.

He was born on 18 March 1984. His father is Mir Quasem Ali and his mother Khandaker Ayesha Khatun.

Mir Ahmad Binquasem obtained an LLB (Hons) degree from the University of London. He later completed the Bar Vocational Course at the Inns of Court School of Law and was enrolled as a barrister at the Bar of England and Wales. On returning home from the United Kingdom he took up the practice of law. Besides being a lawyer and politician, he is also known as a human rights activist.

At the call of Jamaat's ameer, Shafiqur Rahman, he began campaigning in Dhaka-14, and he received the party's nomination in October 2025. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 101,113 votes under the scales symbol.
মীর শাহে আলম স্থানীয় সরকার, পল্লী উন্নয:
Mir Shahe Alam is the State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives and the member of parliament for Bogura-2 (Shibganj). He was sworn in as State Minister on 17 February 2026. A leader who rose from the grassroots, he has been chairman of a union parishad and of an upazila parishad; he is a vice-president of the Bogura district BNP and a businessman.

He was born on 7 August 1970 in the village of Betgari in Atmul union of Shibganj upazila, Bogura; his father is Mir Mozaffar Rahman and his mother Mst. Rajena Begum. He passed his SSC from Shibganj Pilot High School and his HSC from Shibganj M. H. College.

He entered politics through the Chhatra Dal in 1989; in 1991 he became general secretary of the Shibganj upazila Chhatra Dal, and in 1992 joint secretary of the district Chhatra Dal. In 1997, at only 23, he was elected chairman of Atmul union parishad, at the time the youngest UP chairman in the country. In 2009 he became chairman of the Shibganj upazila parishad. In the party he has been convener of the Shibganj municipal BNP (2002), general secretary of the upazila BNP and organising secretary of the district BNP (2010), president of the upazila BNP (2013), and, since 2022, vice-president of the district BNP.

After 2008 several political cases were filed against him, and in 2023 he was imprisoned. In the 2026 election, when the nomination of the alliance candidate for Bogura-2, Mahmudur Rahman Manna, was cancelled, the BNP made him its candidate; he was elected MP for the first time with 145,024 votes. Outside politics he was chairman of Rupshi BD Group and a director of the Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC).
মুঃ মিজানুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Mizanur Rahman is the member of parliament for Chapai Nawabganj-2, which consists of Bholahat, Gomostapur and Nachol upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is also known as an educationist.

He was born on 10 February 1976 in Rohanpur, Gomostapur upazila, Chapai Nawabganj district. His father's name is Md. Lobjan Biswas and his mother's Mst. Begum Bahar.

He passed his secondary examination in the science group from Rohanpur A. B. Government High School and his higher secondary examination from Nawabganj Government College. He then obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in botany from the University of Rajshahi, and a PhD from the same university's Institute of Environmental Science. He joined Rohanpur P. M. Ideal College as a lecturer in biology in 2001 and taught for a long time. In 2023 he was selected as the best class teacher at college level in Gomostapur upazila.

Alongside teaching, he was active in the politics of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami at the local level. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 171,227 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Aminul Islam, received 155,119 votes.
মুন্সী রফিকুল আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Munshi Rafiqul Alam is the member of parliament for Feni-1 (Parshuram, Chhagalnaiya and Fulgazi upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In political circles he is known as Rafiqul Alam Majnu. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

Rafiqul Alam was born on 1 March 1972 in Izzatpur village, Feni Sadar upazila. He is the son of Munshi Golam Mostafa and Rezia Begum. He holds a master's degree in management. By profession he is a businessman and the owner of several businesses.

In politics he has served as president of Jubo Dal and is currently convener of Dhaka Metropolitan South BNP. He has also served as the party's organisational coordinator for the Feni-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 119,904 votes in Feni-1 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মুফতি মুহাম্মদুল্লাহ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mufti Mohammad Ullah is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-2 (Phulpur and Tarakanda) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Land. He is an Islamic scholar.

Mohammad Ullah was born on 1 January 1979. He is the son of Maulana Abdul Quddus and Anowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-2 as the candidate of Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis, backed by the 11-party alliance, with 146,202 votes under the rickshaw symbol. As a member of parliament he has called for maktab education to be introduced in every mosque.
মুশফিকুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্র:
Mushfiqur Rahman is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-4 (Akhaura and Kasba upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the second time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

Mushfiqur Rahman was born on 8 January 1940 in the western para (neighbourhood) of Chhatura Sharif village, Akhaura upazila, Brahmanbaria. He is the son of Md. Muniruzzaman and Hamidunnesa.

In his career he was an officer in the administration cadre of the Pakistan civil service (CSS). Over a long administrative career he served as assistant commissioner, deputy secretary, joint secretary, additional secretary and secretary. He later became an alternate executive director of the World Bank. He is also one of the founders of the private television channel Desh TV.

Entering politics after his retirement, he served as an adviser to Brahmanbaria district BNP and as an adviser to the BNP chairperson. In the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Brahmanbaria-4 seat. In the 8th Parliament too he was chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, winning 139,842 votes in Brahmanbaria-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মুস্তাফিজুর রহমান ভূঁইয়া, যিনি মোস্তাফি:
Mustafizur Rahman Bhuiyan, known as Mostafizur Rahman Bhuiyan Dipu, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-1. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

He was born on 2 April 1976 into the Bhuiyan family of Rupganj. His grandfather, Golbaksh Bhuiyan, was one of the leading businessmen of what was then East Pakistan. His father, Majibur Rahman Bhuiyan, was the proprietor of the Gausia Group and chairman of the Rupganj Upazila Parishad. His mother is Shamsun Nahar.

Dipu, who holds an MBA from North South University, is an industrialist by profession and a director of Gausia Corporation. In 2025 he was elected president of the Narayanganj Chamber of Commerce and Industry and chairman of the board of directors of Bangladesh Real Estate Club Limited for the 2025–2026 term.

In politics he is a member of the BNP's executive committee. In 2025 he became senior joint convener of the Narayanganj District BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-1 with 158,358 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মুহাম্মাদ আজীজুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Muhammad Azizur Rahman is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jashore-1 (Sharsha upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is known as Maulana Azizur Rahman and is a member of the central working council of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 1 May 1951 in South Bagachra village of Bagachra union, Sharsha upazila, Jashore district. His father is Idris Ali and his mother Rabia Khatun.

In his working life he taught at Bagachra United Secondary School.

In a long political career Azizur Rahman has served as amir of the Jashore district Jamaat-e-Islami. He was also the party's candidate for Jashore-1 in the 2008 election.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jashore-1 with 119,093 votes under the scales symbol.
মুহাম্মাদ আব্দুল খালেক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Muhammad Abdul Khaleq is the member of parliament (MP) for Satkhira-2 (Sadar and Debhata) in the 13th Parliament. Known as Muhaddis Abdul Khaleq, this Islamic scholar entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs and a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central working council (Karmaparishad).

He was born on 1 March 1963. His ancestral home is in the village of Dhalbaria in Agardari Union, Satkhira Sadar upazila. He is the son of Aftab Uddin and Shahar Banu. In his working life he was head muhaddis of Agardari Aminia Kamil Madrasa in Satkhira.

In his organisational career he has served as amir of the Satkhira district unit of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and as director of the Khulna region. As a member of the party's central working council, he has also served as organising secretary.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Satkhira-2 with 266,959 votes on the scales symbol. In this election, Jamaat-e-Islami candidates won all four seats in Satkhira.
মুহাম্মাদ আলী আছগার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Muhammad Ali Asgar is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Pabna-3 (Chatmohar, Bhangura and Faridpur). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In his area he is known as Professor Maulana Ali Asgar.

He was born on 1 March 1966 in Bhangura upazila of Pabna district. His father is Md. Elahi Box Pramanik and his mother Mst. Fatima Khatun.

In the party, Ali Asgar is assistant tarbiyat (training) secretary of the Pabna district Jamaat-e-Islami. He previously served as amir of the Bhangura upazila Jamaat-e-Islami.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Pabna-3 with 147,475 votes under the scales symbol. After his victory he pledged to build a Pabna-3 founded on justice, taking everyone along with him.
মোঃ অলি উল্লাহ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে বরগ:
Md. Oli Ullah is the member of parliament (MP) for Barguna-1 (Sadar, Amtali and Taltali) in the 13th Parliament. Known as Maulana Mahmudul Hossain Oliullah, this Islamic scholar entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of Islami Andolan Bangladesh. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee, the special committee on amending the Constitution, and the standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

He was born on 1 February 1983 in Barguna district. His father, the late Maulana Abdur Rashid, was an Islamic scholar and pir; his mother is Momtaz Begum. Oliullah is himself an Islamic scholar and is known as the Pir of Keorabunia. By profession he is engaged in business.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Barguna-1 with 140,291 votes on the hand fan symbol. According to a report in Ittefaq, with this victory Islami Andolan Bangladesh gained representation in Parliament for the first time.
মোঃ আখতারুজ্জামান মিয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md Akhtaruzzaman Mia is the member of parliament for Dinajpur-4 (Khansama and Chirirbandar) in the 13th Parliament and a Whip in Parliament. This is his second term from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was previously elected MP from the same seat in the 2001 election to the 8th Parliament, as a candidate of the four-party alliance.

Akhtaruzzaman Mia was born on 12 February 1957 in Dinajpur district. His father is Habibar Rahman Mia and his mother Ahamuda Rahman. He obtained honours and master's degrees in accounting and information systems from the University of Rajshahi (1978-79 academic session). He is a businessman by profession.

He was also the BNP's candidate for Dinajpur-4 in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for the second time, winning 166,717 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He was later given the post of government Whip in Parliament.
মোঃ আতাউর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে নড:
Md. Ataur Rahman is the member of parliament (MP) for Narail-2 in the 13th Parliament. Known as Ataur Rahman Bachchu, he entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central Majlis-e-Shura and amir of its Narail district unit.

He was born on 15 October 1980 in the village of Komkhali in Habokhali Union, Narail district. He is the son of Md. Abdul Kasem Molla and Mst. Kulsum Begum.

After completing his secondary and higher secondary education at local institutions, he obtained bachelor's and master's degrees from Government Brajalal University College in Khulna. He later obtained an LLB degree from Dhanmondi Central Law College in Dhaka. By profession he is a businessman and entrepreneur.

In 1994 he joined Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir. As a student he served as president of its Government Brajalal College unit and of its Khulna metropolitan unit. He later joined Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and took on the posts of Narail district amir and member of the central Majlis-e-Shura.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narail-2 with 118,142 votes on the scales symbol. A report by Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS) described the win as a notable success for Jamaat-e-Islami in Khulna division. In his personal life, he is the father of three daughters.
মোঃ আনোয়ারুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Md Anwarul Islam is the member of parliament for Kurigram-1 (Bhurungamari and Nageshwari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

Anwarul Islam was born on 1 March 1970 in Bhurungamari upazila, Kurigram district. His father is Momtaz Uddin and his mother Mst. Anowara Begum. He holds an MSS degree in economics. He is a teacher by profession and is known as an assistant professor.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kurigram-1, winning 141,090 votes with the scales symbol.

Md Anwar-ul-Islam is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Natore-3 (Singra upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). Locally he is known as Principal Anwar-ul-Islam Anu.

He was born on 30 December 1964 in Singra upazila of Natore district. His father is Asmatullah Pramanik and his mother Mst. Mofejan Khatun.

Anwar-ul-Islam became involved in politics as a student. He served as joint general secretary of the University of Rajshahi unit of Chhatra Dal. He later served as acting convener of the Singra upazila BNP and became a member of the Natore district BNP convening committee.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Natore-3 with 119,768 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আফজাল হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md. Afjal Hossain is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Kushtia-4 (Kumarkhali and Khoksa). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 12 August 1977. His father is Ahsan Ali Biswas and his mother Mst. Maleka Begum. He lives at Elangi in Kumarkhali. He is a businessman by profession.

Afjal Hossain was educated in the madrasa system. He passed the Dakhil at Maniknagar D. S. Aminia Alim Madrasa in Mujibnagar and the Alim at Lauri Kamil Madrasa in Jashore. He then completed the Fazil at Badarganj Kamil Madrasa in Chuadanga and the Kamil at Kuwatul Islam Kamil Madrasa in Kushtia.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kushtia-4 with 148,201 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আবদুল মান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Abdul Mannan is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-5 (Nabinagar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Abdul Mannan was born on 1 July 1959 in Nabinagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Jinnat Ali Bhuiyan and Mst. Ayesha Khatun. By profession he is a lawyer.

In politics he has served as president of Nabinagar upazila BNP and also as convener of Brahmanbaria district BNP. In November 2025 the party nominated him as its candidate for the Brahmanbaria-5 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 85,769 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this, a BNP party candidate was elected member of parliament from the Nabinagar seat for the first time in nearly 30 years.
মোঃ আবদুল হান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Abdul Hannan is the independent member of parliament for Chandpur-4 (Faridganj upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time and is known locally as M. A. Hannan. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

Abdul Hannan was born on 27 July 1962 in Faridganj upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Ashek Ali and Angkurer Nesa. By profession he is a businessman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Chandpur-4 as an independent candidate, winning 74,175 votes with the prawn symbol.
মোঃ আবদুস সালাম পিন্টু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Md. Abdus Salam Pintu is the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-2 (Gopalpur and Bhuapur) in the 13th Parliament. This is his fourth term, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He has previously served as Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Education and in the Ministry of Industries. He was born on 1 July 1952. He is the son of Mohiuddin Mia and Mst. Salema Khatun. He is a lawyer by profession.

Abdus Salam Pintu is the founding general secretary of Tangail district BNP. He was elected MP for Tangail-2 in the elections to the 5th Parliament in 1991, the 6th Parliament on 15 February 1996 and the 8th Parliament in 2001. From 2001 to 2003 he was Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Education, and from 2003 to 2006 Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Industries. In 2016 he was appointed a vice-chairman of the BNP's national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Tangail-2 for the fourth time with 198,213 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবু ওয়াহাব আকন্দ ওয়াহিদ ত্রয়োদশ জ:
Md. Abu Wahab Akanda Wahid is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-4 (Mymensingh City Corporation and Mymensingh Sadar Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was born on 9 May 1963 in Mymensingh. He is the son of Abdul Motaleb Akanda and Joynab Nessa. He is a businessman by profession.

Wahab Akanda Wahid has served as senior joint convener of Mymensingh Metropolitan BNP. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-4 with 179,688 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবু তালিব ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ঝিনা:
Md. Abu Taleb is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jhenaidah-4 (Kaliganj upazila, and the Naldanga, Ghorashal, Fursundi and Maharajpur unions of Jhenaidah Sadar upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

He was born on 1 March 1969 in Kaliganj, Jhenaidah district. His father is Abul Kashim and his mother Mojirannesa. He is a teacher by profession and is known in his area as Maulana Abu Taleb.

In the party he has served as amir of the Kaliganj upazila Jamaat-e-Islami. At a meeting with journalists before the election he set out his plans to solve the problems of the Mobarakganj sugar mill, improve local healthcare and end waterlogging.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jhenaidah-4 with 105,999 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আবু তালেব মন্ডল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Md. Abu Taleb Mondol is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Pabna-4 (Ishwardi and Atgharia). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is an educationist and politician, and is known as Professor Abu Taleb Mondol.

He was born on 25 November 1958 in Bhelupara village of Ishwardi upazila, Pabna district. His father is Achhir Uddin Mondol and his mother Tarifun Nesa.

Abu Taleb Mondol obtained honours and master's degrees in Islamic History and Culture from the University of Rajshahi. At the start of his career he was principal of Jagir Hossain Academy. He later joined Pabna Islamia College as a founding teacher. He is a retired teacher.

In his organisational life he served as secretary of the Pabna district Jamaat for 28 years. He is currently a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central Shura and working council.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Pabna-4 with 137,675 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আবু সাইদ চাঁদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Abu Sayed Chad is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Rajshahi-6, a seat made up of Charghat and Bagha upazilas. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 2 January 1957 in Charghat upazila of Rajshahi district. His father's name is Md. Sattar Pramanik and his mother's name is Mst. Ashrafunnesa.

Abu Sayed Chad has long been involved in BNP politics in the Rajshahi region. He was president of the Charghat upazila BNP for many years. Up to the time of the election he had been serving as convener of the Rajshahi district BNP for about seven years, and he has long been a member of the BNP's national executive committee. As district convener he played an active role in organising the party and strengthening its organisational activities.

In the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026 he was elected by a wide margin, winning 148,672 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Principal Md. Nazmul Haque, received 92,965 votes.
মোঃ আবুল কালাম আজাদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Md. Abul Kalam Azad is the member of parliament (MP) for Khulna-6 (Koyra and Paikgachha) in the 13th Parliament. Known as Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, he is a member of the central working council (Karmaparishad) of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. Having entered Parliament for the first time, he serves as a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

He was born on 4 November 1966 in Koyra upazila, Khulna district. He is the son of Akkas Ali Laskar and Chhatufa Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Khulna-6 with 150,724 votes on the scales symbol.
মোঃ আবুল কালাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুম:
Md Abul Kalam is the member of parliament for Cumilla-9 (Laksam and Monohorgonj upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Industries and a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Abul Kalam was born on 31 December 1961. He is the son of Alhaj Wali Ullah Mia and Alhaj Arusa Khatun. By profession he is a businessman.

In politics he is industrial affairs secretary of BNP's national executive committee. According to his own website, he has been involved in public service for more than 25 years and is giving priority to education, healthcare, infrastructure development and creating opportunities for young people in his constituency.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 170,008 votes in Cumilla-9 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবুল খায়ের ভূঁইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md Abul Khair Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-2 (Raipur upazila and part of Lakshmipur Sadar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. This experienced politician of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected a member of parliament from this seat for the fourth time. He is an adviser to the BNP chairperson. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology and of the committee on private members' bills and private members' resolutions.

Khair Bhuiyan is the son of Mazharul Islam Bhuiyan and Rezia Begum. By profession he is a businessman. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected from Laxmipur-2 as the BNP candidate, winning 146,321 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবুল হাসনাত ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md. Abul Hasnat is the member of parliament for Cumilla-4 (Debidwar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is better known as Hasnat Abdullah. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance and of two other parliamentary committees.

Hasnat was born on 13 September 1998 in Debidwar, Cumilla. He is the son of Md. Jalal Uddin and Jahanara Yasmin. After passing the secondary examination in the science stream in 2014 from Debidwar Government Reaz Uddin Pilot Model High School and the higher secondary examination from Paruara Abdul Matin Khasru College, he was admitted to the Department of English at the University of Dhaka.

As a student leader he was one of the coordinators of the 2024 quota reform movement and later served as convener of the Students Against Discrimination movement. In the National Citizen Party, formed after the July mass uprising, he was given the post of chief organiser for the southern region.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament as the NCP candidate, winning 166,583 votes in Cumilla-4.
মোঃ আব্দুল আজিজ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে না:
Md. Abdul Aziz is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Natore-4 (Gurudaspur and Baraigram upazilas). He is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 26 June 1959 in Gurudaspur upazila of Natore district. His father is Tajem Uddin Prang and his mother Abeda Khatun.

Abdul Aziz has long experience in local government. He was elected union parishad chairman four times and also served as chairman of the Gurudaspur upazila parishad. In the party he is joint convener of the Natore district BNP convening committee. During the election campaign he pledged quality education, infrastructure development and the introduction of family cards and agriculture cards for marginalised people.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Natore-4 with 170,551 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আব্দুল আলীম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে বা:
Md. Abdul Aleem is the member of parliament (MP) for Bagerhat-4 (Morrelganj and Sarankhola) in the 13th Parliament. A leader of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, he has entered Parliament for the first time and serves as a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

He was born on 1 July 1966 in Morrelganj upazila, Bagerhat district. He is the son of Tafsir Uddin Ahammad and Fatema Begum. A teacher by profession, he is known locally as Principal Abdul Aleem.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Bagerhat-4 with 116,067 votes on the scales symbol, as the candidate of the 11-party alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami.
মোঃ আব্দুল করিম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে গা:
Md Abdul Karim is the member of parliament for Gaibandha-2, which consists of Gaibandha Sadar upazila, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He also serves as ameer of Jamaat-e-Islami's Gaibandha district unit.

He was born on 6 July 1960. His father's name is Nazib Uddin and his mother's Jarina Khatun. He is a retired teacher by profession.

Besides his organisational duties as district ameer, Abdul Karim has also served as chairman of the Gaibandha Sadar upazila parishad. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 122,630 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Anisuzzaman Khan Babu, received 92,890 votes.

After his election, on 22 February 2026, following the Fajr prayer, he took up a broom with his own hands and, together with party leaders and activists, began a cleanliness drive in Gaibandha town. He said that this programme, undertaken ahead of Ramadan, would be carried out in turn across the town's nine wards. In his words, cleanliness is not just a programme but part of social awareness.
মোঃ আব্দুল গফুর ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md. Abdul Gafur is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Kushtia-2 (Bheramara and Mirpur). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 1 December 1955. His father is Abdur Rahman and his mother Rizia Khatun. He lives at Chauduar in Amla union of Mirpur upazila. He is a businessman by profession.

Rising from the grassroots, Abdul Gafur began his political journey as a union parishad member. He was elected union parishad member twice and union parishad chairman three times. He was later elected chairman of the Mirpur upazila parishad in 2009 and 2013, serving from February 2009 to 30 January 2013 and from 13 May 2013 to 4 February 2014. He told Bangla Tribune that there had been no break in his political journey since 2003.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kushtia-2 with 192,083 votes under the scales symbol. As an MP he has said he will give priority to the infrastructure of the area's schools and colleges, to healthcare in Mirpur and Bheramara, and to the problem of erosion by the Padma river.
মোঃ আব্দুল বাতেন, যিনি কর্নেল আব্দুল বাত:
Md Abdul Baten, known as Colonel Abdul Baten (retd), is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-16. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Special Committee.

He was born in 1953. His father is Sharif Uddin and his mother Shakila Begum. After his primary schooling at Notabari High School, he completed his secondary education at Pirgacha Gyanendra Narayan Government Model High School and his higher secondary education in 1970 at Carmichael College, Rangpur. In 1976 he obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in Bangla from the University of Rajshahi.

His career began as a teacher at BAF Shaheen College Kurmitola. He later joined the Bangladesh Army as an education officer, served as an instructor at the Bangladesh Military Academy and worked for a year on a United Nations mission for the army. In 1999 he became principal of Chattogram Cantonment Public College; he was later principal of Cantonment Public School and College, Rangpur, and finally principal of Shaheed Bir Uttom Lt. Anwar Girls' College, after which he retired in 2007. A retired army officer and educationist, Abdul Baten is also known as a writer, translator and businessman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-16 with 88,828 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আব্দুল বারী জনপ্রশাসন এবং খাদ্য মন্ত:
Md Abdul Bari is the State Minister for Public Administration and for Food, and the member of parliament for Jaipurhat-2. A former bureaucrat with long administrative experience, he was Deputy Commissioner of Dhaka and Divisional Commissioner of Dhaka division.

He was born on 1 February 1955 in the village of Balishibsamudra in Matrai union of Kalai upazila, Joypurhat. His father, Zafer Ali Mondal, was a mosque imam and a member of the union board in the British period; his mother is Misirunnesa Begum. He received his higher education at the University of Rajshahi.

After joining the administration cadre of the Bangladesh Civil Service, he began his work in field administration as an assistant commissioner and upazila nirbahi officer. He later became additional deputy commissioner, Deputy Commissioner of Dhaka and Divisional Commissioner of Dhaka division. He also served as director (administration) in the Prime Minister's Office and as executive director of the National Nutrition Programme. From 2007 until his retirement in 2015 he was kept as an officer on special duty (OSD).

After retiring he joined the BNP. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was elected MP for the first time, from Jaipurhat-2, with 158,065 votes, and, with his administrative experience, was given charge of the Ministry of Public Administration.
মোঃ আব্দুল মহিত তালুকদার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md. Abdul Mohit Talukder is the member of parliament for Bogura-3, which consists of Adamdighi and Dhupchanchia upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 31 October 1958. His father is Haji Abdul Mazid Talukder and his mother Mst. Rabeya Mazid. He comes from a political family. His father, Abdul Mazid Talukder, and his brother, Abdul Momin Talukder, were also elected MP from Bogura-3.

Professionally, Mohit Talukder is an entrepreneur in the fisheries sector. He is the proprietor of G M Aqua Culture Limited. For his contribution to the production of pangas, tilapia and koi fish, he received a gold medal in the National Fisheries Award 2026. He received the award from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman at the central inaugural ceremony of National Fisheries Week on 16 August 2026.
