In party politics he is involved with the Bogura district BNP. In the full committee of the Bogura district BNP approved in September 2023 he was made a vice-president. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026, after a close contest, he was elected with 127,406 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Nur Mohammad, received 111,026 votes.
মোঃ আব্দুল্লাহ্ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে মু:
Md. Abdullah is the member of parliament for Munshiganj-1 (Sreenagar and Sirajdikhan Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Sheikh Mohammad Abdullah. He was born on 27 February 1962. He is the son of the late Alhaj Md. Muslim Mia and Mosammat Karimun Nesa. He is a businessman by profession.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected by a large margin as the BNP's nominated candidate, with 167,562 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আব্দুস সাত্তার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Abdus Sattar is the member of parliament for Nilphamari-1 (Domar and Dimla) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He currently serves as ameer of the Nilphamari district Jamaat-e-Islami.

Abdus Sattar was born on 1 January 1972 in Dimla upazila, Nilphamari district. His father is Sohir Uddin and his mother Olijun Nesa. He is a teacher by profession. In the local media he is known as Principal Maulana Abdus Sattar.

Jamaat-e-Islami nominated him as its candidate for Nilphamari-1 in the election to the 13th Parliament. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP with 150,824 votes.
মোঃ আব্দুস সালাম (ডা. আব্দুস সালাম) ত্রয:
Md. Abdus Salam (Dr Abdus Salam) is the member of parliament for Thakurgaon-2 (Baliadangi, Haripur, and the Dharmagarh and Kashipur unions of Ranishankail upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He was elected as the candidate nominated by the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Born on 13 July 1955, Abdus Salam is a native of Baliadangi in Thakurgaon district. His father is Rahim Uddin Ahammed and his mother Saleha Khatun.

A physician by profession, Abdus Salam is a former secretary general of the Doctors Association of Bangladesh (DAB), an organisation of doctors. On 4 December 2025, when the BNP announced its second round of candidates, it nominated him for Thakurgaon-2. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP, winning 121,017 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. According to a report in Ittefaq, with this win a BNP candidate carried the seat after 37 years. After his victory he pledged to work shoulder to shoulder with everyone, regardless of party or opinion.
মোঃ আমানউল্লাহ আমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Md. Amanullah Aman is the member of parliament for Dhaka-2 (part of Keraniganj Upazila, wards 55, 56 and 57 of Dhaka South City Corporation, and the Aminbazar, Tetuljhora and Bhakurta unions of Savar Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. Elected for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this experienced politician has entered Parliament for the fifth time. In Parliament he is chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, and also a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Standing Committee on Public Accounts and the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions. On 15 August 2026 he became a member of the National Standing Committee, the BNP's highest policy-making forum.

Aman was born on 25 January 1962 in Keraniganj Upazila, Dhaka District. He is the son of Meghu Mia and Karimon Nesa.

His political career began in Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. In 1990 he was elected vice-president of the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU). He was one of the front-line student leaders of that year's anti-autocracy movement, which led to the resignation of General Ershad and to free elections under a caretaker government.

He was first elected member of parliament for Dhaka-3 in the 1991 general election. He was then re-elected from the same seat in the February and June 1996 elections and in 2001. In 1996 he was made State Minister for Education. In the 2001 government he served as State Minister for Health and Family Welfare and later as State Minister for Labour and Employment. In the party he was general secretary of Dhaka District BNP and has served as a joint secretary general of the BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected for Dhaka-2 as the BNP candidate with 163,793 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Sabera Aman. Their son is Erfan Ibne Aman Omi.
মোঃ আমির হামজা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুষ:
Md. Amir Hamza is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Kushtia-3 (Kushtia Sadar). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is an Islamic speaker, a da'i (preacher) and a writer, and is known as Mufti Amir Hamza.

He was born on 28 October 1992 in Dabiravita village of Patikabari union, Sadar upazila, Kushtia district. His father, Md. Riaz Uddin, is a farmer, and his mother's name is Feroza Khatun.

As a child he completed the hifz (memorisation) of the Quran. He then completed ifta at a Qawmi madrasa in Kushtia and earned the title of mufti. Alongside this he passed the Alim from an Alia madrasa, and obtained bachelor's and master's degrees from the Department of Al-Quran and Islamic Studies in the Faculty of Theology at Islamic University, Kushtia. After completing his studies he began da'wah (preaching) work through waz mahfils (religious sermon gatherings).

As a writer, his published books include Namaz Aday Paddhati (‘How to perform namaz’, 2015), Musalman Kokhon Kafer Hoy? (‘When does a Muslim become a kafir?’, 2017), Iman Anar Paddhati (‘How to embrace iman’, 2019), Kon Amale Kon Jannat, Kon Karone Kon Jahannam (‘Which deeds lead to which paradise, which causes lead to which hell’, 2019) and 6 Jon Jannati Adarsha Nari (‘6 model women of paradise’, 2021).

In 2025 Jamaat-e-Islami announced him as its prospective candidate for Kushtia-3. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kushtia-3 with 182,476 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আমিরুল ইসলাম খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md. Amirul Islam Khan is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Sirajganj-5. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a former assistant publicity secretary of the BNP's central executive committee.

He was born on 1 December 1970 in Tamai village of Belkuchi upazila, Sirajganj district. His father, Mozammel Haque Khan, was a businessman, and his mother, Mst. Angura Begum, a homemaker.

He passed the SSC from Bahumukhi High School in 1986. After completing his HSC at Government Titumir College, he was admitted to the University of Dhaka in 1991 and obtained bachelor's and master's degrees from the Department of Sociology.

Amirul Islam's political life began while he was studying at Titumir College. He joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, became general secretary of its Government Titumir College unit, and took an active part in the anti-autocracy movement of the 1990s. From 2002 to 2005 he was general secretary and president of the University of Dhaka unit of Chhatra Dal, and in 2009 he served as general secretary of the Chhatra Dal central committee. He was then elected assistant publicity secretary of the BNP's central executive committee. He has also served as assistant organising secretary of the Rajshahi divisional BNP and as convener of the Sirajganj district conference preparatory committee.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Sirajganj-5 for the first time, with 134,989 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আয়নুল হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সিরা:
Md. Aynul Haque is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Sirajganj-3 (Raiganj and Tarash upazilas). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In his area he is known as VP Aynul. In the party he is information and research secretary of the Sirajganj district BNP.

He was born on 12 September 1968 in Raiganj upazila of Sirajganj district. His father is Md. Mofiz Uddin Sekh and his mother Mst. Hajera Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

As a student he was elected VP (vice-president of the students' union) three times at Chandaikona Haji Wahed Moriom Honours College. He held various posts in Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal and Jubo Dal, and took an active part in the anti-autocracy movement of 1990. He later served as general secretary of the Raiganj upazila BNP and as chairman of the Raiganj upazila parishad.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Sirajganj-3 with 174,430 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আশরাফ উদ্দিন, যিনি আশরাফ উদ্দিন বকুল:
Md Ashraf Uddin, known as Ashraf Uddin Bakul, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narsingdi-5 (Raipura). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is assistant secretary for science and technology affairs of the BNP's central committee and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

He was born on 22 June 1969 in Raipura Upazila, Narsingdi District. His father is Abdul Hashem Bhuiyan and his mother Saleha Begum. After receiving the nomination he pledged to work in unity with the party's grassroots leaders and activists.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narsingdi-5 with 137,690 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the seat after nearly 30 years.
মোঃ আসাদুজ্জামান আইন, বিচার ও সংসদ বিষয়:
Md. Asaduzzaman is the Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs and the member of parliament (MP) for Jhenaidah-1. He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A senior lawyer of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court, Asaduzzaman was appointed the country's 17th Attorney General on 8 August 2024.

He was born on 31 January 1971 in Baraipara village of Umedpur union, in Shailkupa upazila of present-day Jhenaidah; his father is Sheikh Md. Israil Hossain and his mother Begum Rokeya. He passed the SSC from Garaganj Secondary School in 1987 and the HSC from Shailkupa Government Degree College in 1989, and then obtained LLB (Honours) and LLM degrees from the Department of Law of the University of Dhaka. As a student he was involved in the politics of the JSD Chhatra League; in 1994 he became the organisation's central publicity secretary.

He received his Bar Council licence in 1995, and was enrolled as a lawyer in the High Court Division in 1996 and in the Appellate Division in 2005. At the start of his career he worked with lawyer Nizamul Huq Nasim (later a justice); in 1998 he joined Barrister Syed Ishtiaq Ahmed as a junior and later became a partner in his law chambers. He has appeared as a lawyer in many important cases in the higher courts.

He was human rights secretary of the BNP's central executive committee and an adviser to party chairperson Khaleda Zia. After the July mass uprising he served as Attorney General under the interim government. Elected MP for the first time from Jhenaidah-1 in the 13th parliamentary election in 2026, he became Minister of Law.
মোঃ ইজ্জত উল্লাহ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Md. Izzatullah is the member of parliament (MP) for Satkhira-1 (Tala and Kalaroa) in the 13th Parliament. Known as Principal Izzatullah, this educationist entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources. He is currently a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central executive council and serves as director for the Khulna region.

He was born on 26 January 1956 in the village of Foyzullahpur in Jalalabad Union, Kalaroa upazila, Satkhira district. He is the son of Yusuf Ali Sana and Mst. Rupjan Bibi.

Izzatullah is a former student of the University of Dhaka. In his professional life he worked as a teacher, and he is now a retired teacher. He was a member of the Senate of the University of Rajshahi.

In his organisational career he served as amir of the Satkhira district unit of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He later joined the party's central executive council.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Satkhira-1 with 193,772 votes on the scales symbol. In this election, Jamaat-e-Islami candidates won all four seats in Satkhira.
মোঃ এনামুল হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে পত্ন:
Md. Anamul Haque is the member of parliament for Naogaon-2, which consists of Patnitala and Dhamoirhat upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

He was born on 16 April 1964 in the village of Farshipara in Dhamoirhat upazila, Naogaon district. His father's name is Ismail Hossain and his mother's Mst. Jahanara Begum. He is an engineer by profession and is known locally as Engineer Anamul Haque.

Before the election he was a member of the working council of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami's Naogaon district unit, and it was from this position that the party made him its candidate for Naogaon-2. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 141,526 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Samsuzzoha Khan, received 134,533 votes. After his victory he thanked the voters of Patnitala and Dhamoirhat and called on everyone to remain calm.
মোঃ কামরুজ্জামান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ম:
Md. Quamruzzaman is the member of parliament for Munshiganj-3 (Munshiganj Sadar and Gazaria Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In political circles he is known as Quamruzzaman Ratan. In the party he is social welfare affairs secretary of the BNP central committee. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Quamruzzaman Ratan was born on 31 January 1965 in Gazaria Upazila, Munshiganj District. He is the son of Md. Awal and Karimunnesa. He has long been involved in party politics.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 124,691 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ কামরুল হাসান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ম:
Md. Quamrul Hassan is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-6 (Fulbaria Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. Locally he is known as Principal Quamrul Hassan Milon.

By profession Principal Quamrul Hassan is an educationist and businessman. He is the son of Md. Mokbul Hossain and Mst. Hasna Ara Begum. In politics he serves as naib-e-amir (deputy amir) of the Mymensingh District unit of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate on behalf of the eleven-party alliance, with 77,325 votes under the scales symbol. He took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.
মোঃ কেরামত আলী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে শিব:
Md. Keramat Ali is the member of parliament for Chapai Nawabganj-1, which consists of Shibganj upazila, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committees on the Ministry of Industries and the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

He was born on 1 February 1958 in the village of Jalmachhmari in Shibganj upazila, Chapai Nawabganj district. His father, Md. Daud Ali, was a physician and an Islamic scholar (alem) in the area; his mother's name is Anowara Begum. He is the fourth of twelve siblings.

He received his first lessons from his father. After Shibganj Model Primary School, he passed his Dakhil from Bhabanipur Dakhil Madrasa in 1974, his Alim from Chhatrajitpur Fazil Madrasa and his Fazil from Tumchar Islamia Kamil Madrasa. He completed a double Kamil in Hadith and Tafsir at Madrasa-e-Alia Dhaka. After passing his intermediate examination from Rajshahi New Government Degree College in 1979, he took master's degrees at the University of Rajshahi in political science in 1983 and in Islamic studies in 1987. In 2014 he obtained a PhD from the same university for research on the role of alems in the propagation of Islam and social reform in the Chapai Nawabganj region. He began his career in 1991 as principal of Shibganj Islami Academy, joined Chhatrajitpur Fazil Madrasa as a lecturer in 1999, and retired as an assistant professor in 2018.

As a student he joined Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir in 1977. He was president of its Rajshahi metropolitan unit from 1984 to 1988 and later served as its central foreign affairs secretary. In Jamaat-e-Islami he was Shibganj upazila ameer from 1990 to 2000, Chapai Nawabganj district secretary from 2000 to 2006, and district nayeb-e-ameer and a member of the central Majlis-e-Shura from 2006 to 2018. Since 2018 he has been a member of the central working council and ameer of Rajshahi metropolitan city. He was elected chairman of the Shibganj upazila parishad twice, in 2009 and 2014. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP with 206,893 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Shahjahan Mia, received 162,515 votes.

He is also active in writing and social work. He is the author of the book 'A Century of the Propagation of Islam in the Chapai Nawabganj Region'. He is one of the founding members of Shibganj Islami Academy, and together with colleagues he founded Shibganj Orphanage, of which he is still president. He is also associated with the Dawatul Islam Trust as its chief adviser and with the Shah Neamatullah Trust as its chairman.
মোঃ খালেদ হোসেন মাহবুব ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Md. Khaled Hossain Mahboob is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-3 (Brahmanbaria Sadar and Bijoynagar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Khaled Hossain Mahboob was born on 11 September 1967 in Sadar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Mohammad Ali and Samsunnahar Begum. He studied at Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) and is known as an engineer. By profession he is a businessman.

In politics he is economic affairs secretary of BNP's central executive committee and president of Brahmanbaria district BNP. He is also involved in education in the area, serving as chief adviser to Brahmanbaria Ideal School.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 209,636 votes in Brahmanbaria-3 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ গোলাম রছুল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে যশো:
Md. Golam Rasul is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jashore-4 (Bagherpara, Abhaynagar and Basundia). This Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami leader has entered Parliament for the first time. He currently serves as amir of the Jashore district Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 1 March 1971 in Paikpara village of Bagherpara upazila, Jashore. His father is Md. Siddik Ahammad and his mother Anowara Khatun. His education began at Bagherpara Siddiqia Kamil Madrasa. He later obtained a Kamil degree from Narail Shahabad Majidia Alia Madrasa. He obtained bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of Rajshahi and an MPhil from Islamic University.

Professionally, Golam Rasul is a teacher. In 1996 he joined Hamidpur Al-Hera College in Jashore as a lecturer in the Department of Islamic Studies. As a student he was involved with Islami Chhatra Shibir, and in 1996 he joined Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He then held various party posts in Jashore district before becoming district amir.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jashore-4 with 176,912 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ গোলাম রব্বানী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Golam Rabbani is the member of parliament for Rangpur-5 (Mithapukur) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In the local media he is known as Professor Golam Rabbani and is referred to as ameer of the Rangpur district Jamaat-e-Islami.

Golam Rabbani was born on 25 January 1963 in Mithapukur, Rangpur district. His father is Moazzem Hossain and his mother Mst. Fatema Khatun. He studied at Ranipukur School and College, Carmichael College in Rangpur and the University of Rajshahi.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-5 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 176,411 votes.
মোঃ জসীম উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md Jashim Uddin is the member of parliament for Cumilla-5 (Brahmanpara and Burichang upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is also known as Haji Jashim Uddin.

Jashim Uddin was born on 1 March 1965 in Bagra village, Brahmanpara upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Nurul Islam and Anowara Begum.

He has long been in the leadership of the local BNP. Since 2000 he has served as president of Brahmanpara upazila BNP. From 2022 to 2025 he was member secretary of Cumilla South district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 134,485 votes in Cumilla-5 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is the father of three daughters and a son.
মোঃ জালাল উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চ:
Md Jalal Uddin is the member of parliament for Chandpur-2 (Matlab Uttar and Matlab Dakshin upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance and of the standing committee on public accounts.

Jalal Uddin was born on 4 January 1959 in Matlab Uttar upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Md. Sayed Ali Howlader and Amena Khatun. Locally he is known as Alhaj Dr Mohammad Jalal Uddin.

In politics he is a member of BNP's national executive committee. In November 2025 the party nominated him as its candidate for Chandpur-2. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 172,506 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the election he was given a public reception in Matlab Uttar.
মোঃ জাহান্দার আলী মিয়া মাদারীপুর-২ (মাদ:
Md Jahander Ali Miha is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Madaripur-2 (part of Madaripur Sadar, and Rajoir). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Jahander Ali Miha was born on 20 April 1962 in Madaripur Sadar Upazila, Madaripur District. His mother's name is Aytan Nesa. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he serves as member secretary of the Madaripur District BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 61,744 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ জাহিদুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Jahidur Rahaman is the member of parliament for Thakurgaon-3 (Pirganj and Ranishankail) in the 13th Parliament. This is his second term from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was first elected MP from the same seat in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament.

Jahidur Rahaman was born on 11 January 1959 in the village of Uttar Malancha in Pirganj upazila, Thakurgaon district. His father is Mobarak Ali and his mother Jamila Khatun. According to his family, his father served as chairman of the local union parishad for about 25 years, and it was from his father that he drew his first inspiration for politics. He is a farmer by profession.

Jahidur Rahaman has been involved in politics since 1978. Guided by the then leaders of the Pirganj upazila BNP, he became active in Chhatra Dal politics. He has said that a speech by the then President Ziaur Rahman at a public rally on the Pirganj Government College ground in 1979 inspired him to become active in the BNP. In that year's parliamentary election he campaigned for the party's candidate in the Pirganj-Setabganj constituency. In the late 1980s, during the anti-Ershad movement, he took part in party activities in Thakurgaon and helped expand the party's work at the local level. He was also the BNP's candidate for Thakurgaon-3 in the 2008 election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP again, winning 132,797 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol, and he took the oath on 17 February 2026.
মোঃ জাহিদুল ইসলাম ধলু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md. Zahidul Islam Dhalu is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Naogaon-5, a seat made up of Naogaon Sadar upazila. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

He was born on 28 March 1963 in Naogaon Sadar upazila. His father's name is Naim Uddin Ahammed and his mother's name is Chhattarunnesa. He is a businessman by profession.

Zahidul Islam Dhalu is a former general secretary of the Naogaon district BNP. On 4 December 2025, BNP secretary general Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir announced him at a press conference as the party's candidate for the Naogaon-5 (Sadar) seat. After receiving the nomination he said that, if elected, he would stand by ordinary people and work to establish the people's rights and to build a state founded on good governance for future generations.

In the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 129,385 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Abu Sadat Md. Sayem, received 104,747 votes.
মোঃ তমিজ উদ্দিন ঢাকা-২০ (ধামরাই) আসন থেক:
Md Tamiz Uddin is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-20 (Dhamrai). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

He was born in Dhamrai Upazila, Dhaka District. His father is Md. Afaz Uddin and his mother Sharifun Nesa. He is a businessman by profession and has long been involved in politics. He previously served as chairman of the Dhamrai Upazila Parishad. He is currently a member of the BNP's National Executive Committee and president of the Dhamrai Upazila BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 162,504 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In 1988 he founded Afaz Uddin School and College in Sharifbag village, Dhamrai Upazila.
মোঃ তাজউদ্দীন খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Tajuddin Khan is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Meherpur-1 (Meherpur Sadar and Mujibnagar). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is amir of the Meherpur district Jamaat-e-Islami. In September 2026 he was elected a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Housing and Public Works.

He was born on 28 February 1974. His father is Md. Abul Hossain Khan and his mother Mst. Sufia Khatun. He is a teacher by profession and is known in his area as Maulana Tajuddin Khan.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Meherpur-1 with 123,271 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ নজরুল ইসলাম আজাদ নারায়ণগঞ্জ-২ (আড়া:
Md Nazrul Islam Azad is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-2 (Araihazar). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 12 December 1976 in Araihazar Upazila, Narayanganj District. He is a resident of Satgram Union, Araihazar. His father is Md. Mostafizur Rahman and his mother Shahnaz Rahman. He studied at Panchrukhi Haji Saheb Ali Fakir High School.

Nazrul Islam Azad, who is involved in BNP politics, was appointed international affairs secretary of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal by the party's chairperson, Begum Khaleda Zia.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-2 with 124,291 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ নাজমুল হুদা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে মে:
Md. Nazmul Huda is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Meherpur-2 (Gangni). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 19 September 1958 in Gangni upazila of Meherpur district. His father is Md. Altaf Hossain and his mother Mst. Nurunnahar Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In local government, Nazmul Huda has served as chairman of the Gangni upazila parishad. In the party he is a member of the Shura and working council of the Meherpur district Jamaat-e-Islami.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Meherpur-2 with 96,306 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ নাহিদ ইসলাম ঢাকা-১১ আসন থেকে নির্বাচ:
Md. Nahid Islam is a member of the 13th Parliament, elected from Dhaka-11, and convener of the National Citizen Party (NCP). This is his first parliamentary term. In February 2026, at a meeting of the NCP parliamentary party, he was nominated Chief Whip of the Opposition in Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the Business Advisory Committee, the Standing Committee on Privileges and the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

Nahid Islam was born on 28 April 1998 in Dhaka. His father, Badrul Islam, is a teacher, and his mother is Momtaz Nahar. After passing the SSC from Dakshin Banasree Model High School in 2014 and the HSC from Government Science College in 2016, he was admitted to the Department of Sociology at the University of Dhaka, completing his bachelor's degree (Honours) in 2022.

From his first year at university he was vocal on students' demands. He took part in the 2018 quota reform and road safety movements, and contested the 2019 DUCSU election. In 2023, together with fellow students, he formed a student organisation named Gonotantrik Chhatra Shakti and was its member secretary. From the start of the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Students Movement he was one of its coordinators, and he announced the one-point demand during the non-cooperation programme. The same year he was named in the TIME100 Next list.

On 8 August 2024 he was appointed an adviser to the interim government, in charge of the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology and later of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. On 25 February 2025 he resigned as adviser and joined the new party, the National Citizen Party, formally taking charge as its convener on 28 February.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Dhaka-11 with 93,872 votes.
মোঃ নুরুল আমীন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে রংপ:
Md Nurul Amin is the member of parliament for Rangpur-6 (Pirganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs. He is known as an educationist and mufassir (exegete of the Quran), and is general secretary of the central committee of Bangladesh Majlisul Mufassirin.

Maulana Nurul Amin was born on 1 March 1974 in the village of Duramitipur in Pirganj municipality, Rangpur. His father is Maulana Md. Azizur Rahman and his mother Mst. Amena Begum.

He passed his Dakhil, Alim and Fazil from Pirganj Fazil Degree Madrasa, and later obtained a Kamil degree. He then obtained higher degrees in Islamic history and Islamic studies from Carmichael College, Rangpur and the University of Rajshahi.

He has been teaching since 1996. He is currently an assistant professor at Pirganj Senior Fazil Madrasa. He has also served as an imam since 1997 and is the khatib of Altaf Nagar Jame Mosque. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-6 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 120,128 votes.
মোঃ নুরুল হক নুর প্রবাসী কল্যাণ ও বৈদেশি:
Md. Nurul Haque Nur is the State Minister for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment and the member of parliament (MP) for Patuakhali-3. He has held this post since 4 March 2026; before that, from 17 February to 4 March, he was State Minister for Labour and Employment. A former vice-president (VP) of DUCSU, known as "VP Nur", Nur is president of Gono Odhikar Parishad.

He was born on 30 January 1994 in Patuakhali; his father is Md. Idris Howlader. He sat the SSC examination in 2010 at Gola Abdur Rahim Secondary School in Companir Hat and the HSC examination in 2012 at Uttara High School and College in Dhaka; he later studied at the University of Dhaka.

In 2018 he became nationally known when he led the quota reform movement as joint convener of Bangladesh Chhatra Odhikar Sangrakkhan Parishad. In 2019 he was elected VP of the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU). He was at the forefront of movements on various demands, including a fair price for paddy and justice for the murders of Nusrat and Abrar. He was attacked several times during these movements; in December 2019 he and his colleagues were seriously injured in an attack on the DUCSU building.

He was arrested on 20 July during the 2024 quota reform movement. He is also convener of the Chhatra, Jubo o Probashi Odhikar Parishad (Student, Youth and Expatriate Rights Council). In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was elected MP for Patuakhali-3 for the first time.
মোঃ নূরুল ইসলাম, যিনি নূরুল ইসলাম বুলবুল:
Md. Nurul Islam, well known as Nurul Islam Bulbul, is the member of parliament for Chapai Nawabganj-3, which consists of Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs, the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Private Members' Resolutions, and the Special Committee. He is a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central executive council.

He was born on 7 February 1968 in the village of Rehaichar in Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila. His father, Professor Mohammad Israil, was a former principal of Krishnagobindapur Degree College; his mother is Mst. Nurjahan Begum Nuri. He is the eldest of ten siblings.

He passed his secondary examination in the first division from Harimohan Government High School in 1983 and his higher secondary examination from Nawabganj Government College in 1985. He obtained a BSS from the same college in 1987 and an MSS from the political science department of the University of Rajshahi in 1991. He began his career as a teacher of political science at Nawabganj City College. He founded Pan Asiatic School and College in Chapai Nawabganj. He has also served as registrar of Victoria University of Bangladesh and of Bangladesh Islami University, and as managing director of Jabale Noor Hospital and Foundation.

He became active in politics as a student. In 1987 he was elected vice-president (VP) of the Chapai Nawabganj Government College students' union, and in 1990, in the Rajshahi University Central Students' Union (RUCSU) election, general secretary (GS) of Shaheed Shamsuzzoha Hall. In Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir he served as president of its University of Rajshahi and Rajshahi metropolitan units, as central secretary general, and from 2001 to 2002 as central president. After joining Jamaat-e-Islami in 2003 he served as Gulshan thana ameer and as assistant secretary and secretary of Dhaka metropolitan city, and in 2017 he was elected ameer of Dhaka Metropolitan South.

In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 189,640 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Harunur Rashid, received 127,037 votes. He is married to Kohinur Akhter Sima; they have two sons and a daughter.
মোঃ ফজলুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কি:
Md. Fazlur Rahman is the member of parliament for Kishoreganj-4 (Itna, Mithamain and Austagram Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. Elected for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this freedom fighter and senior lawyer has entered Parliament for the second time. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs. He has served as an adviser to the BNP Chairperson, Khaleda Zia.

Fazlur Rahman was born on 3 October 1948 in Karanshi village, Joysiddhi Union, Itna Upazila, Kishoreganj District. He is the son of Md. Abul Hossain and Hosena Banu. He is a lawyer by profession.

As a student he served as general secretary and as president of the Chhatra League. In the Liberation War of 1971 he fought as chief of the Mujib Bahini in Kishoreganj District. After independence he was involved in Awami League politics; in 1979 he joined the BNP, and in 1980 he was elected a member of a union parishad. In 1986 he was elected member of parliament for the first time, for Kishoreganj-3 as a Jatiya Party candidate. In 1988 he returned to the BNP, and he later served as president of Kishoreganj District BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected by a large margin as the BNP's nominated candidate, with 132,472 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ ফজলুর রহমান সাঈদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md Fazlur Rahman Sayed is the member of parliament for Jaipurhat-1, which consists of Joypurhat Sadar and Panchbibi upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He serves as ameer of the party's Joypurhat district unit, and is also known as a member of Jamaat's central Majlis-e-Shura.

He was born on 20 January 1969. His father's name is Tachhir Uddin and his mother's Sharifun Nesa.

As district ameer, he began organisational preparations in the Jaipurhat-1 constituency well before the election. Under his leadership the party's organisational structure was strengthened through the formation of polling-centre-based teams and door-to-door contact. Before the election he told Prothom Alo: 'We have stood by the people for a long time.'

In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 165,192 votes under the scales symbol. The BNP candidate for the seat, Md. Masud Rana Prodhan, received 155,309 votes.
মোঃ ফজলে হুদা, যিনি ফজলে হুদা বাবুল নামে:
Md. Fazley Houda, known as Fazley Houda Babul, is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Naogaon-3, a seat made up of Badalgachhi and Mohadevpur upazilas. He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

He was born on 15 February 1973 in Badalgachhi upazila of Naogaon district. His father's name is Md. Nihal Uddin Akanda and his mother's name is Mst. Dilruba Begum.

Fazley Houda has long been involved in BNP politics in Badalgachhi. At the 2014 conference he became president of the Badalgachhi upazila BNP, and at the following biennial conference he was elected to the same post again. He is also joint general secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal. Before the election he told Prothom Alo: ‘I have been involved in BNP politics in the area for a long time. I have tried to stand by people in their joys and sorrows.’

In the 13th parliamentary election on 12 February 2026 he was elected by a wide margin, winning 166,889 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Md. Mahfuzur Rahman, received 119,421 votes.
মোঃ ফরিদুল কবীর তালুকদার, যিনি ফরিদুল কব:
Md. Faridul Kabir Talukder, known as Faridul Kabir Talukder Shamim, is the member of parliament for Jamalpur-4 (Sarishabari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is president of Jamalpur District BNP.

Faridul Kabir Talukder was born on 17 January 1967 in Sarishabari Upazila, Jamalpur District. He is the son of Saidur Rahman Talukder and Mst. Nure Ferdousi. He is a businessman by profession. As president of the district BNP, he has spoken out in favour of social harmony.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Jamalpur-4 with 147,406 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ বরকত উল্লাহ বুলু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md. Barkat Ullah Bulu is the member of parliament for Noakhali-3 (Begumganj upazila) in the 13th Parliament. A vice-chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Bulu has come to Parliament for the fifth time. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Barkat Ullah Bulu was born on 20 December 1956 in Begumganj, Noakhali. His father is Abdur Rahman. His education began at Batatali Bazar Primary School, and in 1980 he obtained a bachelor's degree in science.

In politics he was central president of Jubo Dal. In 1989 he was elected a member of BNP's executive committee, and he later served as the party's central joint secretary general. He is currently a vice-chairman of the party. He was elected a member of parliament from the Noakhali-2 seat in the 5th parliamentary election in 1991 and the 6th and 7th in February and June 1996, and from the Noakhali-3 seat in the 9th parliamentary election in 2008. In the 9th Parliament he was a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Public Administration. He also served for a long time as an adviser to the Ministry of Commerce.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the fifth time, winning 141,031 votes in Noakhali-3 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. In 1981 he married Shamim Akter Lucky. The couple have two sons.
মোঃ মজিবর রহমান সরওয়ার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md. Mazibar Rahman Sarwar is the member of parliament (MP) for Barishal-5 (Barishal City Corporation and Barishal Sadar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. This is his fifth term, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He has also served as mayor of Barishal City Corporation. He was born on 1 October 1957 in Barishal. He is the son of Syedur Rahman and Syeda Majidun Nesa.

In a long political career, Mazibar Rahman Sarwar has served as joint secretary general of the BNP. When Abdur Rahman Biswas, then MP for Barishal-5, was elected President, he was first elected MP in the by-election of December 1991. He was elected from this seat again in a by-election in 1998. He was also elected MP as the BNP candidate in the elections to the 8th Parliament in 2001 and the 9th Parliament in 2008. In between, from 24 April 2003 to 21 April 2007, he was the elected mayor of Barishal City Corporation.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Barishal-5 for the fifth time with 135,146 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মজিবুর রহমান গাজীপুর-১ আসন থেকে নির্:
Md. Mazibur Rahman is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-1. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a member of the BNP's central National Executive Committee and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Locally he is known as Mayor Mazibur Rahman.

He was born on 11 July 1968 in Kaliakair Upazila, Gazipur District. His father is Shukur Ali and his mother Surja Bhanu. After completing his primary and secondary education at local institutions, he obtained a master's degree (MSS) in political science. He is a businessman by profession.

His career as an elected representative began in 2004 as administrator of Kaliakair Municipality. He was later elected mayor of Kaliakair Municipality three times in a row and held the post for nearly two decades. As mayor he worked on developing the municipal area's roads, drainage and social infrastructure.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-1 with 208,688 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মতিয়ার রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Motiar Rahman is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jhenaidah-3 (Kotchandpur and Maheshpur upazilas). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

He was born on 7 August 1957 in Kotchandpur, Jhenaidah district. His father is Abdul Majid Biswas and his mother Mst. Jayeda Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

In his area he is known as Professor Motiar Rahman. In the party he has served as amir of the Kotchandpur upazila Jamaat-e-Islami.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jhenaidah-3 with 175,857 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ মনজুরুল ইসলাম (মঞ্জু) ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Md Monjurul Islam (Manju) is the member of parliament for Dinajpur-1 (Birganj and Kaharole) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs and the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

Monjurul Islam was born on 5 March 1962 in the village of Bhabki in Birganj upazila, Dinajpur district. His father is Md. Khademul Islam and his mother Mst. Nurjahan Begum. While studying at the University of Dhaka he joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics, and from 1980 to 1984 he served as organising secretary of the Chhatra Dal unit of the university's Jasimuddin Hall.

After completing his education he worked for about 24 years as country director of a Japanese multinational company. He later entered the ready-made garment industry and started a business. He is currently managing director of JM International Limited.

He became actively involved in BNP politics in 2009, and later, as president of the Birganj upazila BNP, organised party activities at the local level. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Dinajpur-1, winning 179,314 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মনিরুল হক চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md Manirul Haque Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Cumilla-6 (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar, Cumilla City Corporation and the Cumilla Cantonment area) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this veteran politician has come to Parliament for the fourth time. In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs. He is a freedom fighter and an organiser of the Liberation War.

Manirul Haque Chowdhury was born in Noygram, Cumilla Sadar Dakshin upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Md. Noab Haider Chowdhury and Joynaber Nesa.

He has been active in politics since his student days. From 1974 to 1975 he was president of the Bangladesh Chhatra League. In the 3rd parliamentary election in 1988 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Cumilla-9 seat on a Jatiya Party nomination, and he was re-elected from the same seat in the 5th parliamentary election in 1991. He later joined BNP, and in the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 he became a member of parliament for the third time, from Cumilla-9 on a BNP nomination. He has also served as an adviser to the BNP chairperson.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, standing in Cumilla-6 for the first time, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 201,706 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Azizunnesa, and the couple have four children.
মোঃ মনোয়ার হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Monowar Hosen is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Magura-1. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time and serves as a member of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs. In local media he is also known as Monowar Hosen Khan.

He was born on 30 May 1964. His father is Wajed Ali Khan and his mother Monowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Monowar Hosen has long been involved in the organisational work of the Magura district BNP. When the party's central committee announced a new convening committee for the Magura district BNP in December 2024, he was made its member secretary. At that time the committee was charged with forming committees at district, upazila, union and ward level and organising conferences. He later became known as convener of the Magura district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Magura-1 with 185,338 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the seat for the first time in about 30 years.
মোঃ মমিনুল হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চাঁদ:
Md Maminul Haque is the member of parliament for Chandpur-5 (Hajiganj and Shaharasti upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Engineer Maminul Haque.

Maminul Haque was born in Hajiganj upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Alhaj Md. Lokit Ulla Sarkar and Latifa Khatun.

A politician who rose from the grassroots, he has served as convener of Hajiganj-Shaharasti BNP and as president of Chandpur district BNP. He is currently a member of BNP's central executive committee. He received BNP's nomination for Chandpur-5 in the 2008 and 2018 parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, having received the party's nomination for the third time, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 185,404 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মশিউর রহমান খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Md Moshiur Rahman Khan is the member of parliament (MP) for Bagerhat-1 in the 13th Parliament. A leader of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, he has entered Parliament for the first time and is a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources. He is a member of the party's central Majlis-e-Shura.

He was born on 2 June 1968 into a Muslim family in the village of Aruabarni Charpara in Chitalmari upazila, Bagerhat district. He is the son of Sultan Ahmad Khan and Asia Begum.

His education began at the village maktab. After studying at Aruabarni Government Primary School, he passed the Dakhil and Alim examinations from Hizla Alim Madrasa. He then obtained the Fazil from Rahmatpur Fazil Madrasa and the Kamil degree in the Hadith department from Sarsina Darus Sunnah Alia Madrasa in Pirojpur. Since 1999 he has served as principal of Ahmadia Fazil Madrasa in Kachua upazila, Bagerhat.

In his organisational career, Moshiur Rahman Khan served as amir of Bagerhat district Jamaat-e-Islami from 2004 to 2016. He is currently a member of the party's central Shura.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Bagerhat-1 with 117,527 votes on the scales symbol. According to a report in Naya Diganta, this was Jamaat-e-Islami's first victory in the seat since independence.
মোঃ মাজেদুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Mazedur Rahman is the member of parliament for Gaibandha-1 (Sundarganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In the local media he is known as the Jamaat-e-Islami leader Professor Mazedur Rahman Mazed.

Mazedur Rahman was born on 14 May 1973. His father is Md. Momin Uddin and his mother Rahima Begum. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Gaibandha-1, winning 140,726 votes with the scales symbol.
মোঃ মাসুদ পারভেজ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চ:
Md. Masud Parves is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Chuadanga-1 (Alamdanga upazila and part of Chuadanga Sadar upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 10 June 1985 in Alamdanga upazila of Chuadanga district. His father is Md. Khairul Islam and his mother Mst. Parula Khatun.

Masud Parves is a lawyer by profession. In the party he has served as assistant secretary of the Chuadanga district Jamaat. Jamaat announced him as its candidate for Chuadanga-1 on the basis of the views of the district councillors and subject to central approval.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Chuadanga-1 with 211,041 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ মাহবুবুর রহমান (বেলাল) ত্রয়োদশ জাতী:
Md Mahbubur Rahman (Belal) is the member of parliament for Rangpur-3 (Rangpur Sadar upazila and most of Rangpur City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. Within the party he is a member of Jamaat-e-Islami's central working council. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Land.

Mahbubur Rahman Belal was born on 1 October 1960 in Rangpur. His father is Mofizul Islam and his mother Mst. Fatema Begum. He completed his bachelor's degree in the economics department of Carmichael College, Rangpur. He is a transport businessman by profession.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-3 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 175,827 votes.
মোঃ মাহবুবুল আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ক:
Md Mahbubul Alam is the member of parliament for Kurigram-3 (Ulipur) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is better known as Barrister Mahbubul Alam Salehi or Mahbub Salehi. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Mahbubul Alam was born in the village of Kishorpur in Ulipur upazila, Kurigram district. His father is Md. Abdul Karim and his mother Mst. Mannuja Begum. After his primary education at Kishorpur Government Primary School, he passed his Dakhil and Alim from Satdarga Nesaria Kamil Madrasa. He then completed a bachelor's degree at the University of Rajshahi and a master's degree at Stockholm University in Sweden. In the United Kingdom he obtained the Barrister-at-Law from Lincoln's Inn, completed the Bar Professional Training Course and the Legal Practice Course at City University of London, and earned a postgraduate diploma in law from London South Bank University.

He is a lawyer by profession. As an expert on international migration and human rights, during some 16 years living abroad he played an active role at the level of the UK Parliament and the European Union. As a student he served as president of the University of Rajshahi unit and as central office secretary of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir. After returning home in 2024 he founded the Ulipur Development Forum.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kurigram-3 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 106,923 votes.
মোঃ মাহমুদুল হক রুবেল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md. Mahmudul Hoque Rubel is the member of parliament for Sherpur-3 (Sreebardi and Jhenaigati) in the 13th Parliament. He has represented this seat more than once for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Special Committee on Constitutional Amendment. Within the party he is a member of the BNP Central Executive Committee.

Mahmudul Hoque Rubel was born on 21 September 1971 at Griddanarayanpur in Sherpur. His father, Serajul Hoque, is a physician and a former member of parliament for Sherpur-3. His mother is Mst. Helen Akter. He has passed the higher secondary examination. He is a businessman by profession.

Rubel was the member of parliament for Sherpur-3 from 1995 to 30 March 1996 and from 1 October 2001 to 29 October 2006. In the 2001 election to the 8th Parliament he was elected as the BNP candidate. He has also served as president of Sherpur District BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was again elected member of parliament for Sherpur-3, with 166,117 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মিজানুর রহমান মিনু ভূমিমন্ত্রী এবং র:
Md. Mizanur Rahman Minu is the Minister of Land and the member of parliament (MP) for Rajshahi-2. He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A former mayor of Rajshahi City, he led the BNP in Rajshahi for many years and was an adviser to BNP chairperson Khaleda Zia.

He was born in Rajshahi on 7 January 1958; his father is Fazlar Rahman. He studied at Rajshahi Collegiate School.

He first became an MP in the 2001 election, winning more than 176,000 votes in Rajshahi-2. In 2002 he was elected mayor of Rajshahi. He has also served as president of the Rajshahi metropolitan BNP.

During his years in opposition several cases were filed against him, and he was imprisoned in 2014 and 2015. Elected from Rajshahi-2 for the second time in the 13th parliamentary election in 2026, he joined Tarique Rahman's Cabinet.
মোঃ মুজিবুর রহমান চৌধুরী মৌলভীবাজার-৪ (শ:
Md Mujibur Rahman Choudhury is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-4 (Sreemangal and Kamalganj). Known as Haji Mujib, this politician, industrialist and social worker is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

Mujibur Rahman Choudhury was born in Khushalpur village in Kamalganj municipality, Maulvibazar district. He is the son of Abdul Gafur Choudhury and Ummerunnesa.

After passing the SSC from Kamalganj Multilateral High School and the HSC from Kamalganj College, he obtained a BCom degree from the University of Dhaka. By profession he is a businessman and industrialist.

He has been a member of BNP's central executive committee since 2008. He contested this seat as an independent candidate in 2001, and was later BNP's candidate in the 2008 and 2018 elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 170,877 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he dedicated it to the people of Kamalganj and Sreemangal.
মোঃ মোক্তার আলী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে যশ:
Md. Moktar Ali is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jashore-6 (Keshabpur). He has been elected an MP for the first time, on the nomination of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

He was born on 7 September 1957 in Kayemkhola village of Keshabpur upazila, Jashore district. His father is Lokman Hakim and his mother Rahima Begum. In his working life he was a professor at Keshabpur Government Degree College.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jashore-6 with 92,234 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ মোবাশ্বের আলম ভুঁইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Md Mobasher Alam Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Cumilla-10 (Cumilla Sadar Dakshin, Lalmai and Nangalkot upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Mobasher Alam was born on 2 July 1970 in Nishchintapur village, Nangalkot upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Md. Abdul Latif Bhuiyan and Mst. Karimun Nesa Bhuiyan.

By profession he is a businessman. His businesses are Zamzam Car, Automobile and Hotel Okada.

In politics he has served as president of Nangalkot upazila BNP and vice-president of Cumilla South district BNP. In the 2008 election he was BNP's candidate for Cumilla-10. He is currently a member of BNP's central executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 163,667 votes in Cumilla-10 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মোশারফ হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ক:
Md. Mosharrf Hossain is the member of parliament for Bogura-4, which consists of Kahaloo and Nandigram upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he is representing this seat in Parliament for the second time. He has been made a member of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, formed on 7 September 2026.

He was born on 21 November 1974. His father's name is Hamir Uddin Sarkar and his mother's Mst. Pomijan. He is a businessman by profession.

Mosharrf Hossain has long been involved in BNP politics. He is acting general secretary of the Bogura district BNP and joint general secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal. Before this he was joint secretary in the Bogura district BNP committee approved in 2023. He was first elected MP from Bogura-4 in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament.

In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected for the second time with 155,339 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Dr Mostafa Faisal Parvez, received 108,978 votes. Local media have reported that since his election he has been working on the development of schools, colleges and madrasas in Kahaloo and Nandigram, the construction and repair of roads, and infrastructure development including bridges and culverts.
মোঃ মোস্তাফিজুর রহমান (মোস্তাফিজুর রহমান:
Md Mostafizur Rahman (Mostafizur Rahman Mostak) is the member of parliament for Kurigram-4 (Roumari, Char Rajibpur and Chilmari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami.

Mostafizur Rahman was born on 10 December 1959 in Jadurchar union of Roumari upazila, Kurigram district. His father is the former MLA Monsur Ahammed and his mother Mst. Hazera Begum. He studied at Kurigram Government College.

He is a businessman and entrepreneur by profession. He is chairman of Mohammadia Hospital and Diagnostic Centre, which has been providing healthcare at the local level. He also runs a business as an authorised fertiliser dealer of the Bangladesh Chemical Industries Corporation and the Bangladesh Agricultural Development Corporation.

A member of Jamaat-e-Islami, Mostafizur Rahman served as ameer of the party's Roumari upazila unit for two consecutive terms from 2021 to 2024. In 2014 he was the party-nominated candidate for chairman in the Roumari upazila parishad election. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kurigram-4, winning 106,347 votes with the scales symbol.
মোঃ মোস্তাফিজুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md. Mostafizur Rahman is the member of parliament for Naogaon-1, which consists of Porsha, Sapahar and Niamatpur upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 1 July 1963 in Niamatpur upazila, Naogaon district. His father's name is Md. Panaullah Sonar and his mother's Nurjahan Begum. Professionally he is engaged in agriculture and business.

In party politics, Mostafizur Rahman has served as general secretary of the Niamatpur upazila BNP. While he held this post, the BNP nominated him as its candidate for Naogaon-1. In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026 he was elected with 173,864 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Md. Mahbubul Alam, received 153,816 votes. After his victory he thanked Tarique Rahman for the party nomination and sought everyone's cooperation in implementing the election manifesto.
মোঃ মোস্তাফিজুর রহমান বাবুল ত্রয়োদশ জাত:
Md. Mustafizur Rahman Babul is the member of parliament for Jamalpur-3 (Madarganj and Melandaha) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. He was born on 3 February 1961 in Melandaha Upazila, Jamalpur District. He is the son of Md. Abdul Hai Jamali and Mst. Anowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Mustafizur Rahman Babul is assistant secretary for climate change affairs on the BNP National Executive Committee and is part of the leadership of Melandaha Upazila BNP. On 3 November 2025 the party announced him as its candidate for Jamalpur-3. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament with 207,412 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ রফিকুল ইসলাম খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md. Rafiqul Islam Khan is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Sirajganj-4 (Ullapara upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, and since 17 February 2026 he has served as the opposition whip. He is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges. In the party he is an assistant secretary general of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and a member of its executive council.

He was born on 1 September 1966 in Naokair village, in the Dikrirchar area of Ullapara upazila, Sirajganj district. His father is Md. Khorshed Alam Khan and his mother Fatema Begum.

Rafiqul Islam Khan passed the Dakhil at Dikrirchar Fazil Madrasa, and the Alim and Fazil at Pabna Alia Madrasa. After completing the Kamil in 1984, he obtained a bachelor's degree in Islamic Studies from the University of Rajshahi, and a master's degree in 1992.

He became involved in organisational politics as a student, and from January 1994 to December 1995 he served as the 13th central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir. He later joined the central leadership of Jamaat-e-Islami. He had also contested the 9th parliamentary election as the party's candidate.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Sirajganj-4 with 161,872 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ রবিউল আওয়াল, যিনি রবিউল আওয়াল লাভল:
Md. Robiul Awal, known as Robiul Awal Lavlu, is the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-6 (Delduar and Nagarpur) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was born on 1 January 1967 in Nagarpur upazila, Tangail district. He is the son of Md. Mizanur Rashid Ansari and Rubia Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Robiul Awal has long been active in BNP politics and is known as a grassroots organiser of the party. The party nominated him for Tangail-6 in the election to the 13th Parliament. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP with 150,952 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ রাজিব আহসান নৌপরিবহন মন্ত্রণালয় এবং:
Md. Razib Ahsan is the State Minister for the Ministry of Shipping and the Bridges Division, and the member of parliament (MP) for Barishal-4. He has held this post since 4 March 2026.

He was born in Mehendiganj, Barishal; his father is Md. Mizanur Rahman.

In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was elected MP for Barishal-4 for the first time, as the candidate of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
মোঃ রায়হান সিরাজী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Rayhan Shirazi is the member of parliament for Rangpur-1 (Gangachara upazila and wards 1 to 8 of Rangpur City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is assistant secretary general of Jamaat-e-Islami's Rangpur metropolitan unit. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

Rayhan Shirazi was born on 3 July 1979 in Gangachara upazila, Rangpur district. His father is Md. Ruhul Islam and his mother Mst. Saleha Khatun. He passed the Kamil examination from Pakuria Sharif Kasimia Fazil (Degree) Madrasa. He obtained honours and master's degrees in economics from Carmichael College, Rangpur, and completed an LLB in law. He is a teacher by profession.

As a student he was involved in the politics of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir. After his student years he joined Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He was secretary of the Gangachara upazila Jamaat for a long time and was later elected upazila ameer.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Rangpur-1 as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 145,088 votes.
মোঃ রাশেদুল ইসলাম রাশেদ, যিনি হাফেজ রাশে:
Md. Rashedul Islam Rashed, known as Hafez Rashedul Islam, is the member of parliament for Sherpur-1 (Sherpur Sadar) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Planning. He is a former central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir and is currently a member of the Central Majlis-e-Shura of Jamaat-e-Islami.

Rashedul Islam was born in 1990 in Kumri Mudipara village, Bajitkhila Union, Sherpur Sadar Upazila. He is the son of Md. Abul Kashem and Rezia Begum, and the youngest of five siblings. After completing his primary education at Kumri Kalitola Government Primary School, he memorised the Quran (hifz) at Ghonapara Hafezia Madrasa and Farukia Darussalam Madrasa. After passing the Dakhil from Al-Jamiatul Islamia Fazil Madrasa and the Alim from Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa, he earned BSc (Honours) and MSc degrees from the Department of Population Science and Human Resource Development at the University of Rajshahi. He also obtained a diploma in professional IT from the Technical Education Board and an MBA from Manarat International University.

He began his career as executive director of a skill development institution in Dhaka. Later, as an entrepreneur, he became involved in running a publishing house, a Hajj and Umrah agency, an online news portal, a hospital, an agro farm, a consultancy firm and an educational institution. He writes on Islamic thought, leadership and human resource development. In 2022 his booklet 'Manush Gorar Nobobi Shilpo: Rasul (SAW)-er Proshikkhon Poddhoti' (The Prophetic Art of Building People: The Training Method of the Messenger, peace be upon him) was published by Prochchhod Prokashon.

Rashedul Islam joined Chhatra Shibir in 2003, while in class nine. In 2009, while studying at the University of Rajshahi, he became a member of the organisation. He later served as a member of its central executive council, president of its University of Rajshahi unit, central science, education, dawah and office secretary, and secretary general. In 2022 he was the central president of Chhatra Shibir. In 2023 he joined Jamaat-e-Islami, where he serves as a member of the working council of Dhaka Metropolitan South and a member of the Central Majlis-e-Shura. Contesting for the first time, in the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Sherpur-1 with 127,811 votes under the scales symbol.

In social work, as chairman of the Sherpur Forum and the Sherpur Advancement Forum of Equity, he is involved in education, employment and humanitarian assistance activities. He has played a part in initiatives such as relief distribution, scholarships, tree planting and free medical camps.
মোঃ রুহুল আমিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চুয:
Md. Ruhul Amin is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Chuadanga-2 (Damurhuda and Jibannagar upazilas and part of Chuadanga Sadar upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is amir of the Chuadanga district Jamaat-e-Islami and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

He was born on 4 January 1980 in Jibannagar upazila of Chuadanga district. His father is Md. Abdul Khaleque and his mother Bulbuli Khatun.

Ruhul Amin is an income tax lawyer and businessman by profession.

He began in politics through Islami Chhatra Shibir in 1991. In 2003 he was elected district president of Chhatra Shibir. In 2009 he became joint general secretary of the district Jamaat, and general secretary in 2014. Since 2022 he has served as amir of the district Jamaat.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Chuadanga-2 with 208,011 votes under the scales symbol. His wife, Swapna Khatun, is a teacher by profession. They have one son and one daughter.
মোঃ রুহুল আমীন দুলাল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md. Ruhul Amin Dulal is the member of parliament (MP) for Pirojpur-3 (Mathbaria) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges. He was born on 31 December 1964. He is the son of Abdul Aziz Khalifa and Kulsum Bibi. Alongside politics, he is engaged in business.

Ruhul Amin Dulal is convener of Mathbaria upazila BNP. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Pirojpur-3 with 63,791 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ রেজাউল করিম বাদশা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md Rezaul Karim Badsha is the member of parliament for Bogura-6, which consists of Bogura Sadar upazila, in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he entered Parliament for the first time by winning the by-election of April 2026. He has been made chair of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, formed on 7 September 2026.

He was born on 6 July 1959 in Bogura. His father's name is Md. Shah Alam and his mother's Jahanara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Rezaul Karim Badsha has long been in the leadership of the Bogura district BNP. Before the election, in late 2025, he was still serving as president of the Bogura district BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament on 12 February 2026, BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman won two seats, Bogura-6 and Dhaka-17. When he kept Dhaka-17 and gave up Bogura-6, a by-election was held for the seat. In that by-election, on 9 April 2026, Rezaul Karim Badsha was elected with 133,931 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, Abidur Rahman, received 57,159 votes.
মোঃ রোকন উদ্দীন বাবুল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md Rokon Uddin Babul is the member of parliament for Lalmonirhat-2 (Kaliganj and Aditmari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Within the party he is a vice-president of the Lalmonirhat district BNP.

Rokon Uddin Babul was born on 3 January 1972 in the village of Uttar Batrish Hazari in Kaliganj upazila, Lalmonirhat district. His father is Shamsuddin Mia and his mother Mst. Rumia Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in politics and social work. After being active in Jatiya Party politics for a time, he joined the BNP and played a role in the party organisation as well as in local politics. In the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament he contested Lalmonirhat-2 with the BNP's nomination and received 78,193 votes. He has also twice stood in elections for chairman of the Kaliganj upazila parishad.

The BNP nominated him as its candidate for Lalmonirhat-2 in the election to the 13th Parliament. In his campaign he highlighted the development of the area, the waters of the Teesta river, border problems and the rights of young people. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP, winning 118,359 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ লুৎফর রহমান খান আজাদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md. Lutfor Rahman Khan Azad is the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-3 (Ghatail) in the 13th Parliament. This time he was elected as an independent candidate. He was previously MP for this seat as the candidate of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), and served as a State Minister in the BNP government.

Lutfor Rahman Khan Azad was born on 1 January 1957 in Ghatail upazila, Tangail district. He is the son of Habibar Rahman Khan and Mst. Sufia Khanam. He studied up to higher secondary level.

Having won as the BNP candidate in the parliamentary elections of 1991, 1996 and 2001, he was MP for Tangail-3 from 5 March 1991 to 29 October 2006. During the term of the 8th Parliament he served as State Minister for Labour and Employment from 11 February 2002 to 22 May 2003, as State Minister for Textiles and Jute from 22 May 2003 to 6 May 2004, and as State Minister for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment from 9 July to 29 October 2006.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he contested Tangail-3 as an independent candidate and was again elected MP.
মোঃ লুৎফর রহমান, যিনি লুৎফর রহমান মতিন ন:
Md. Lutfor Rahman, known as Lutfor Rahman Matin, is the member of parliament (MP) for Tangail-4 (Kalihati) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Lutfor Rahman was born on 3 November 1952 in the Elenga municipality area of Kalihati upazila, Tangail district. He is the son of Md. Sirajul Islam and Mrs Bela Begum. He completed his bachelor's degree at Jagannath University. He is a businessman by profession. To promote women's education, he founded Lutfor Rahman Matin Women's College in Elenga.

Involved in BNP politics, Lutfor Rahman was elected MP for Tangail-4 with 105,342 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol in the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026.
মোঃ লুৎফুজ্জামান বাবর ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Md Lutfozzaman Babar is the member of parliament for Netrokona-4 (Mohanganj, Madan and Khaliajuri Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. Elected for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this experienced politician has represented the seat more than once before and served as State Minister for Home Affairs from 2001 to 2006.

Babar was born on 10 October 1958. His family's ancestral home is in Netrokona. His father, A. K. Lutfor Rahman, was a senior officer of the Bangladesh Police and a member of President Ziaur Rahman's security team. His mother is Jobeda Rahman. He is the third of seven children, four brothers and three sisters. He grew up in the Moghbazar area of the capital, Dhaka.

In the 1980s he became known as a businessman in the digital watch import trade. At the same time he became involved in student politics, emerged as a young leader, and played an active part in the 1990 mass movement against autocracy.

In 1991 he joined the BNP central committee and was elected member of parliament for Netrokona-4. Re-elected in 2001, he was made State Minister for Home Affairs as the youngest member of Begum Khaleda Zia's cabinet. During this period he played a role in the government's operations to suppress militancy and in the arrest of Siddiqur Rahman, alias Bangla Bhai, a top leader of Jamaatul Mujahideen Bangladesh.
