In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected by a wide margin with 160,801 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife, Tahmina Zaman, was the BNP candidate for Netrokona-4 in the 2018 election. The couple have two sons and two daughters.
মোঃ শওকতুল ইসলাম মৌলভীবাজার-২ (কুলাউড়া):
Md Showkatul Islam is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-2 (Kulaura). Known as Showkatul Islam Shaku, the politician is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Showkatul Islam was born on 21 May 1959 in Kulaura, Maulvibazar district. He is the son of Md. Rais Ali and Maleka Khanam.

An expatriate politician, he was involved in Kulaura upazila BNP politics. In the 2001 parliamentary election he stood as a Jatiya Party candidate, and he later joined BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 88,381 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With his victory the seat returned to BNP for the first time since 1996, after nearly 30 years.
মোঃ শফিকুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে প:
Md. Shafiqul Islam is the member of parliament (MP) for Patuakhali-2 (Bauphal) in the 13th Parliament. Known as Dr Shafiqul Islam Masud, he entered Parliament for the first time as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and is a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. In the party he is a member of the central Majlis-e-Shura and the central working council, and secretary of Dhaka Metropolitan South.

He was born on 1 March 1978 in the Madanpura area of Bauphal upazila, Patuakhali district. He is the son of the late Md. Siraj Uddin Khan and Mst. Kaniz Fatima.

After passing the Dakhil and Alim examinations in the first division, he obtained a BA (Honours) and an MA in Bangla language and literature from the University of Rajshahi. He later obtained a PhD from the same university. He is a consultant by profession.

As a student he was president of the University of Rajshahi unit of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir from 2002 to 2003, and central president of the organisation from 2006 to 2007. He later joined Jamaat-e-Islami and took on the posts of member of the central working council and secretary of Dhaka Metropolitan South.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Patuakhali-2 with 100,750 votes on the scales symbol. In his personal life, he is married to the eye specialist Dr Zakia Farhana and is the father of one daughter and two sons.
মোঃ শরীফুল আলম বস্ত্র ও পাট প্রতিমন্ত্রী:
Md. Shariful Alam is the State Minister for Textiles and Jute and the member of parliament for Kishoreganj-6. He has been in charge of this ministry since 4 March 2026; before that, from 17 February to 4 March, he was State Minister for Industries and Commerce. A businessman, Shariful Alam is president of Kishoreganj District BNP.

He was born on 1 January 1975 in Kuliarchar Upazila, Kishoreganj. His father is Md. Siddique Mia and his mother Rasheda Begum.

On 21 September 2025 he was elected president of Kishoreganj District BNP. Elected member of parliament for the first time, for Kishoreganj-6 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he joined the government.
মোঃ শহিদুল ইসলাম, যিনি শহিদুল ইসলাম বাবু:
Md. Shohidul Islam, known as Shohidul Islam Babul, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Faridpur-4. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is central general secretary of Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

He was born on 20 April 1971 in Nagarkanda Upazila, Faridpur District. His father is Md. Sirajul Islam Khan and his mother Mariam Begum. He describes himself as a farmer's son.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Faridpur-4 with 127,443 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he went to the home of his rival, the Jamaat candidate Maulana Sarwar Hossain, to exchange greetings with him, and held cordial talks with supporters of both sides; this was reported as an example of harmony in the area.
মোঃ শহীদউদ্দীন চৌধুরী এ্যানি পানি সম্পদ:
Md. Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee is the Minister for Water Resources and the member of parliament for Laxmipur-3 (Sadar). He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A former central president of Chhatra Dal and a former acting VP of DUCSU (the Dhaka University Central Students' Union), Anee is a joint secretary general of BNP; he has been elected a member of parliament from this seat three times.

He was born on 2 February 1968 into the Chowdhury family of Banchanagar village in Lakshmipur municipality. His father, Haji Bashir Ullah Chowdhury, was a Lakshmipur businessman, and his mother is Hosne Ara Begum. Two of his paternal cousins, Shahabuddin Chowdhury and Chowdhury Khorshed Alam, were members of parliament from Lakshmipur. He passed the SSC in the science stream from Lakshmipur Adarsha Samad Government High School and the HSC from Government Science College, Dhaka. From the Department of Applied Chemistry and Chemical Technology at the University of Dhaka he obtained a bachelor's (honours) degree in 1988 and an MSc in 1989, and in 1993 he completed a diploma in education at the university's Institute of Education and Research.

In 1980, while still a schoolboy, he entered Chhatra Dal politics through President Ziaur Rahman's canal-digging programme. In 1989 he was GS (general secretary) of the Ziaur Rahman Hall students' union; in 1990 he was elected a member of DUCSU with the highest number of votes; and he was three times a student representative in the university senate. In 1992 he served as acting VP of DUCSU. From 1996 to 1998 he was central president of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal.

In 1999 he became a member of BNP's central executive committee. Elected a member of parliament from Laxmipur-3 in 2001 and 2008, he was a member of the parliamentary standing committees on the Ministries of Education, Disaster Management and Relief, Textiles and Jute, and Science and Information Technology. After serving as the party's central student affairs secretary (2009) and publicity secretary (from 2016), he is now a joint secretary general. In 2026 he was elected a member of parliament for the third time. His wife is Parvin Akter Chowdhury; they have two sons and a daughter.
মোঃ শামছুর রহমান শিমুল বিশ্বাস ত্রয়োদশ:
Md. Shamsur Rahman Simul Biswas is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Pabna-5 (Pabna Sadar). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he has been made chair of the parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

He was born on 3 July 1958. His father is Azizul Islam Biswas and his mother Shefali Begum.

A lawyer by profession, Simul Biswas was special assistant to BNP chairperson Begum Khaleda Zia. In 2004 he was appointed chairman of the Bangladesh Shipping Corporation, and during his tenure the loss-making corporation became profitable. In the party he serves as chief coordinator of the Jatiyatabadi Sramik Dal.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Pabna-5 with 181,925 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ শাহজাহান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে নোয়া:
Md Shahjahan is the member of parliament for Noakhali-4 (Subarnachar and Noakhali Sadar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. A vice-chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Shahjahan has come to Parliament for the fifth time. In Parliament he is chair of the committee on private members' bills and resolutions.

Mohammad Shahjahan was born in Sadar upazila, Noakhali district. He is the son of Abdul Motin and Hurer Nesa.

In 1978, when BNP was founded, he became actively involved in the party's politics under President Ziaur Rahman. After serving as the party's joint secretary general, he is currently a vice-chairman and the coordinator for rebuilding the party at the grassroots. He was president of Noakhali district BNP until 2016. In 2015 he was also given responsibility for nominating the party's candidates in the municipal elections.

In the 5th parliamentary election in 1991 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Noakhali-4 seat. He was then elected from the same seat to the 6th, 7th and 8th Parliaments as well. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the fifth time, winning 219,182 votes in Noakhali-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ শাহাদাত হোসেন, যিনি শাহাদাত হোসেন সে:
Md. Shahadat Hossain, known as Shahadat Hossain Selim, is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-1 (Ramganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

Shahadat Hossain Selim was born in Karpara union, Ramganj upazila, Lakshmipur district. His father is the late Alhaj Ali Hossain Mia and his mother is Saleha Begum.

Beginning his political life in Chhatra Dal, he was active in BNP politics for a long time. He later served as chairman of the Bangladesh Liberal Democratic Party (BLDP) and as spokesman of the 12-party alliance. On 8 December 2025 he dissolved his own party, rejoined BNP and received the party's nomination for the Laxmipur-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-1 as the BNP candidate, winning 86,811 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ সফিকুর রহমান (কিরন) শরীয়তপুর-২ (নড়:
Md. Shafiqur Rahman (Kiron) is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Shariatpur-2 (Naria and Sakhipur). He has been a member of Parliament once before; the 13th Parliament is his second term.

Shafiqur Rahman Kiron was born in 1965. His father is Habib Ulla Chokdar and his mother Shariatun Habib.

In party politics he is president of the Shariatpur District BNP. He was first elected MP from Shariatpur-3 in the election to the 6th Parliament held on 15 February 1996. He has long been active in Shariatpur politics and has contested several parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the second time, from Shariatpur-2 with 129,814 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ সাইফুল আলম, যিনি সাইফুল আলম খান মিলন:
Md Saiful Alam, known as Saiful Alam Khan Milon, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-12. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee, the Special Committee, the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Finance and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Planning.

He was born in 1954 in Dhaka. His father is Md. Habibur Rahman Khan and his mother Lutfun Nahar. By profession he is known as a businessman. Involved in organisational work since his student days, Saiful Alam served as central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir from January to December 1983.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-12 with 53,773 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ সাদিক রিয়াজ (সাদিক রিয়াজ চৌধুরী পি:
Md Sadique Reaz (Sadique Reaz Chowdhury Pinak) is the member of parliament for Dinajpur-2 (Bochaganj and Birol) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was born on 20 December 1965 in the village of Daula in Bochaganj upazila, Dinajpur district. His father is A F M Riazul Haque Chowdhury and his mother Suraiya Reaz. He holds a master's degree in commerce and is a businessman by profession.

Sadique Reaz has long been involved in politics in Dinajpur district. As an executive member of the district BNP he has played an active role in party activities. He was also the BNP's nominated candidate for Dinajpur-2 in the election to the 11th Parliament. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP, winning 139,622 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ সেলিম ভূইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ক:
Md Salim Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Cumilla-2 in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Education.

Salim Bhuiyan was born on 16 November 1958. He is the son of Sirajul Haque Bhuiyan and Ambia Khatun. Associated with the teaching profession, Salim Bhuiyan is known as "Principal".

In politics he is organising secretary (Cumilla division) of BNP's national executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 77,037 votes in Cumilla-2 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the election he was given a civic reception in Homna.
মোঃ সেলিম রেজা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সির:
Md. Salim Reza is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Sirajganj-1 (Kazipur upazila, and the Mechhra, Ratankandi, Bagbati, Chhongachha and Bahuli unions of Sirajganj Sadar upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 11 January 1964 in Kazipur upazila of Sirajganj district. His father is Afzal Hossain Sarkar and his mother Mst. Shyamoli Afzal. He is a businessman by profession.

Salim Reza has long been involved in BNP politics in Kazipur and has served as president of the Kazipur upazila BNP.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP with 115,132 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. According to a report in Naya Diganta, this was the first time since independence that a BNP candidate had won the Kazipur seat.
মোঃ সেলিমুজ্জামান মোল্যা গোপালগঞ্জ-১ (মু:
Md. Salimuzzaman Molla is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Gopalganj-1 (Muksudpur and part of Kashiani). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he serves as a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Salimuzzaman Molla was born in 1970 in Paschim Majhigati village, Kashiani Upazila, Gopalganj District. His father is Alhajj Moazzem Hossain and his mother Fatema Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he serves as assistant organising secretary (Faridpur Division) of the BNP's central executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 69,462 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In this election the sheaf of paddy candidates won all three seats in Gopalganj.
মোঃ হাফিজ ইব্রাহিম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md. Hafiz Ibrahim is the member of parliament (MP) for Bhola-2 (Doulatkhan and Borhanuddin) in the 13th Parliament. A leader of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has been elected an MP for the second time and is a member of the parliamentary Standing Committee on Public Accounts. He is a member of the BNP's central executive committee.

He was born on 1 January 1954 in Bhola district. He is the son of Zainul Abedin and Mst. Halima Khatun.

He is a businessman by profession and the publisher of the daily Khaborpatra. He has also served as a director of the state-owned Rupali Bank.

In the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001 he was first elected MP for Bhola-2 as the BNP candidate. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was again elected MP for this seat with 119,085 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ হারুন-অর-রশিদ রাজবাড়ী-২ (পাংশা, কাল:
Md. Harun-Or-Rashid is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Rajbari-2 (Pangsha, Kalukhali and Baliakandi). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

He was born on 1 July 1970 in Machhpara, Pangsha Thana, Rajbari. His father is the late Motiar Rahman and his mother Monowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Harun-Or-Rashid is a former general secretary of the Rajbari District BNP. For the 13th parliamentary election the BNP gave him the party nomination for Rajbari-2.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Rajbari-2 with 237,254 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ হাসান রাজীব প্রধান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Md Hasan Rajib Prodhan is the member of parliament for Lalmonirhat-1 (Patgram and Hatibandha) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is a member of the BNP's central committee. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs.

Hasan Rajib Prodhan was born on 1 July 1966 into the Prodhan family of Sreerampur union in Patgram upazila, Lalmonirhat district. His father is Md. Abedur Rahman Prodhan and his mother Hosne Ara Prodhan. He is a barrister by profession; after a long involvement in the legal profession, he later became engaged in active politics.

He has long been involved in local politics. The BNP nominated him as its candidate for Lalmonirhat-1 in the election to the 13th Parliament. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP, winning 138,686 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he said that the first duty of the winners is to ensure the safety of the defeated, and that he had come into politics to serve the people.
মো. ইসমাইল জবিউল্লাহ মন্ত্রীর পদমর্যাদায:
Md. Ismail Zabihullah is the Prime Minister's Adviser on the Ministry of Public Administration, with the rank of a Minister. A former secretary, Zabihullah retired in 2008 after working in the administration for about three and a half decades; since 15 August 2026 he has been a member of the BNP's national standing committee. He is not a member of parliament.

He was born in 1950 in South Char Kadira village, Char Kadira union, Kamalnagar upazila, in present-day Lakshmipur district (then Noakhali); his father is Sujauddin Ahmed. He was twelfth on the merit list of the Cumilla Board in the SSC in 1965 and third in the HSC in 1967. From the University of Dhaka he obtained a BA (Honours) in English literature in 1970, an MA in 1973 and later an LLB.

He began his career in 1973 as a lecturer in English at Chowmuhani College and taught at Noakhali Government College until 1976. Having passed the first regular civil service examination after independence, he joined the administration in 1977 as an assistant commissioner in Chattogram. He was a metropolitan magistrate in Dhaka, upazila nirbahi officer of Bhuapur (1986) and deputy commissioner of Faridpur; he also served as private secretary to the ministers for communications, home affairs, local government and health. He was a joint secretary at the Election Commission, an additional secretary in the Economic Relations Division and, in 2005-06, chairman of IDCOL and IIFC. As a secretary he served in the Economic Relations Division and the Ministry of Shipping.

After retirement he became involved in BNP politics and became a member of the chairperson's advisory council, and in the 2026 election he was chief coordinator of the party's election management committee. He is registered as a lawyer of the Supreme Court; he is associated with the board of trustees of Eastern University, and in 2026 he was nominated a member of the standing committee of the International Conference of Asian Political Parties (ICAPP).
মোছাঃ তাহসিনা রুশদীর সিলেট-২ আসন থেকে নি:
Mst. Tahsina Rushdir is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-2. Known as Tahsina Rushdir Luna, this politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament. She is the first woman elected MP from Sylhet Division. In Parliament she is a member of the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Tahsina Rushdir was born on 31 December 1966. Her father is A. B. M. Ekramul Hasan and her mother Mst. Mahfuza Khatun.

She studied at the University of Dhaka and worked as a deputy registrar of the University of Dhaka. In politics she has served as an adviser to the BNP chairman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, she was elected MP for the first time, with 116,697 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.

She is the wife of BNP leader M. Ilias Ali. The couple have two sons and a daughter.
মোছাঃ নুসরাত তাবাসসুম জ্যোতি ত্রয়োদশ জা:
Mst. Nusrat Tabassum Joty is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-50 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament from the National Citizen Party (NCP), as a nominee of the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami. She is a joint convener of the NCP and chief organiser of Jatiya Nari Shakti, the party's women's organisation. According to a Desh Rupantor report, having taken the oath at the age of 25, she is the youngest member of Parliament.

Nusrat Tabassum was born on 18 March 2001 in Bagoan village, Mathurapur union, Daulatpur upazila, Kushtia district. Her father is Mohd. Abdul Halim and her mother is Mst. Johura Khatun. Both her parents are teachers.

She studied at Bagoan Government Primary School and Bagoan K.C.V.N. Secondary School, and completed her higher secondary education at Dr. Fazlul Haque Girls' Degree College. In 2018 she was admitted to the Department of Political Science at the University of Dhaka. As a student she was active in debating, recitation and drama.

Her political activism began during the 2018 road safety movement. At the University of Dhaka she served as cultural secretary and as assistant general secretary of the university unit of Chhatra Odhikar Parishad, and later became one of the founding joint organisers of Ganatantrik Chhatra Shakti. In the July 2024 mass uprising, as a front-line coordinator of the Anti-Discrimination Students Movement, she played an important role in organising female students. When the NCP was launched on 28 February 2025 she became a joint convener of the party, and she was given the post of chief organiser of Jatiya Nari Shakti, formed in March 2026. The international human rights organisation Front Line Defenders has recognised her as a human rights defender.

In April 2026 the 11-party electoral alliance nominated her for a reserved seat for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was declared elected unopposed, and in May 2026 she took the oath as a member of parliament.
মোছাঃ সানজিদা ইয়াসমিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Most. Sanjida Yasmeen is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-31 in the 13th Parliament. The BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) nominated her for this seat. She is a trainee lawyer by profession.

Sanjida Yasmeen was born on 3 March 1989. Her father is Md. Akter Hossain and her mother is Mst. Rabeya Begum. She was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মোছাঃ সাবিরা সুলতানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mst. Sabira Sultana is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-14 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Sabira Sultana was born on 20 October 1976. She is the daughter of Md. Abdul Mannan and Mst. Razia Sultana. She is a businesswoman and social worker by profession. She lives in Kirtipur, in ward 5 of Jhikargacha municipality, Jashore.

Her husband, Md. Nazmul Islam, was a businessman and social worker. After her husband's death in 2011 she became active in politics. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament she contested Jashore-2 as the BNP candidate and received 146,447 votes. The BNP later nominated her for a reserved women's seat, and she became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-14 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোছাঃ সুরাইয়া জেরিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mst. Suraia Jerin is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-25 in the 13th Parliament. She entered Parliament for the first time as a nominee of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Known as Suraia Jerin Roni, she was born on 20 February 1985. She is a businesswoman by profession. She is active in the politics of Bogura and is joint general secretary of the Bogura district Mohila Dal.

Suraia Jerin was one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved seats for women in the 13th Parliament. She became the MP for reserved Women's Seat-25 through a vote of members of parliament. In May 2026, as the MP for the reserved women's seat for the Joypurhat and Bogura area, she took part in a meeting to exchange views with leaders and activists of the Joypurhat district BNP.
মোরশেদ মিলটন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে গাবতল:
Morshed Milton is the member of parliament for Bogura-7, which consists of Gabtali and Shajahanpur upazilas, in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time. BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia won this seat at every election from 1991 to 2008.

He was born on 1 January 1967. His father's name is Dr Abdur Rouf and his mother's Jahanara Khanam.

Morshed Milton is president of the Gabtali upazila BNP and a former chairman of the Gabtali upazila parishad. He was also the BNP's nominated candidate for Bogura-7 in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament.

In the election to the 13th Parliament, nomination papers for Bogura-7 had been submitted on behalf of Begum Khaleda Zia, and Morshed Milton was the party's previously announced alternative candidate. After Begum Khaleda Zia's death he became the BNP's candidate for the seat. In the election of 12 February 2026 he was elected with 264,212 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The Jamaat-e-Islami candidate for the seat, Md. Golam Rabbani, received 116,665 votes.
মোসাঃ নাজমুন নাহার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Mst Nazmun Nahar is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-40 in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, she is secretary of the media and publicity department of the party's women's wing. In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

Known as Nazmun Nahar Nilu, she was born on 3 December 1970. Her father is Dr. G. M. Azizul Haque and her mother is Zebunnesa. She is involved in teaching by profession; according to a Dinajpur TV report, she is the founding director of an educational institution and a former central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatri Sangstha.

Nazmun Nahar Nilu was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
মোসাঃ ফরিদা ইয়াসমিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mst. Farida Yeasmin is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-6 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a member of the BNP central executive committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Farida Yeasmin was born on 5 June 1961. She lives in Bheramara upazila, Kushtia district. She is a social worker by profession. Her name was announced on the BNP's list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as the candidate for the Meherpur and Kushtia region. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-6 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোসাম্মৎ শাম্মী আক্তার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Musammat Shammi Akther is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-22 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is assistant local government affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee and a member of the party's media cell.

Shammi Akther was born on 2 November 1973 in Chunarughat, Habiganj district. Her father is freedom fighter commander Sirajul Islam. She is a former student of the University of Dhaka. She is a social worker by profession.

She has served as joint secretary and as acting convener of the Habiganj district BNP. In the 9th Parliament, from 2009 to 2014, she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 38, and during that time she was a member of the Library Committee of Parliament.

Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-22 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোস্তফা কামাল পাশা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Mostafa Kamal Pasha is the member of parliament for Chattogram-3 (Sandwip) in the 13th Parliament. This veteran leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has previously been a member of parliament for this seat.

Mostafa Kamal Pasha was born on 10 November 1947 in Sandwip upazila, Chattogram district. He is the son of Haji Abdul Baten and Mosammat Sakina Khatun.

He has long experience in local government. From 1973 to 1990 he was elected chairman of Rahmatpur union in Sandwip upazila four times in a row. In 1990 he was elected upazila chairman. In the parliamentary elections of February 1996 and 2001 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-3 for the BNP. Within the party he has served as convener of the Sandwip upazila BNP and as a member of the BNP national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Chattogram-3 as the BNP candidate, winning 73,037 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ আক্তারুজ্জামান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Mohammed Akteruzzaman is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-10 (Gafargaon Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Akteruzzaman Bachchu. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

Akteruzzaman Bachchu was born on 1 November 1975. His home is in southern Gafargaon, Mymensingh. He is the son of Mohammad Shamsul Huda and Mst. Anowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession. He has long been involved in BNP politics and has played an active part in the party's movements and struggles.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 75,585 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he said that continuing work for public welfare would be his main goal.
মোহাম্মদ আবু সুফিয়ান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Mohammad Abu Sufian is the member of parliament for Chattogram-9 (14 wards of Chattogram City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Abu Sufian was born on 1 October 1964 in Saharbil village, Chakaria upazila, Cox's Bazar district. He is the son of Abul Hashem and Hure Jannat Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In the early 1980s, while studying at Chittagong College, he joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics, inspired by the ideals of President Ziaur Rahman. In 1985 he was elected vice-president of the city Chhatra Dal, and in 1987 its president. In 1990 he was the Chattogram convener of the anti-autocracy All-Party Students' Unity Council. In 1996 he became joint secretary of the metropolitan BNP, and he later served as senior vice-president of the metropolitan BNP. He was the BNP candidate for Chattogram-8 in the 2018 national election and in the 2020 by-election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament he stood for Chattogram-9 by decision of the party. Contesting the election with pledges to end waterlogging, improve civic services and ensure law and order, he was elected member of parliament on 12 February 2026, winning 109,388 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ আবুল হাসান সিলেট-৫ (জকিগঞ্জ ও ক:
Mohammed Abul Hasan is the Khelafat Majlis member of parliament elected from Sylhet-5 (Zakiganj and Kanaighat). Known as Mufti Abul Hasan, this Islamic scholar, preacher, mosque khatib and madrasa muhaddith is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of a special committee and of the standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Abul Hasan was born on 15 October 1966 in Majargram, No. 2 Birshri union, Zakiganj upazila, Sylhet district. His father, Abdul Latif, was known locally as Kazi Saheb. His mother is Mosammat Asharun Bibi. He is the eldest of four brothers and three sisters.

His education began at the village maktab. After studying up to class five at West Jamdahar Government Primary School, he completed hifz (memorisation of the Quran) at Jamea Darus Sunnah Barapathar Madrasa. Later, at Dhaka Uttar Ranaping Madrasa, under the Azad Deeni Edara-e-Talim board, he passed the Safela Chaharam examination in 1986, Mutawassitah in 1989, Fazilat in 1991 and Dawra-e-Hadith in 1992. He came first in the last three of these examinations. In 1992–1993 he obtained a higher degree in the department of fatwa and Islamic research at Jamia Islamia Patiya, Chattogram.

In 1993 he joined Jamia Islamia Darussunnah Mohammadia Lamargram Madrasa as mufti and muhaddith. He later became head of its ifta (fatwa) department and Shaikhul Hadith, posts he still holds. In 2000 he was appointed imam and khatib of Zakiganj Central Jame Mosque, and since 2013 he has also served as khatib of the Central Mokam Mosque in Beanibazar municipal town.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament with 79,355 votes as the candidate of Khelafat Majlis, backed by the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami, standing with the wall clock symbol.
মোহাম্মদ আমিন উর রশিদ (ইয়াছিন) টেকনোক্র:
Mohammad Amin ur Rashid (Yasin) is Minister for Fisheries and Livestock and Minister for Agriculture, appointed under the technocrat quota. When he took the oath on 17 February 2026 he was also responsible for the Ministry of Food; since 25 March he has been in charge of these two ministries. An industrialist and exporter, Amin ur Rashid is chairman of Lalmai Group. He is not a member of parliament.

He was born on 23 January 1958 in Cumilla district; his father is Ali Mia and his mother Amena Begum.

As one of the pioneers of the country's footwear industry, he has led various companies including Lalmai Footwear Limited, Arku Industries Manufacturing Limited, Baby Nutrition Limited, Lalmai Food Products, Organic Nutrition Limited and Arku Foods Limited. His companies have received the National Export Trophy (gold and silver) 12 times, and he has been selected a Commercially Important Person (CIP) 13 times. He founded Barapara Amena Begum Girls' High School in Cumilla.

In February 1996 he was elected MP for Cumilla-9 in the election to the 6th Parliament. He was president of the Cumilla Kotwali thana BNP. He was a member of the BNP's national executive committee from 2001 to 2009, joint secretary for agriculture affairs from 2010 to 2016, and secretary for relief and rehabilitation affairs from 2016 to 2025. He was general secretary of the Cumilla South district BNP from 2009 to 2022, and its convener from 30 May 2022 to 2025. On 12 March 2025 he became a member of the party chairperson's advisory council. In the 2026 election, at the request of party chairman Tarique Rahman, he withdrew his candidacy for Cumilla-6 and campaigned for the party's candidate, Manirul Haque Chowdhury. His wife is Mosammat Tahmina Akter; they have two sons, Iftekhar Rashid and Enayet Rashid.
মোহাম্মদ আমিনুল হক টেকনোক্র্যাট কোটায় য:
Mohammad Aminul Haque is State Minister for Youth and Sports, appointed under the technocrat quota; he took the oath on 17 February 2026. A former captain of the Bangladesh national football team and one of the best goalkeepers in the country's history, Aminul is the first former sportsman to enter the Cabinet directly without being a member of parliament. He is the BNP's central sports affairs secretary and convener of the Dhaka Metropolitan North BNP. He is not a member of parliament.

He was born on 5 October 1980 in Bhola and grew up in Mirpur, Dhaka. He became interested in football following the example of his elder brother, Moinul Haque. He began playing for MSPC City Club in the Pioneer League and did not concede a goal in his first nine matches.

He played for Mohammedan, Farashganj, Abahani, Muktijoddha Sangsad, Brothers Union, Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club and BJMC; he won the Premier League, several Federation Cups and the 2009 Super Cup, and also received the best goalkeeper award at the Super Cup. He made his debut for the national team in a friendly against Qatar in 1998 and captained the team for a long time. His crucial save in the final played a part in winning the 2003 SAFF Championship; he was named best goalkeeper of that tournament. At the 2010 South Asian Games, as captain, he led the under-23 team to the gold medal without conceding a single goal. Former national team coach György Kottán called him one of the best goalkeepers he had seen. He ended his 17-year professional playing career at the end of the 2013-14 season.

After retiring from football he joined BNP politics in 2014. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was the BNP candidate for Dhaka-16. As State Minister he has spoken of plans to build a playground in every union and a mini-stadium in every upazila of the country, with the aim of creating a new sports movement from the grassroots.
মোহাম্মদ আলি আসগার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Mohammad Ali Asghar is the member of parliament (MP) for Khulna-5 in the 13th Parliament. Known as Ali Asghar Lobi, this nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) has become an MP for the second time. He previously represented Khulna-2 in Parliament.

He was born on 18 October 1946 in Khulna. He is the son of Alhaj A.H.M. Ali Hafez and Begum Saleha Hafez. He studied at St Joseph's High School. He is a businessman by profession.

Ali Asghar Lobi was a member of the BNP's central executive committee. In the 2001 general election, BNP chairperson Khaleda Zia won more than one seat and gave up Khulna-2; in the by-election held that November he was elected MP unopposed.

He has also played a notable role in sports administration. From 2001 to 2006 he was president of the Bangladesh Cricket Board and worked on the administration and development of the country's cricket. From 2002 to 2004 he served as president of the Asian Cricket Council.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Khulna-5 with 148,854 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol. According to a report in Prothom Alo, this was the first time since independence that the BNP had won Khulna-5.
মোহাম্মদ এনামুল হক, যিনি এনামুল হক এনাম:
Mohammed Enamul Hoque, known as Enamul Hoque Enam, is the member of parliament for Chattogram-12 (Patiya) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Enamul Hoque was born on 5 March 1969. He is the son of the late Nurul Haque and the late Salma Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in the BNP's organisational work in south Chattogram. He has served as senior joint convener of the Chattogram South district BNP and convener of the Patiya upazila BNP. He was also the BNP candidate for the Patiya seat in the election to the 11th Parliament in 2018.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-12 as the BNP candidate, winning 135,044 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the Patiya seat for the first time since 2001.
মোহাম্মদ কয়ছর আহমেদ সুনামগঞ্জ-৩ (জগন্না:
Mohamed Koysor Ahmed is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-3 (Jagannathpur and Shantiganj). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee.

Koysor Ahmed was born in 1974. His father is Md. Abdul Matin and his mother Surma Bibi.

This UK-based politician is a former general secretary of the BNP in the United Kingdom. He is currently a member of the BNP's central executive committee.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 97,313 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is one of three expatriate leaders who won in Sylhet Division on BNP nominations.
মোহাম্মদ কামাল হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mohammed Kamal Hossain is the member of parliament for Dhaka-5 (wards 48, 49, 50 and 60 to 70 of Dhaka South City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Commerce. In the party he is a member of the Central Majlis-e-Shura and assistant secretary of Dhaka Metropolitan South Jamaat.

Kamal Hossain was born on 5 June 1976 in Shaharasti Upazila, Chandpur District. His father, the late Maulana Mohammad Abul Khayer, was an Islamic scholar, teacher, imam and social worker. His mother is Afia Khatun. He grew up in a family of eleven siblings.

He obtained a bachelor's degree with honours and a master's degree in statistics from Jagannath University, and an MBA from Bangladesh Islami University. As a student he made a name for himself as a debater. He began his career as an officer of Bangladesh Islami University. Later, to become more active in politics and social service, he left the job and took up business and social work.

His organisational life began in Islami Chhatra Shibir. In the organisation he served as president of the Khilgaon thana unit, president of Dhaka Metropolitan East and a member of the central executive council. In 2007 he joined Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, and from 2012 to 2018 he served as amir of the Motijheel thana unit.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate with 96,641 votes under the scales symbol. He is married and the father of three children.
মোহাম্মদ জাকির হোসেন, যিনি জাকির হোসেন ব:
Mohammed Zakir Hossain, known as Zakir Hossain Bablu, is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-5 (Muktagacha) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

Zakir Hossain was born on 1 January 1967 in Kandigaon village, Muktagacha Upazila, Mymensingh District. He is the son of the late Haji Md. Kashem Ali and the late Sultana Hasana. He studied at Ananda Mohan College. He is a businessman by profession.

Before the election he was convener of Mymensingh South District BNP. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-5 with 128,898 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is the father of a son and a daughter.
মোহাম্মদ নাজিবুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Muhammad Nazibur Rahman is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Pabna-1 (Santhia upazila and part of Bera upazila). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is also known as Nazibur Rahman Momen and as Barrister Nazib. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs and of the Library Committee, and chair of Sub-committee No. 4 of the Library Committee.

He was born on 1 March 1981 in Manmathapur village of Santhia upazila, Pabna district. His father was Maulana Motiur Rahman Nizami, a former amir of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and a former minister. His mother, Shamsunnahar Nizami, is a former principal of Manarat International School and College. Nazibur Rahman is the second of four brothers and three sisters.

He completed his primary, Dakhil, Alim and Fazil studies at Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa, and obtained a Kamil degree in Fiqh from Madrasah-e-Alia, Dhaka. He took a diploma in Arabic and Islamic Studies from Imam Muhammad ibn Saud Islamic University. In the United Kingdom he obtained a master's degree in Islamic Studies from Loughborough University, a bachelor's degree in law and the qualification of barrister-at-law from Northumbria University, and a master's degree and a PhD in banking and finance law from Queen Mary University of London.

He is a researcher, a specialist in international law and Islamic economics, and a lawyer. He became a member of the Bangladesh Bar Council in 2010 and began his career as a lawyer of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh in 2013. From April 2010 to June 2013 he was a part-time lecturer in the law department of International Islamic University Chittagong. He is recognised as a certified Shariah adviser and auditor by the Bahrain-based Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions, and has also served as a legal adviser at the UK Ministry of Justice.

Alongside his legal career he became active in national politics. In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Pabna-1 with 129,974 votes under the scales symbol.
মোহাম্মদ নূরুল ইসলাম, যিনি নুরুল ইসলাম ন:
Mohammad Nurul Islam, known as Nurul Islam Nayan, is the member of parliament (MP) for Bhola-4 (Charfasson and Monpura) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He also serves as central general secretary of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, an associate organisation of the party, and as a member of the BNP's central executive committee.

Nurul Islam Nayan was born on 12 September 1971 in Sharif Para, Charfasson upazila, Bhola district. He is the son of Mohammad Mohiuddin Mia and Umme Kulsum. He studied at Dhaka College and the University of Dhaka. Alongside politics, he is a businessman by profession.

Nayan became involved in Chhatra Dal politics in his school days and took part in various democratic movements, including the anti-autocracy movement of 1990. Beginning his organisational life as assistant general secretary of the Dhaka College South Hostel committee, he served as senior joint general secretary and acting general secretary of University of Dhaka Chhatra Dal. He later became a member of Chhatra Dal's central committee, its library secretary, joint general secretary and central vice-president. After student politics he joined Jubo Dal, where he served as senior joint general secretary, acting general secretary and senior vice-president of the central committee. On 9 July 2024 he was named general secretary of Jubo Dal.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, Nurul Islam Nayan was elected MP for Bhola-4 with 189,351 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ ফখরুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mohammed Fakrul Islam is the member of parliament for Noakhali-5 (Companiganj and Kabirhat upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), and took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Fakrul Islam is a native of Noakhali. He is the son of Alhaj Ahmed Ullah and Rezia Begum. By profession he is a businessman. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament as BNP's nominated candidate for Noakhali-5, winning 147,808 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ ফাহিম চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Mohammed Fahim Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Sherpur-2 (Nakla and Nalitabari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was born on 5 July 1978 in Nakla Upazila, Sherpur District. He is the son of Zahed Ali Chowdhury and Mst. Farida Chowdhury. He is an engineer and businessman by profession.

Nominated by the BNP in the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Sherpur-2 with 118,472 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. Of these, 60,054 votes came from Nakla Upazila and 57,387 from Nalitabari Upazila. After the result was announced, he asked party leaders, activists and supporters not to hold victory processions.
মোহাম্মদ মাজহারুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Mohammad Mazharul Islam is the member of parliament for Kishoreganj-1 (Kishoreganj Sadar and Hossainpur Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In the party he serves as general secretary of Kishoreganj District BNP.

Mazharul Islam was born on 4 May 1957 in Gaital village, Kishoreganj Sadar Upazila. He is the son of Abdul Ahad and Mst. Asia Khatun. He was a student of the 1972 batch of Kishoreganj Government Boys' High School. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been active in BNP politics in Kishoreganj. During the 1990 anti-autocracy movement he joined young activists on the streets of Kishoreganj in the struggle to restore democracy. On 21 September 2025 he was elected general secretary of Kishoreganj District BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected as the BNP's nominated candidate with 124,035 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ মোসলেহউদ্দিন ফরিদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতী:
Mohammad Moslehuddin Farid is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Jashore-2 (Jhikargacha and Chaugachha upazilas). He entered Parliament for the first time as the candidate nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a physician and researcher.

He was born on 15 December 1961 at the historic Kharki Pir Bari (the family home of the pirs of Kharki) in Jashore district. His father, Professor Mohammad Sharif Hossain, an educationist and social reformer awarded the Ekushey Padak, was principal of Government Michael Madhusudan College, Jashore. His mother is Begum Farida Hossain.

Moslehuddin Farid studied at Jashore Zilla School up to class seven. He passed the secondary examination from Jhenaidah Cadet College in 1977 and the higher secondary in 1979. He completed his MBBS at Dhaka Medical College in 1985. He later obtained a higher degree from the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health in the United Kingdom and a PGC from the University of Nottingham.

After working in Bangladesh for two years, he went to England for higher studies in 1989. After obtaining higher qualifications he worked there as a consultant in a cardiology department in Birmingham. He was a director of the Europe-Bangladesh Federation of Commerce and Industry.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Jashore-2 with 180,965 votes under the scales symbol.

In social and educational work, he serves as a trustee of Al Quran Academy, London, a trustee of Eden Academy Coventry, and president of the Centre for Alternative Development Foundation UK.
মোহাম্মদ শামীম কায়সার লিংকন ধর্ম বিষয়ক:
Mohammad Shamim Kaiser Lincoln is the State Minister for Religious Affairs and the member of parliament for Gaibandha-4. He has held this post since August 2026.

He was born on 23 February 1980 in Gobindaganj, Gaibandha; his father is M A Mottalib.

In May 2006, when a by-election was held for the Gaibandha-4 seat following the death of MP Abdul Mottaleb Akanda, he won it as the BNP candidate and entered Parliament for the first time. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament he was elected MP from the same seat for the second time.
মোহাম্মদ সালমান ওমর, যিনি সালমান ওমর রুব:
Mohammad Salman Omer, known as Salman Omer Rubel, is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-1 (Haluaghat and Dhobaura) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as an independent candidate. He was born on 1 May 1981 in Mymensingh. He is the son of Mohammad Hanif Omer and Mosammat Maksuda Khanam. He is a businessman by profession.

Salman Omer has been involved in politics since his student days. For a long time he was active in BNP politics, and he was a member of Mymensingh North District BNP and Haluaghat Upazila BNP. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Mymensingh-1 as an independent candidate with 108,265 votes.
রকিবুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে খুলনা:
Rakibul Islam is the member of parliament (MP) for Khulna-3 in the 13th Parliament and a Whip in Parliament. Nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he has entered Parliament for the first time. He is chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges, and a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs and of the House Committee. In politics he is known as Rakibul Islam Bakul, and he is student affairs secretary of the BNP's central executive committee.

He was born on 1 September 1967 in Khalishpur, Khulna. He is the son of freedom fighter Md. Sirajul Islam and Sahara Begum.

Bakul completed his primary education at Rotary School in Khulna and his secondary education at Khalishpur Secondary School. After passing his higher secondary examination from Government Brajalal College, he was admitted to the Department of Physics at the University of Dhaka in 1985 and completed his bachelor's degree there.

His political career began while he was studying at the University of Dhaka, as a Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal activist at Fazlul Huq Muslim Hall. He later became publicity secretary of Chhatra Dal's University of Dhaka unit and won in the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU) election of the 1990-91 session. He served two terms as vice-president of Chhatra Dal's central committee. He subsequently worked as a senior leader of Khulna metropolitan BNP, and in 2023 he was named student affairs secretary of the BNP's central executive committee. He was also the BNP candidate for Khulna-3 in the 2018 election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Khulna-3 with 74,845 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
রফিকুল ইসলাম জামাল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Rafiqul Islam Jamal is the member of parliament (MP) for Jhalokathi-1 (Rajapur and Kathalia) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he serves as chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs. He was born on 10 January 1964. He is the son of Abdul Aziz Mia and Shefali Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Rafiqul Islam Jamal has long been involved in BNP politics. After working as an organiser of Jhalokathi district BNP, he was named religious affairs secretary of the party's national executive committee. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Jhalokathi-1 with 62,010 votes on the sheaf of paddy symbol.
রফিকুল ইসলাম হিলালী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Rafiqul Islam Hilaly is the member of parliament for Netrokona-3 (Atpara and Kendua Upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is currently general secretary of Netrokona District BNP.

Hilaly was born on 1 May 1969. He is the son of Golam Muksud Hilaly and Anowara Hilaly. He passed the SSC in 1984 from Kendua Joyhari Spry Government High School and the HSC with letter marks in 1986 from Kendua Government College. After completing his honours degree in 1989 and his master's in 1990 at the University of Chittagong, he obtained a PhD in 2012 for research on the contribution of the martyred President Ziaur Rahman to the Liberation War. He is a businessman by profession.

His politics began in his student days. While studying at the University of Chittagong he became general secretary of Alaol Hall in 1987, and later held the posts of publicity secretary and general secretary of the university unit, becoming its president in 1993. He was nominated a member of the central Jubo Dal in 1995, assistant general secretary of the central Swechchhasebak Dal in 1997, and assistant forest and environment affairs secretary of the central Jubo Dal in 2002. He was elected president of Kendua Upazila BNP in 2008 and 2016. He was nominated a member of the BNP Central Executive Committee in 2014 and 2016, and in 2020 he was given the post of member secretary of Netrokona District BNP. In August 2025 he was elected general secretary at the district BNP conference.

He had also received the sheaf of paddy nomination for Netrokona-3 in 2006, 2008 and 2018. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament with 118,469 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
রাশেদা বেগম হীরা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Rasheda Begum Hira is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-3 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is training affairs secretary of the BNP central committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Rasheda Begum Hira was born on 29 August 1957. She is the daughter of the late Solaiman Tapadar and the late Anwara Begum. She obtained a master's degree from the University of Chittagong in 1981 and an MPhil from the University of Rajshahi in 1990. She is a social worker by profession.

While at university she joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics in 1979. In 2009 she became a BNP member of parliament for a reserved women's seat. Former MP Rasheda Hira is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. Through the votes of the members of parliament she again became a member of parliament, for reserved Women's Seat-3.
রুমিন ফারহানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্রা:
Rumeen Farhana is the independent member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-2 (Sarail and Ashuganj upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. A lawyer and politician, she was previously a member of the 11th Parliament from a reserved seat for women. She has now come to Parliament for the second time.

Rumeen Farhana was born on 19 August 1981 in Islampur, Bijoynagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. Her father, Oli Ahad, was a veteran of the Language Movement, one of the organisers of the Liberation War and a politician honoured with the Independence Award. Her mother is Rashida Begum. She was introduced to politics through her family. After completing her secondary education at Holy Cross Girls' High School and her higher secondary education at Viqarunnisa Noon School and College, she completed a bachelor's degree in law under the University of London. She later qualified as a barrister at Lincoln's Inn in the United Kingdom.

By profession she is an advocate of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and a member of the Dhaka Bar Association. Alongside law and politics, she is also known as a writer. Her published books include Amader Rojnamcha ("Our Diary", 2018), Jotota Bolte Perechhi ("As Much as I Could Say", 2022) and Sangsader Dinguli ("Days in Parliament", 2026).

In her political career Rumeen has served as assistant international affairs secretary of BNP's central committee. On 28 May 2019 she was elected unopposed, on a BNP nomination, as member of parliament for Reserved Women's Seat-50, and she was the party's only woman member in the 11th Parliament. On 11 December 2022 she resigned her seat in Parliament.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, she was elected member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent candidate, winning 118,547 votes with the duck symbol. She took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.
রুহুল কবির রিজভী মন্ত্রীর পদমর্যাদায় প্:
Ruhul Kabir Rizvi is Political Adviser to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, with the rank of a Minister; since 4 March 2026 he has also been responsible for the Ministry of Industries. A lawyer and long-time party spokesperson, Rizvi has been acting secretary general of the BNP since 20 August 2026 and is a member of the party's national standing committee. He is not a member of parliament.

He was born on 7 January 1965 in Dhaka; his ancestral home is in Kurigram. He studied at Bogura Zilla School, Kurigram Government High School and Bogura Bangla School, and then at Rajshahi College and Rajshahi Government City College. From the University of Rajshahi he obtained MAs in two subjects, geography and environmental studies and history, and a bachelor's degree in law.

After his higher secondary education he entered student politics through the left-wing Biplobi Chhatra Union. When the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal was founded he joined it, becoming publicity secretary and then general secretary of its University of Rajshahi unit, and later served as central president of the Chhatra Dal. In 1989 he was elected vice-president (VP) of the Rajshahi University Central Students' Union (RAKSU).

At the BNP's 6th national council on 19 March 2016 he was elected the party's senior joint secretary general, and for a long time he served as the party's spokesperson. In the 2026 election he was member secretary of the BNP's election management committee. On 15 August 2026 he became a member of the national standing committee, and on 20 August, when secretary general Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was elected President, he was given the post of acting secretary general of the party. His wife is Anjuman Ara.
রেজা আহাম্মেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুষ্:
Reza Ahammed is the member of parliament (MP) in the 13th Parliament for Kushtia-1 (Daulatpur). Elected as the candidate nominated by the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party), he is serving his second term as an MP. He is better known as Bachchu Mollah.

He was born on 3 October 1959. His father, Ahsanul Haque Mollah, was a four-time MP and State Minister for Posts and Telecommunications from 2001 to 2003. His mother is Begum Maleka Parvin. By profession Reza Ahammed is engaged in business and agriculture.

In the 2004 by-election for the Kushtia-1 seat, left vacant by his father's death, he was first elected MP as the BNP candidate with 81,587 votes, and served from 1 March 2004 to 27 October 2006. In the party he is a member of the BNP's national executive committee. He has also served as vice-president of the Kushtia district BNP and as president of the Daulatpur upazila BNP.

In the election held on 12 February 2026 he was elected MP for Kushtia-1 for the second time, with 165,909 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. According to Wikipedia, in this election this was the BNP's only winning seat in greater Kushtia, the region made up of Kushtia, Meherpur and Chuadanga.
রেজা কিবরিয়া হবিগঞ্জ-১ আসন থেকে নির্বাচ:
Reza Kibria is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Habiganj-1. An economist, writer and politician, he is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Education.

Reza Kibria was born on 6 March 1957 in Jalalsap village in Habiganj subdivision of what was then Sylhet district (now Nabiganj upazila, Habiganj). His father, Shah A. M. S. Kibria, was a former finance minister of Bangladesh. His mother, Asma Kibria, was a painter. His sister, Nazli Kibria, teaches in the Department of Sociology at Boston University in the United States.

He obtained a bachelor's degree in politics, philosophy and economics from the University of Oxford and a master's degree in economics from Queen's University. He later completed an MPhil and a DPhil in economics, also at Oxford. In 1984 he joined the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and he taught in the Department of Economics at the University of Dhaka. From 1996 to 2000 he was macroeconomic adviser to the revenue department of the Government of Papua New Guinea, then chief economist of PDP Australia, and from 2009 to 2011 macroeconomic adviser at the IMF's East Africa Regional Technical Assistance Centre. While teaching at Griffith University, from 2016 he spent two years as the IMF's macro-fiscal adviser at the Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Government of Cambodia. He has been chairman of Integro Holdings since 2015.

His active political career began in 2018, when he returned home and joined Gano Forum. He became a member of Gano Forum's presidium and later its general secretary. On 26 October 2021 he took over as convener of Gono Odhikar Parishad. On 1 December 2025 he formally joined BNP, and the party nominated him for the Habiganj-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 111,999 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Simi Kibria.
রেজেকা সুলতানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংর:
Rezeka Sultana is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-36 in the 13th Parliament. The BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) nominated her for this seat from Rangpur. She is a central assistant organising secretary of the Jatiyatabadi Mohila Dal and president of the Rangpur Metropolitan Mohila Dal.

Known as Advocate Rezeka Sultana Fancy, she was born on 1 March 1958. Her father is K. A. Kuddus and her mother is Fatema Zohra.

She is a lawyer by profession and well known in Rangpur's legal circles. In her professional career she served as public prosecutor (PP) at the Rangpur court. She is currently a vice-president of the Jatiyatabadi Ainjibi Forum (Nationalist Lawyers' Forum).

Rezeka Sultana was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. When she returned to Rangpur after being nominated, various organisations gave her receptions.
রেহান আসিফ আসাদ প্রতিমন্ত্রীর পদমর্যাদায:
Rehan Asif Asad is Adviser to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman with the rank of a State Minister; since 24 February 2026 he has been responsible for the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology and the Ministry of Science and Technology. An engineer and technology professional, Rehan is not a member of parliament.

He was born in Kella Baruipara village, Godagari upazila, Rajshahi district. He obtained a bachelor's degree in telecom and electrical engineering from RMIT and a master's degree in management and engineering from the MIT Sloan School of Management in the United States.

He is the son of Dr. M. Asaduzzaman, the late chairman and former executive director of the Barind Multipurpose Development Authority. The late Barrister Aminul Haque, a former Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, was his paternal uncle; another paternal uncle, Enamul Haque, was a former Inspector General of the Bangladesh Police. The posts and telecommunications sector, whose ministry his uncle once headed as minister, is now in his charge.
রেহানা আক্তার রানু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Rahana Akter Ranu is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-4 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the third time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is assistant training affairs secretary of the BNP central committee.

Rahana Akter Ranu is the daughter of Abdul Mazid and Nurjahan Begum. She is a businesswoman by profession.

As the BNP candidate for reserved women's seats she became a member of parliament in the 8th Parliament in 2001 and in the 9th Parliament in 2009. Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-4 through the votes of the members of parliament.
রোকেয়া বেগম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Rokeya Begum is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-45 in the 13th Parliament. Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami nominated her for this seat. In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs. She is best known as the mother of Jabir Ibrahim, a child martyr of the July mass uprising.

Rokeya Begum was born on 21 October 1977. Her father is Fazlur Rahman and her mother is Panna Rahman. She lives in West Mollartek, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka.

She completed her primary and secondary education at Khilgaon Government High School, her higher secondary education at Siddheswari Girls' College, and her bachelor's and master's degrees at Eden Mohila College. In her working life she was a school teacher.

Rokeya Begum was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.

Her husband is Kabir Hossain. The couple have three children. Their child Jabir Ibrahim was a student of KC Model School and College; on 5 August 2024 he was martyred in Uttara while taking part in the long march of the July mass uprising.
লুৎফুর রহমান, যিনি লুৎফুর রহমান কাজল নাম:
Lutfur Rahman, known as Lutfur Rahman Kajal, is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3 (Cox's Bazar Sadar, Eidgaon and Ramu upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament for the second time. He is fishermen's affairs secretary of the BNP national executive committee. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

Lutfur Rahman Kajal was born on 18 November 1966 in Gomatali union, Cox's Bazar district. His father, the late Alhaj Mostafizur Rahman, was an industrialist and social worker. His mother, Saleha Khanam, is a teacher and a former member of parliament.

Alongside politics he is an industrial entrepreneur and chairman of Niribili Group.

He entered politics through the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal in 1980. He later held posts at various levels of the Jubo Dal and the BNP. In 2001 he was first elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3 as the BNP candidate, winning 182,096 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Shirin Rahman, and they have two sons.
লুৎফুল্লাহেল মাজেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Luthfullahel Mazed is the member of parliament for Mymensingh-8 (Ishwarganj Upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Engineer Luthfullahel Mazed Babu. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Mazed Babu was born on 24 September 1978. He is the son of Md. Jasim Uddin and Mst. Nilufa Khanam. He is a businessman by profession. In party politics he has served as president of Ishwarganj Upazila BNP.

Standing as a parliamentary candidate for the first time in his life, in the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected on the BNP's nomination with 108,685 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he called on supporters to refrain from processions, flowers and violence.
শওকত আরা আক্তার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সং:
Shacot Ara Akter is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-33 in the 13th Parliament. The BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) nominated her for this seat. In Parliament she is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Known as Advocate Shacot Ara Akter Urmi, she was born on 1 April 1977. Her father is Abdul Hamid Sardar and her mother is Mallika Begum. She is married into a family from Gosairhat in Shariatpur. She is a lawyer by profession.

She has a long record in student politics. She was joint convener of the Eden Mohila College Chhatra Dal more than once. In the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal she served as assistant secretary for female students' affairs (Tuku-Alim committee), assistant general secretary (Habib-Juel committee) and joint general secretary (Rajib-Akram committee).

Shacot Ara Akter was one of the 36 people whose names the BNP announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026. After being nominated, she expressed her resolve to work for securing the rights of the country's people and for democracy.
শামছুন্নাহার বেগম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Shamsunnahar Begum is the member of parliament (MP) for reserved Women's Seat-43 in the 13th Parliament. Nominated by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, she is secretary of the women's wing of the Chattogram North district Jamaat.

Shamsunnahar Begum was born on 22 June 1973. Her father is Jamal Ahmed and her mother is Sakina Khanam. She is a resident of Mirsharai upazila in Chattogram.

She is a teacher by profession. She has long been involved in education as a senior teacher in the school section of Rahimpur Ideal School and College in Hathazari.

Shamsunnahar Begum was one of the 13 people whose names the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami announced on 20 April 2026 for the reserved seats for women. As the only candidate for this seat, which is filled by a vote of members of parliament, she was elected unopposed, and the Election Commission published the gazette on 30 April 2026.
শামা ওবায়েদ ইসলাম পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্র:
Shama Obaed Islam is State Minister for Foreign Affairs and MP for Faridpur-2 (Nagarkanda-Saltha). She took office on 17 February 2026. She is one of the seven women who won in that year's election and one of the three women in the cabinet. A computer scientist by training, Shama long worked, as a key member of the BNP's foreign relations committee, on the party's contacts with diplomats in Dhaka.

She was born in Faridpur on 14 May 1973. Her father, K. M. Obaidur Rahman, was an organiser of the independence movement, the BNP's fourth secretary general and a minister more than once; her mother, Shaheda Obaed, is an educationist and a former chairman of the Dhaka Education Board. After her studies at Viqarunnisa Noon School and College she went to the United States, where she took a bachelor's degree in computer science with highest honours from California State University and an MBA from the University of Phoenix. In the United States she worked in finance and technology at First Union Bank.

After her father's death she returned home and joined the BNP. In 2008 and 2018 she was the party's candidate in Faridpur-2, her father's long-held seat. In 2010 she became president of Jatiyatabadi Muktijuddher Projonmo, an organisation of the descendants of freedom fighters. Drawing on her knowledge of computer science, she was at the forefront of building public opinion on the risks of using EVMs (electronic voting machines) in elections.

On 20 November 2025, ahead of the election, she formally renounced her United States citizenship. In the 2026 election she was elected MP for the first time, from Faridpur-2 with 120,909 votes. Her husband, Mostajirul Shovon Islam, is managing director of the garment manufacturer Sparrow Group; they have two children.
শামীম আরা বেগম স্বপ্না ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Shamim Ara Begum Shapna is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-21 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She has long served as general secretary of the Cox's Bazar district BNP.

Shamim Ara Begum Shapna was born on 1 July 1960 in Moddhom Tekpara village, Cox's Bazar municipality. She is the daughter of Abul Khair and Fatema Khatun. After obtaining a master's degree in botany from the University of Chittagong in 1984, she studied law.

In 1986 she entered the legal profession as a member of the Cox's Bazar District Bar Association, and she has worked as a lawyer for more than four decades. In 2001 she was appointed public prosecutor (PP) of the Cox's Bazar district court. According to various media reports, she is the country's first woman public prosecutor.

Her political life began in 1982 through the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, while she was studying at the University of Chittagong. She later became general secretary of the Cox's Bazar district Mohila Dal. At the council of the Cox's Bazar district BNP held in the period after One-Eleven, she was elected general secretary. Various news media have reported on her role in the organisational restructuring of the district BNP and in activating the organisation at the grassroots.

On 20 April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat, and on 23 April the Election Commission declared her nomination paper valid. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-21 through the votes of the members of parliament.
শাহ মোঃ ওয়ারেছ আলী মামুন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Shah Md. Wares Ali Mamun is the member of parliament for Jamalpur-5 (Jamalpur Sadar) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Land. Within the party he is an assistant organising secretary of the BNP Central Executive Committee.

Wares Ali Mamun was born on 2 January 1968 in Rashidpur Union, Jamalpur Sadar Upazila. He is the son of S.M.A. Gafur and Mst. Romisa Khatun. He passed the higher secondary examination from Government Ashek Mahmud College and obtained a bachelor's degree in law from the University of Rajshahi. He is a lawyer by profession.

He has experience in local government: in 2004 he was elected mayor of Jamalpur Municipality. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Jamalpur-5 with 199,344 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
শাহজাহান চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কক:
Shahjahan Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-4 (Ukhia and Teknaf upazilas) in the 13th Parliament.
